description_zh: 用于读取、修改和重建 PE（可移植可执行）文件的 C# 库，既支持 Windows 原生映像，也支持带 .NET 元数据的映像。它提供三个抽象层次：原始文件头和节区（PEFile）；导入、导出、TLS、异常、调试信息和 Win32 资源等数据目录的解析结果（PEImage）；以及类似 System.Reflection 的 .NET 程序集和模块模型，涵盖托管、原生和动态方法体。它还能从 AppHost／单文件捆绑包中提取文件，支持 ReadyToRun 映像，无需 DIA 即可读取 PDB 和 Portable PDB 符号；上游的设计目标是在面对格式异常或经过混淆的二进制时保持稳健。
requirements: Release at review: v6.0.1, published 2026-07-25 on GitHub and NuGet; the reviewed master commit is one contributing-guide commit ahead. Nightly builds come from a separate NuGet feed. Version 6.0 changed the API, and upstream publishes a guide for migrating from v5.x.

Distributed as layered NuGet packages: AsmResolver, AsmResolver.PE.File, AsmResolver.PE, AsmResolver.PE.Win32Resources, AsmResolver.DotNet, AsmResolver.DotNet.Dynamic and AsmResolver.Symbols.Pdb. The libraries target .NET Framework 3.5, 4.6.2 and 4.7.2, .NET Standard 2.0 and 2.1, .NET Core 3.1 and .NET 6, 8, 9 and 10, and the README lists Windows, Unix-like systems, Mono and NixOS. Building uses the .NET SDK; the full test suite needs additional .NET runtimes, plus Mono and Wine on macOS and Linux.

It is a library without a GUI or a C# decompiler: users write .NET code against its API and supply their own PE files or .NET assemblies. Modified or rebuilt images still have to be checked by running them.

MIT license. The test resources are purpose-built sample binaries. Robustness against malformed or obfuscated binaries is an upstream design goal, not a guarantee for any particular protector. No binaries were processed for this entry.

name: DecompilerServer
description_en: Stdio MCP server built on the ICSharpCode.Decompiler engine that lets agents load managed .NET assemblies, including a Unity game's Assembly-CSharp.dll located from its game directory, then search symbols, string literals and attributes, read decompiled C# or IL, and trace callers, callees, usages and inheritance. Several assemblies stay loaded under aliases, so an agent can compare two versions structurally or diff individual method bodies, the README's example being RimWorld mod porting. Modding-oriented tools generate Harmony patch skeletons, detour stubs and transpiler anchor suggestions as text from the inspected members.
description_zh: 基于 ICSharpCode.Decompiler 引擎的 stdio MCP 服务器，智能体可借此加载托管 .NET 程序集（包括从游戏目录中定位到的 Unity 游戏 Assembly-CSharp.dll），继而搜索符号、字符串字面量和特性，阅读反编译得到的 C# 或 IL，并追踪调用方、被调用方、使用位置和继承关系。多个程序集可以用别名同时保持加载，便于智能体对两个版本做结构比较或逐个比对方法体，README 举的例子是 RimWorld 模组移植。面向模组开发的工具还能根据所查看的成员，以文本形式生成 Harmony 补丁骨架、绕行存根和 Transpiler 锚点建议。
requirements: Reviewed release: v1.4.0, published 2026-10-01; its tag points at the reviewed main commit. Release assets are framework-dependent single-file executables for Windows x64, macOS arm64 and x64, and Linux x64 and arm64 that need the .NET 10 runtime; building from source needs the .NET 10 SDK. The server speaks MCP over stdio, with README setup for Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code/Copilot and Codex, and an optional script installs a locally signed build and the bundled decompiler-mcp skill for Codex on macOS.

Users supply the managed .NET assemblies to inspect, such as a game's Assembly-CSharp.dll or a third-party library; the repository contains only its own test libraries, and the README notes that native libraries do not load. Loaded aliases are registered in LocalApplicationData/DecompilerServer/contexts.json and restored on demand, and at most four contexts stay resident by default (DECOMPILER_MAX_LOADED_CONTEXTS changes the limit).

Inspection tools carry the MCP readOnlyHint annotation; loading, unloading, context selection, decompiler settings and cache tools change server state. The patch, stub and wrapper generators return source text and do not modify the loaded assemblies. Responses are compact by default; DECOMPILER_RESPONSE_MODE=extended restores the earlier response fields.

The v1.4.0 release notes report 238 passing Release tests, and the release workflow builds and runs the test suite before publishing assets; these are project-reported results. MIT. No server, client or assembly was run here, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: Gepetto
description_en: IDA Pro plugin that sends Hex-Rays pseudocode to a hosted or local language model the user selects, to explain a function, comment it or propose new variable and function names, which the user picks from before they are applied. A chat console inside IDA also lets the model call tools that read disassembly, decompilation, cross-references, strings and types, rename and comment the database and run Python. The README warns that these general-purpose models may well be wrong and asks users to treat every result critically.
description_zh: IDA Pro 插件，把 Hex-Rays 伪代码发送给使用者选定的托管或本地大模型，用于解释函数、添加注释或提出新的变量名与函数名，由使用者勾选后再应用。IDA 内的对话控制台还允许模型调用工具，读取反汇编、反编译结果、交叉引用、字符串和类型，对数据库进行重命名和注释，并运行 Python。README 提醒这些通用模型很可能出错，要求使用者审慎对待每一个结果。
requirements: The reviewed main commit is 38 commits after the v1.5.1 release of 2025-11-19, while ida-plugin.json and pyproject.toml still declare version 1.5.0. The README requires IDA Pro 7.6 or later with the Hex-Rays decompiler. Installation uses Hex-Rays’ hcli plugin command, or copies gepetto.py and the gepetto folder into the IDA plugins directory and installs requirements.txt into IDA’s Python; pyproject.toml asks for Python 3.10+.

Each request sends the current function’s pseudocode, and in the chat console whatever the tools return, to the selected provider. Built-in providers include Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Azure OpenAI, Groq, Together, Novita AI, Kluster.ai, DeepSeek and OpenRouter with the user’s own API keys, which the README notes are usually paid, plus local Ollama or LM Studio models. Further providers load as drop-in Python files or entry-point packages, which the README warns execute arbitrary code when IDA starts.

The chat console, chosen as Gepetto in IDA’s input bar, offers the model 22 tools: reading disassembly, bytes, pseudocode, cross-references, imports, symbols, strings, structures and search results; declaring C types; renaming functions, globals and local variables; setting comments; and run_python, which executes model-supplied Python inside IDA with no confirmation step. Its system prompt tells the model to carry out requested changes without asking. The Explain, Comment and Auto-rename menu actions work on one function, and Auto-rename lists the proposed names so the user selects which to apply; two actions the README does not describe, Generate C Code and Generate Python Code, save a model-written rewrite of the function to a file.

Repository tests use pytest with Hex-Rays’ idapro library and open a bundled manalyze.exe build, from the author’s Manalyze PE analyser, as a fixture; no CI workflow is published. The README’s before-and-after screenshot and its observation that renaming works better after an explanation are the author’s. This collection reviewed source and documentation without running the plugin, its tests or any model.

GPL-3.0 per LICENSE and ida-plugin.json; IDA Pro, the Hex-Rays decompiler and model services keep their own licences and terms. The README credits Kaspersky with initial funding and HarfangLab as the current backer. The reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: GhidrAssistMCP
description_en: Ghidra extension that runs an MCP server inside Ghidra over streamable HTTP and legacy SSE, with 100 explicitly named tools (93 enabled by default) for pseudocode, disassembly, P-code, control-flow and call graphs, cross-references, strings, imports and exports, plus renaming, retyping, comments and structure inference. Since version 3.0.0 the server starts with the project manager, so agents can create, open, save and close projects and open programs before a CodeBrowser exists, while one shared server tracks whichever CodeBrowser window has focus. Six program resource templates, seven analysis prompts and a bundled script for running the server under analyzeHeadless complete the package.
description_zh: 在 Ghidra 内运行 MCP 服务器的 Ghidra 扩展，通过 streamable HTTP 和旧版 SSE 提供 100 个名称明确的工具（默认启用 93 个），涵盖伪代码、反汇编、P-code、控制流图与调用图、交叉引用、字符串、导入表和导出表，以及重命名、修改类型、注释和结构体推断。自 3.0.0 版起，服务器随项目管理器一同启动，智能体在 CodeBrowser 尚未打开时即可创建、打开、保存和关闭项目并打开程序；同一个共享服务器会跟踪当前获得焦点的 CodeBrowser 窗口。扩展另附六个程序资源模板、七个分析提示词，以及在 analyzeHeadless 下运行服务器的脚本。
requirements: Ghidra 12.0 or 12.1 Public running on Java 25 or newer; extension zips are specific to one Ghidra version. Release 3.0.0 (2026-10-09), whose tag is the reviewed commit, publishes a zip for Ghidra 12.1; installation goes through File → Install Extensions, and source builds use the bundled Gradle wrapper with Java 25 and GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR. The server listens on localhost:8080 by default, with streamable HTTP at /mcp (MCP 2025-11-25) and legacy SSE at /sse (2024-11-05); the Java MCP SDK 2.0.1, Jetty and Jackson are bundled under private package names.

Programs come from the user's own Ghidra project or imports; the extension supplies no target binaries. Headless mode runs the bundled GAMCPStartServerScript.java inside analyzeHeadless against the loaded program, with wait=true to keep the session open and a completion_file option to end it; the project lifecycle tools need the GUI project manager.

Write tools change the program or project, including names, types, comments, structures, disassembly, analysis options and saves, and read and write tools carry separate MCP annotations. import_file, export_program and the five Ghidra script tools are disabled by default; a headless agent_lab profile enables sandbox-local program export while arbitrary-path import and scripts stay disabled. The README describes no client authentication; the server rejects browser requests whose Origin header is not allowed.

The project's modernization review reports 90 passing tests in buildExtension test runs against Ghidra 12.0 and 12.1, and a live Ghidra 12.1 smoke test on 2026-10-09 that predates the four project-control tools; these are project-reported. MIT. The repository moved from jtang613/GhidrAssistMCP, and its README recommends the author's GhidrAssist client. No extension, server or analysis was run here, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: dewolf
description_en: Research decompiler from Fraunhofer FKIE, developed with Singapore's DSO National Laboratories between 2019 and 2021, that runs as a Binary Ninja plugin and starts from Binary Ninja's Medium Level IL. A pipeline of preprocessing, SSA, data-flow and control-flow stages restructures code following the DREAM/DREAM++ approach and emits C-like output. Results appear in a Binary Ninja dock widget, or decompile.py prints or writes them for a whole binary or one named function in batch use.
description_zh: 由 Fraunhofer FKIE 与新加坡 DSO 国家实验室在 2019 至 2021 年合作研发的研究型反编译器，以 Binary Ninja 插件形式运行，并以 Binary Ninja 的中级中间语言（Medium Level IL）为起点。它通过预处理、SSA、数据流和控制流等阶段组成的流水线，按照 DREAM/DREAM++ 方法重建控制结构，输出类 C 代码。结果可在 Binary Ninja 的停靠窗口中查看，也可在批量场景下用 decompile.py 对整个二进制或指定函数进行反编译，并输出到终端或文件。
requirements: Release at review: v2026.7.11, published 2026-07-11 by the project's automatic release workflow; the reviewed main commit is that release, and plugin.json declares the same version and lists Windows, Linux and macOS.

Needs Python 3.10+, a separately licensed Binary Ninja (the README asks for the latest stable release, at least 3.4; plugin.json sets minimum build 4271) with its Python API installed in the same environment, and astyle for indentation; libgraph-easy-perl is needed only for ASCII graph output. The plugin is installed by cloning it into Binary Ninja's plugin folder and installing requirements.txt, which pulls the project's dewolf-logic and dewolf-idioms packages from Git.
Settings made in the Binary Ninja GUI do not apply to decompile.py, which reads a config.json in the plugin folder instead; decompiler/util/default.json lists every option.

The README calls dewolf a research prototype that is not optimized for production use and warns of bugs or decompilation failures on real-world binaries. Its tests compile C sample sources and keep GNU coreutils executables under tests/coreutils/binaries as fixtures; CI builds a Docker image around a Binary Ninja archive and license supplied from repository secrets.
LGPL-2.1 (the plugin.json notice allows any later version). No binaries were decompiled.

name: Dembrandt
description_en: Node.js CLI that renders a website in Playwright-driven Chromium or Firefox and reads computed styles from the DOM to extract its design system: logo, color roles with the evidence behind each pick, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion, breakpoints and component styles such as buttons and inputs. Results export as W3C design tokens (DTCG), Tailwind v4 or shadcn/ui themes, DESIGN.md, an HTML report or a brand-guide PDF, alongside WCAG contrast checks on real DOM pairs and a CI drift gate against a committed baseline. It also runs as an MCP server for agent clients.
description_zh: Node.js 命令行工具，通过 Playwright 驱动 Chromium 或 Firefox 渲染网站，并从 DOM 读取计算样式来提取其设计系统：标志、附带判定依据的颜色角色、字体排版、间距、边框、阴影、动效、断点，以及按钮、输入框等组件样式。结果可导出为 W3C 设计令牌（DTCG）、Tailwind v4 或 shadcn/ui 主题、DESIGN.md、HTML 报告或品牌指南 PDF，还能对页面中实际的前景与背景组合做 WCAG 对比度检查，并在 CI 中与已提交的基线比较、拦截设计漂移。它也能作为 MCP 服务器供智能体客户端调用。
requirements: Release at review: v0.39.2, published 2026-10-11 on GitHub and npm; the reviewed main commit is ten README, MCP-registry and Action-metadata commits ahead. SECURITY.md describes the project as pre-1.0, with fixes only for the latest 0.x release.

Requires Node.js 18+ and a one-time dembrandt install-browser step, because playwright-core ships no browser; Linux and CI hosts also need Playwright's system libraries, and Docker or CI containers may need --no-sandbox. The experimental --ai brand-color model needs the optional onnxruntime-node package. The MCP server starts with npx dembrandt mcp, and a separate GitHub Action wraps the drift gate.

Input is a live URL, rendered at 1920x1080 by default or 390x844 with --mobile; crawls merge several pages found from navigation links or from sitemap.xml after a robots.txt check. The README's limitations: dark mode needs --dark-mode, canvas/WebGL sites cannot be analyzed, some dynamically loaded content and hover or focus states can be missed, and JavaScript-heavy sites need hydration time. Pages behind a sign-in can be reached with the user's own cookies or an interactive login.

MIT. The README limits intended use to design systems you own or may analyze, on sites whose terms permit automated access, and asks users not to reproduce third-party brand identities, logos or trademarks. The optional --key flag uploads each run's snapshot to the vendor's hosted Dembrandt App, which is in beta. No sites were analyzed for this entry.

name: Android Reverse Engineering Skill
description_en: Claude Code plugin and agent skill that drives jadx and Fernflower/Vineflower to decompile Android APK, XAPK, JAR and AAR files and document their HTTP APIs. A fingerprint pass first identifies the app's framework, HTTP stack, obfuscation level and native libraries, then shell scripts extract endpoints and authentication patterns across Retrofit, OkHttp, Volley, Ktor and Apollo/GraphQL, trace call flows from UI down to the network layer, and rebuild original Kotlin class names from the metadata R8 leaves behind. It installs through the bundled Claude Code marketplace, and its scripts also run standalone with a /decompile slash command.
description_zh: Claude Code 插件及智能体技能，驱动 jadx 与 Fernflower/Vineflower 反编译 Android 的 APK、XAPK、JAR 和 AAR 文件并记录其 HTTP 接口。它先用指纹步骤识别应用的框架、HTTP 栈、混淆程度和原生库，再通过 shell 脚本在 Retrofit、OkHttp、Volley、Ktor 和 Apollo/GraphQL 等栈中提取接口与鉴权特征，追踪从界面到网络层的调用链，并利用 R8 无法剥除的元数据还原原始的 Kotlin 类名。技能通过自带的 Claude Code marketplace 安装，其脚本也可独立运行，并提供 /decompile 斜杠命令。
requirements: A Claude Code client with plugin/skill support; install by adding SimoneAvogadro/android-reverse-engineering-skill as a marketplace and installing the android-reverse-engineering plugin, or from a local clone. The reviewed plugin manifest is version 1.5.0 on the master commit, ahead of the latest GitHub release v1.1.0 (2026-04-27).

The skill runs external tools it does not bundle: Java JDK 17+ and the jadx CLI are required, and Vineflower or Fernflower plus dex2jar are optional for better Java output; a dependency checker and an OS-detecting install helper are provided. Bash scripts are the primary path, with experimental PowerShell equivalents for Windows.

Users supply the Android packages to analyze; the repository ships no app files. Work is static decompilation, API documentation, call-flow tracing and Kotlin name recovery; the author reports roughly complete recovery of the Repository/ViewModel/UseCase classes on a typical app, which is a project-reported figure.

Apache-2.0 for the skill; the decompilers and other driven tools keep their own licenses. The README limits use to lawful purposes such as authorized security research, interoperability analysis, and malware analysis, and places responsibility on the user. No decompiler or app was run here, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: GB Recompiled
description_en: Static recompiler that turns Game Boy and Game Boy Color ROMs into portable C projects: it decodes and analyzes banked LR35902 code, emits C with machine-readable metadata, and links it with a shared SDL2 runtime for video, audio, input, saves and hardware timing. Jump targets that static analysis missed fall back to an interpreter. The repository also carries differential, replay and frame and audio capture tooling, plus a Pokémon Crystal port that builds native features on hooks into the exact ROM.
description_zh: 将 Game Boy 和 Game Boy Color ROM 转换为可移植 C 项目的静态重编译器：它解码并分析分 bank 的 LR35902 代码，生成 C 代码及机器可读的元数据，再与共享的 SDL2 运行时链接，由运行时处理视频、音频、输入、存档和硬件时序。静态分析未覆盖的跳转目标会回退到解释器执行。仓库还提供差分对比、回放以及画面和音频捕获工具，并附有一个 Pokémon Crystal 移植，借助对特定 ROM 的挂钩实现原生功能。
requirements: The README calls it an experimental recompiler with no whole-catalogue compatibility claim and says successful code generation does not guarantee that every scene runs correctly. ACCURACY.md (generated 2026-07-13) reports 8 of 8 Blargg and 63 of 67 Mooneye test ROMs passing and states that this is not a measure of commercial-game compatibility.

Users supply their own .gb or .gbc ROMs; the repository contains no ROMs. The bundled Crystal Recompiled port is ROM-free: it requires the user's exact US/Europe Rev 1 ROM, checks its hash before writing any ROM-derived output, and keeps generated projects in ignored local or private-cache paths, and its distribution policy forbids releasing ROMs, generated C or extracted assets. That port's alpha is verified end to end only on macOS arm64.

Release v0.1.0 (2026-08-03) ships prebuilt gbrecomp archives for Linux x64, macOS Intel and Apple silicon, and Windows x64; the reviewed main commit is 13 commits ahead, last committed 2026-09-10. Building from source needs CMake 3.20+, Ninja, SDL2 development files and a C11/C++20 compiler, and generated projects build with CMake and Ninja. ANDROID.md documents a separate single-ROM APK workflow, not reviewed here.

A CTest suite covers isolated invariants. The README notes that differential mode shares runtime devices with the interpreter and so is not an independent hardware oracle, leaving SameBoy comparisons and frame, audio and state captures as separate evidence. The only GitHub workflow builds release archives and smoke-tests them with a generated fixture ROM; an optional manual job checks the Crystal port against a privately held ROM without publishing.

MIT-licensed; the vendored Dear ImGui keeps its own license. The README states no affiliation with Nintendo, and the Crystal port none with Nintendo, The Pokémon Company, Game Freak or Creatures. The README points contributors and coding agents to AGENTS.md but states no REA use. This collection did not build or run it, and no game compatibility is implied.

name: CodemerxDecompile
description_en: Cross-platform desktop .NET decompiler maintained by the original JustDecompile creators as a continuation of their JustDecompile Engine, built with Mono.Cecil and an Avalonia UI. It loads assemblies into a tree of namespaces, types, members and resolved references, shows decompiled C#, VB.NET or IL with go-to-definition and back/forward navigation, and searches names, types, string literals and instructions. A create-project command exports an assembly as a Visual Studio 2015, 2017 or 2019 project.
description_zh: 由 JustDecompile 原班开发者维护的跨平台桌面 .NET 反编译器，是其 JustDecompile 引擎的延续，基于 Mono.Cecil 并采用 Avalonia 界面。它把程序集加载为由命名空间、类型、成员和已解析引用组成的树，以 C#、VB.NET 或 IL 显示反编译结果，支持转到定义和前进／后退导航，并可搜索名称、类型、字符串字面量和指令。“创建项目”命令可将程序集导出为 Visual Studio 2015、2017 或 2019 项目。
requirements: Release at review: 1.5.0, published 2024-11-18, with portable archives for Windows x64 and ARM64, Linux x64 and macOS ARM64 and x64; the reviewed master commit is from the same day and was still the latest at review. The README says the macOS app is unsigned, so macOS reports it as damaged until its quarantine attribute is removed.

Source builds need the JustDecompileEngine and AvaloniaEdit Git submodules and the .NET 7 SDK: the app targets net7.0, and the release workflow publishes one build per runtime with dotnet publish. The main view uses the engine's C# 7 and Visual Basic 10 language modes.

Release builds send usage events, such as start-up, opening files, changing language, searching and creating projects, to a Matomo cloud server together with a hashed device identifier, the app version and OS details, and they query the GitHub API for newer releases; no setting to turn this off was found in the reviewed source.

AGPL-3.0 for the app and the JustDecompile Engine; Mono.Cecil and AvaloniaEdit are MIT-licensed, per the README and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. Input is the user's own .NET assemblies. No assemblies were decompiled and no generated projects were built.

name: Reverify
description_en: Python CLI and stdio MCP server that checks a model’s structured claims about a binary, such as bytes or typed values at an offset, strings, imports and exports, instruction mnemonics, emulation results and tested or Z3-proved equivalence, and returns VERIFIED, REFUTED or INCONCLUSIVE with the evidence the tools observed. Grounded and refuted results are kept in a per-binary ledger on disk, so a reset or later session resumes from them instead of from a summary, and a reconstruct loop has a model propose claims until an informative set verifies. A separate rollover command replaces context compaction in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or OpenCode with file hand-offs and fresh sessions.
description_zh: Python 命令行工具和 stdio MCP 服务器，用于检查模型对二进制文件提出的结构化断言，例如某偏移处的字节或类型化数值、字符串、导入与导出、指令助记符、模拟执行结果，以及经测试或经 Z3 证明的等价性，并连同工具实际观察到的证据返回 VERIFIED、REFUTED 或 INCONCLUSIVE。已确证和已驳斥的结果保存在磁盘上按二进制文件划分的台账中，重置后或之后的会话可据此继续，而不依赖摘要；reconstruct 循环则让模型不断提出断言，直至一组有信息量的断言通过验证。另有 rollover 命令，用文件交接和新会话取代 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 或 OpenCode 的上下文压缩。
requirements: The reviewed main commit is 25 commits after the v0.11.0 GitHub release of 2026-09-04; PyPI’s newest version is 0.10.0, and the README’s status section still describes v0.9.0. The core is pure Python with no dependencies, and pyproject.toml declares Python 3.8+. The full extra adds capstone, unicorn, lief and z3-solver, and the angr extra adds the function, call and cross-reference claims, which return INCONCLUSIVE without an engine. The toolkit also parses PE, ELF and Mach-O files, scans byte patterns, decodes Protobuf and TLV data and generates Frida hook scripts.

The verifier and benchmarks need no model. reconstruct calls an OpenAI-compatible endpoint configured by OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_MODEL, orchestrate can drive Claude through the Claude Agent SDK on a Claude Code login, and the MCP server gives any MCP client parsing, disassembly, pattern-scan, semantic, claim, ledger and checkpoint tools. Ledgers and checkpoints are written under .reverify in the working directory. Users supply the binaries to analyse; the repository holds benchmark sources and result records, not target binaries.

reverify rollover install edits the user settings of each supported CLI it finds to add hooks and switch off native compaction, keeping backups and offering uninstall. The README warns that a Claude Code or Codex session not started through its launcher can then grow without limit, and reports one session that reached 909k tokens.

The headline benchmark applies a fixed textbook push rbp; mov rbp, rsp prologue guess, not a live model, to the entry points of system binaries. BENCHMARK.md reports that guess refuted on 69 of 71 Windows 11 files and never falsely verified, and 0 false VERIFIED among 475 known-false claims on 50 Windows binaries; CI repeats both checks on Linux, Windows and macOS and fails on any false VERIFIED. The author notes that 0 of N bounds the error rate rather than proving it zero. These are project-reported results; this collection ran none of them.

MIT. SECURITY.md limits use to authorised work such as malware analysis, CTF, interoperability research and software the user owns or may analyse, and excludes circumventing licensing or copy protection on software the user does not own or license. The reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: wxapkg
description_en: Desktop GUI for Windows and macOS, built with Wails, that unpacks WeChat mini-program .wxapkg packages for study. It scans the mini-program package folders of local WeChat 3.x and 4.x installations, including per-user folders, or takes a file or folder the user selects; packages that the PC client stores encrypted are decrypted first. Each packaged file is written to its recorded path, with optional beautification of JSON, HTML and JavaScript.
description_zh: 基于 Wails 构建的 Windows 与 macOS 桌面图形工具，用于解包微信小程序 .wxapkg 包以供研究。它会扫描本机微信 3.x 和 4.x 安装中的小程序包目录（包括各用户目录），也可处理用户选定的文件或目录；PC 客户端以加密形式存储的包会先行解密。包内每个文件都按其记录的路径写出，并可选择美化 JSON、HTML 和 JavaScript 代码。
requirements: Release at review: v2.0.0, published 2026-04-16, with a Windows x64 executable and a macOS universal app; earlier v1.x releases shipped Windows executables only. The reviewed main commit adds only a settings dialog for the default output directory after that release.
The README names Windows and macOS as the supported platforms. Building from source needs Go 1.25 as declared in go.mod, the Wails v2 CLI and npm for the Vue frontend.

Input is .wxapkg packages already on the machine, found in WeChat's package folders or selected manually. The output is the files stored in the package: the reviewed code has no WXML or WXSS decompilation step, so compiled view code stays compiled, and reading mini-program information is still an unchecked item in the README's feature list.

No license file or license declaration was found, so public source availability is not a reuse grant. The README disclaimer limits use to learning and researching the design ideas and principles in software, with users bearing all legal responsibility; analyze only packages you are authorized to inspect. No packages were unpacked for this entry.

name: React Native Decompiler
description_en: Alpha-stage Node.js CLI that splits a React Native JavaScript bundle (index.android.bundle or main.jsbundle), an unbundled js-modules folder, or Webpack entrypoint and chunk bundles into one readable file per module. Tagger, editor and decompiler plugins working on a Babel AST undo compilation artifacts such as Babel helpers, comma-operator chains and shortened booleans, turn element calls back into JSX and can rewrite modules as ES6 imports and exports, after which ESLint and Prettier tidy the output. Modules recognized as npm packages are skipped unless requested, and one module ID can limit output to that module and its dependencies.
description_zh: 处于 Alpha 阶段的 Node.js 命令行工具，可把 React Native 的 JavaScript 包（index.android.bundle 或 main.jsbundle）、未打包应用的 js-modules 目录，或 Webpack 入口包与分块包拆分为每个模块一个、便于阅读的文件。基于 Babel AST 的标注器、编辑器和反编译器插件会消除 Babel 辅助函数、逗号运算符链和缩写布尔值等编译痕迹，把元素创建调用还原为 JSX，并可将模块改写为 ES6 import／export 形式，最后用 ESLint 和 Prettier 整理输出。被识别为 npm 包的模块默认跳过，也可指定一个模块 ID，只输出该模块及其依赖。
requirements: Latest npm release: react-native-decompiler 0.2.4, published 2023-03-31, providing the react-native-decompiler and rnd commands; the reviewed master commit is from the same day and was still the latest at review. The package declares no Node.js engine range, its publish workflow uses Node.js 12, and it pins Babel 7.12, ESLint 7 and Prettier 2. It continues Richard Fu's original repository, which is now archived.

Input is a plain-JavaScript bundle taken from the user's own React Native app, a js-modules folder, or a Webpack entrypoint bundle or chunk folder. The README states in bold that encrypted or binary bundles are not supported.

The README labels the tool alpha, and the repository has no automated tests; CI only builds and lints it. The README documents the Prettier switch as --prettier, but the source reads --noPrettier. Output is cleaned-up module code for reading, not the original project sources.
AGPL-3.0-or-later. No bundles were decompiled.

name: DecompAI
description_en: Gradio chat application whose LangGraph ReAct agent analyses an uploaded x86 Linux ELF binary: it lists and disassembles functions, decompiles them with Ghidra, drives radare2 and gdb, and runs shell commands and Python scripts in a privileged Kali Linux runner container. Workspaces are keyed by the binary’s SHA-256, so uploading the same file again restores the session. It came out of a school research project, and its CTF results are the authors’ own report.
description_zh: Gradio 对话应用，其 LangGraph ReAct 智能体分析使用者上传的 x86 Linux ELF 二进制文件：列出并反汇编函数，用 Ghidra 反编译，调用 radare2 和 gdb，并在特权模式的 Kali Linux 运行容器中执行 shell 命令和 Python 脚本。工作区以二进制文件的 SHA-256 为键，再次上传同一文件即可恢复会话。该项目源自一项学校研究计划，其 CTF 成绩为作者自述。
requirements: The reviewed main commit of 2025-11-10 containerised the app. The repository has no tagged releases; the README points to app and runner images tagged 1.0.0 on Docker Hub. Only x86 Linux ELF binaries are supported, and QEMU-based ARM, MIPS and Windows PE support is listed as future work.

The app needs Python with the pinned requirements.txt (Gradio 5.25, LangGraph and LangChain) and Docker. docker compose builds or pulls a Kali runner image with kali-linux-headless, Ghidra 11.3.1, OpenJDK 21 and radare2 plugins, and the app controls the host Docker daemon through a mounted /var/run/docker.sock. Runner containers start with --privileged on Docker’s default network, and the Gradio interface listens on 0.0.0.0:7860 by default; the README asks maintainers to audit any added dependencies.

An OpenAI or Gemini API key and an LLM_MODEL setting go in .env. The README suggests gemini-2.5-pro or gemini-2.5-flash, while the code defaults to gpt-4o-mini; disassembly, decompiled code and tool output are sent to that provider. Users upload their own binaries. None are committed, and tests/test_disassemble.py expects a binaries/ch2.bin that the repository does not include.

The README reports validation on Root-Me CTF challenges, consistently solving difficulty-3-of-5 exercises automatically or semi-automatically, with no published runs or logs. This collection ran neither the app nor its tests. Session data under /tmp/decompai_analysis_sessions by default is lost on reboot.

LICENSE is MIT text with an added clause requiring any use, modification or distribution to display a “Based on DecompAI” attribution, so GitHub does not recognise it as a standard licence; Ghidra, the Kali packages and model services keep their own terms. The README limits use to lawful reverse engineering, education and security research. The reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: dtk-template
description_en: Project template for starting GameCube and Wii matching-decompilation repositories around decomp-toolkit. Its configure.py generates a ninja build that analyzes and splits the game's DOL and REL files from per-version config.yml, symbols.txt and splits.txt files, compiles the decompiled C/C++ with period Metrowerks compilers, relinks the result and checks it against recorded SHA-1 hashes. It also wires in objdiff for per-object diffing, progress reporting for decomp.dev and an example GitHub Actions workflow.
description_zh: 用于围绕 decomp-toolkit 创建 GameCube 和 Wii 匹配反编译仓库的项目模板。其 configure.py 生成 ninja 构建：依据各版本的 config.yml、symbols.txt 和 splits.txt 分析并拆分游戏的 DOL 和 REL 文件，用当年的 Metrowerks 编译器编译反编译出的 C/C++ 代码，重新链接后与记录的 SHA-1 哈希核对。模板还集成了用于逐目标文件比对的 objdiff、面向 decomp.dev 的进度报告，以及一个 GitHub Actions 工作流示例。
requirements: A scaffold rather than a finished project: users rename the GAMEID placeholders, write each version's configuration and refine symbols and splits after the initial analysis. The README says nearly all active GameCube and Wii decompilation projects use this structure. There are no releases or tags; the reviewed commit (2026-04-26) pins decomp-toolkit v1.8.3, objdiff v3.6.1, binutils 2.42-2 and the 20251118 compilers package.

Users place their own disc image or extracted game files in the ignored orig/[GAMEID] directory, and no game assets are committed. The CI guide has the game files needed for a build stored in a separate build-container repository and warns that it must stay private to avoid exposing the game's assets.

Needs Python and ninja on Windows, macOS or Linux; outside Windows a downloaded wibo wrapper runs the 32-bit Windows compilers, or a user-supplied Wine. configure.py downloads pinned decomp-toolkit, GameCube/Wii binutils, objdiff, sjiswrap and wibo releases plus a Metrowerks CodeWarrior compiler archive hosted by decomp.dev rather than by this repository.

Verification happens per project: the build compares the rebuilt DOL and REL files with the hashes in build.sha1, and objdiff and decomp.dev report per-object matching progress. The template ships no game configuration and makes no matching claims of its own.

Released under CC0-1.0, which the README suggests replacing with the project's own license; downloaded tools keep their own licenses, and the CodeWarrior compilers are proprietary. Reviewed sources state no REA use, and this collection did not run the template.

name: hermes-decomp
description_en: Rust decompiler and analysis toolkit for Hermes bytecode (.hbc), the compiled form React Native apps ship for the Hermes engine; the README lists HBC versions 40 to 99. Its hermes-decomp CLI shows file information, disassembles, decompiles whole bundles or single functions to JavaScript, with a slower deep mode that recovers more names, and provides a terminal UI, cross-references, call graphs, control-flow graphs, Metro module and closure views and bytecode diffing. A separate hermes-mcp server exposes the read and analysis functions as MCP tools, and the hbc-decomp crate offers them as a Rust library.
description_zh: 面向 Hermes 字节码（.hbc）的 Rust 反编译与分析工具包；.hbc 是 React Native 应用为 Hermes 引擎打包的编译格式，README 列出支持 HBC 40 至 99 版本。其 hermes-decomp 命令行可显示文件信息、反汇编，并将整个包或单个函数反编译为 JavaScript，较慢的深度模式还能恢复更多名称；此外提供终端界面、交叉引用、调用图、控制流图、Metro 模块与闭包视图以及字节码差异比较。独立的 hermes-mcp 服务器将读取和分析功能作为 MCP 工具提供，hbc-decomp crate 则以 Rust 库的形式提供这些功能。
requirements: Release at review: v0.2.4, published 2026-10-01, which is the reviewed main commit. Its archives contain hermes-decomp and hermes-mcp for Linux x86_64 and ARM64, macOS ARM64 and Windows x86_64, with SHA256SUMS; the README also lists a macOS x86_64 build, which this release lacks. Source builds need Rust 1.70+, and an update command checks for or installs newer releases.

Input is a Hermes bytecode file from the user's own React Native app, not a plain-JavaScript bundle. Full-bundle decompilation writes an .hdcache file next to the input unless --no-cache is passed. hermes-mcp uses stdio by default; its HTTP transport listens on 127.0.0.1:8744 unless another host is given, and docs/MCP.md lists only read and analysis tools.

Separate CLI write commands assemble or patch bytecode and HASM; they never recompile decompiled JavaScript. USAGE.md reports full write support for HBC 96 and below, verified against the Hermes VM, while HBC 97+ files support only same-length string patches and can be checked only with a macOS helper.

CI checks formatting and Clippy, builds on each platform and runs the test suite with corpus-dependent tests skipped; the repository keeps small jsx_cycle .hbc test fixtures. Local gates compile sample snippets with hermesc toolchains that the scripts fetch or build, run the original and decompiled code under Node and compare output, with five known failures listed, and cap unparsable modules per bundle, at 211 for the one recorded bundle, so decompiled output is not always valid JavaScript.
MIT license. No bytecode was decompiled or patched, and the MCP server was not run.

name: N64ModernRuntime
description_en: Runtime for N64Recomp static recompilations and traditional source ports of N64 games, made of two libraries. ultramodern reimplements core libultra services (threads, message queues, timers, controllers, audio, RSP task handling and VI timing) and leaves controller input, audio playback and the graphics renderer, with RT64 recommended, to callbacks the host project registers. librecomp bridges N64Recomp-generated code to ultramodern and adds overlay handling, PI DMA ROM reads, and EEPROM, SRAM and Flash RAM saves.
description_zh: 供 N64Recomp 静态重编译项目和传统源码移植使用的 N64 游戏运行时，由两个库组成。ultramodern 重新实现 libultra 的核心服务（线程、消息队列、计时器、控制器、音频、RSP 任务处理和 VI 时序），并将手柄输入、音频播放和图形渲染器（推荐 RT64）交给宿主项目注册的回调处理。librecomp 负责将 N64Recomp 生成的代码与 ultramodern 衔接，并补充覆盖段处理、PI DMA 读取 ROM，以及 EEPROM、SRAM 和 Flash RAM 存档。
requirements: No releases or tags at review; the README recommends including the libraries in a project's own CMake build with add_subdirectory. The reviewed main commit (2026-08-30) needs CMake 3.20+ and C++20; the README says it was developed with Clang 15, older Clang versions may not work, and recent MSVC and GCC should work but are not regularly tested. N64Recomp, miniz, xxHash and o1heap are pinned submodules.

The runtime contains no game code: the host project supplies the recompiled code, the renderer and the platform callbacks, and the user supplies the game ROM. The reviewed librecomp source checks a user-selected ROM against a per-game hash and also loads .nrm mod packages; the README does not describe either feature.

The Castlevania 64, Conker's Bad Fur Day, Banjo-Kazooie and Star Fox 64 recompilation cases in this catalog are documented as using it; game compatibility is reported in those entries, not here. The README covers library scope only and has no compatibility list.

GPL-3.0 (COPYING); submodules keep their own licenses. CONTRIBUTING.md states that AI-generated code contributions are not accepted. Nothing was built or run, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: REDscript
description_en: Compiler and decompiler toolkit for REDscript, a statically typed, object-oriented language for writing scripts for REDengine, CD Projekt's engine used in Cyberpunk 2077. Its Rust crates parse and analyze source, generate bytecode with monomorphization of generics, decompile .redscripts bytecode bundles back into REDscript source, read and write REDengine's native binary format, and provide a drop-in replacement for CD Projekt's scc script compiler plus a C API with source mapping. The CLI exposes decompile, compile, lint and format commands; the language server and debugger live in a separate redscript-ide repository.
description_zh: REDscript 的编译器与反编译器工具集。REDscript 是一种静态类型、面向对象的语言，用于为 CD Projekt 在《赛博朋克 2077》中使用的 REDengine 引擎编写脚本。其 Rust crate 负责解析和分析源码、生成字节码并对泛型做单态化、将 .redscripts 字节码包反编译回 REDscript 源码、读写 REDengine 原生二进制格式，并提供可直接替代 CD Projekt scc 脚本编译器的实现，以及带源码映射的 C API。命令行提供 decompile、compile、lint 和 format 命令；语言服务器和调试器位于单独的 redscript-ide 仓库。
requirements: GitHub's latest stable release is v0.5.31 (2025-08-28), with Windows and macOS archives and standalone CLI binaries for Windows and macOS arm64. The default 1.0.x branch declares 1.0.0-preview.22, the newest prerelease (2025-09-07); the reviewed commit (2026-05-27) is 26 commits after that tag, and older lines live on the 0.5.x and 0.6.x branches. Source builds use Cargo with a Rust toolchain that supports the 2024 edition.

Installation targets the user's own Cyberpunk 2077 installation: the Windows archive is extracted into the game directory so scripts compile at game startup, with logs under r6/logs. On native macOS the game does not compile scripts at startup, so the README uses a bundled launch_modded.sh, and downloaded binaries must first be removed from quarantine. The decompiler reads a .redscripts bundle from the user's game, compilation uses one as its base, and the reviewed tree contains no game scripts or bundles.

Language documentation is on the REDmodding community wiki, and editor support for VS Code, neovim, IntelliJ IDEA, Zed and Helix is in the separate redscript-ide repository; neither was reviewed. The README states no supported game patch range, and compatibility with a particular game version is not implied.

MIT. This entry covers single-player script modding and analysis of the user's own game installation; the game's license terms are separate. No scripts were compiled or decompiled, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: Kong
description_en: Command-line pipeline that runs Ghidra in-process through PyGhidra and asks Claude, OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible models to name the functions, types and parameters of a stripped binary, working bottom-up through the call graph so callers see already-named callees. It matches known library and cryptographic signatures first, sends functions whose decompilation looks obfuscated through a tool-using deobfuscation pass with z3-based simplification, applies results to the Ghidra program and exports annotated C and an analysis.json file. Its README calls it the first agentic reverse engineer; that label and its accuracy and cost figures are the author’s claims.
description_zh: 命令行分析流水线，通过 PyGhidra 在进程内运行 Ghidra，请 Claude、OpenAI 或兼容 OpenAI 接口的模型为去符号二进制文件中的函数、类型和参数命名，并沿调用图自底向上处理，使调用者能看到已命名的被调函数。它先匹配已知库函数与密码算法特征，再把反编译结果疑似混淆的函数交给可调用工具、借助 z3 化简的去混淆环节，将结果应用到 Ghidra 程序中，并导出带注释的 C 代码和 analysis.json 文件。README 称其为首个智能体逆向工程师，这一说法以及其中的准确性和成本数据均为作者陈述。
requirements: The reviewed main commit is 25 commits after the v0.2.2 release of 2026-03-18, which matches kong-re 0.2.2 on PyPI; those later commits add an unreleased Rust kong-ml crate and XDA model-training scripts that the README does not describe. Kong needs Python 3.11+ with uv, a local Ghidra installation and JDK 21+, which it detects or reads from GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR and JAVA_HOME. Its commands are kong setup, analyze, info and eval, with a Textual interface or --headless output.

Analysis needs an Anthropic or OpenAI API key, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint passed with --base-url, and sends each function’s decompilation with its cross-references, strings and neighbouring signatures to that service; Kong tracks token use and estimated cost per model. Users supply the binary to analyse, and the repository ships no target binaries.

The README rates its confidence by architecture and source language: high for C and C++ on x86, x86-64, ARM and AArch64, medium or low for Go, Rust, MIPS and PowerPC, and lower as binaries grow. Obfuscation is detected by patterns in the decompiled text before the deobfuscation pass. BENCHMARKS.md reports a single run with claude-opus-4-6 on a stripped liblzma.so.5.4.1 from the backdoored XZ Utils 5.6.1 (CVE-2024-3094): 355 of 396 queued functions analysed in 15 minutes for $6.63, with the five core implant functions found at model-reported confidence of 90–95%. These are author results, not reproduced here.

The kong eval command scores analysis.json against ground-truth source, using word-based Jaccard matching for names and signature-component scoring for types; no evaluation results are published. CI runs the pytest suite on Python 3.11 to 3.14 for pull requests. This collection reviewed source and documentation without running Kong, Ghidra or any model.

Apache-2.0 per LICENSE and pyproject.toml; Ghidra, model services and analysed binaries keep their own terms. The README names KeygraphHQ’s Shannon web-pentesting pipeline as its inspiration. The reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: Spice86
description_en: PC emulator for executing, reverse engineering and rewriting real-mode DOS programs whose source code is unavailable. While a program runs it builds a control-flow graph, and on exit it dumps memory, execution flow, Ghidra-compatible symbols and a self-contained, runnable C# project whose generated functions override the original assembly, so analysts can rewrite them function by function into readable code while the program keeps working. It also provides a GDB remote server with custom analysis commands, a built-in debugger with a C-header structure viewer, an optional HTTP memory API and an MCP server whose tools cover CPU, memory, breakpoints, CFG and device state; an optional Ghidra plugin imports the dumps.
description_zh: 用于执行、逆向分析并重写无源码实模式 DOS 程序的 PC 模拟器。程序运行时它会构建控制流图，退出时转储内存、执行流、Ghidra 兼容的符号，以及一个可独立运行的 C# 项目，其中生成的函数会覆盖原有汇编代码，分析者可以在程序始终可运行的前提下逐个函数将其改写为可读代码。它还提供带自定义分析命令的 GDB 远程服务器、配有 C 头文件结构查看器的内置调试器、可选的 HTTP 内存 API，以及工具覆盖 CPU、内存、断点、控制流图和设备状态的 MCP 服务器；可选的 Ghidra 插件可导入这些转储。
requirements: Releases are published on NuGet (16.1.0 at review, published 2026-08-05); the GitHub release tagged latest is a rolling development prerelease built from master with debug and release archives. The reviewed master commit (2026-10-13) declares 16.1.0. The project is a C# port and continuation of the original Java Spice86. Running and building need .NET 10 on Windows, macOS or Linux; source builds use dotnet build.

The README lists 8086/8088 as fully implemented, with partial 80186, 80286 and 80386 support (no protected mode or paging, and no FPU beyond detection); 1 MB segmented memory with EMS, XMS and HMA; text, CGA, EGA, VGA and VESA VBE 1.2 graphics, with CGA and EGA best effort; a largely complete DOS 5.0 INT 21h; and Sound Blaster, OPL and Adlib Gold audio ported from DOSBox Staging, with MT-32 partial and unavailable on macOS. COMPATIBILITY.md says many programs do not run and lists tested games individually.

The analyst supplies the DOS program and its files; the emulated C: drive defaults to the program folder. Dumps go to a subfolder named by the program's SHA-256 hash, and the generated project passes the expected checksum so overrides cannot run against a different binary. The GDB server starts by default on port 10000, and the MCP HTTP server is documented as enabled by default on port 8081. The Ghidra plugin is a separate repository that needs Java 17. The README suggests LLM assistance for rewriting generated functions and points to the project's Cryogenic rewrite of Cryo's Dune as a worked example.

Apache-2.0; NOTICE credits the Aeon project, the README credits DOSBox Staging for ported sound code and as the model for CD and floppy emulation, and a prebuilt FastExpressionCompiler DLL is vendored in 3rdparty. Test resources are small DOS test programs, most with assembly sources in the repository. No program was emulated or rewritten here, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: PS2 Web Recomp
description_en: Statically recompiles PlayStation 2 games for the browser: eerecomp translates the Emotion Engine code of a game's boot executable into C++ that is compiled to WebAssembly, and a runtime emulates the rest of the console, including a high-level EE kernel, an interpreted I/O processor running the disc's IRX modules, the vector units, SPU2 sound and the Graphics Synthesizer on WebGPU compute shaders. Its port script repeats headless runs to find functions reached through pointers and vector-unit microprograms to compile ahead of time, then builds the web page and a native runner.
description_zh: 将 PlayStation 2 游戏静态重编译后在浏览器中运行：eerecomp 把游戏启动程序中的 Emotion Engine 代码转换为 C++，再编译为 WebAssembly；运行时负责仿真主机的其余部分，包括高层仿真的 EE 内核、以解释器运行光盘 IRX 模块的 I/O 处理器、向量单元、SPU2 音频，以及基于 WebGPU 计算着色器的 Graphics Synthesizer。其移植脚本会反复进行无界面运行，找出经指针调用的函数和需要预先编译的向量单元微程序，最后构建网页和原生运行程序。
requirements: The README reports two titles brought up so far: the PAL Gran Turismo 4, playable from boot through races at full speed in Chrome, and God of War II from its menus into combat, which needed no game-specific code but exposed a recompiler bug and a vector-unit timing bug. It warns that another game will most likely stop at an unimplemented system call, IOP library function or GS feature, and that vector-unit results can differ from the console's in the last bit.

Users bring a disc image of a game they own; the repository contains no game code or data. The README states that the generated C++ and the built WebAssembly are translations of the game's executable that belong to its owners, asks users to keep them on their own machine and not publish them, and warns that anyone who can reach the local server can load the game.

Porting needs Git, CMake 3.20+, Ninja, a C++20 compiler (Clang preferred), Python 3 and 7-Zip for .7z images; the first run installs the Emscripten SDK and downloads wgpu-native, and the native window needs SDL2. Everything has been run on x86-64 Linux, and the scripts also build on Apple-silicon macOS; expect about 300 MB of disk per game. The page needs WebGPU, which Linux Chrome enables only behind flags (the software renderer fallback is too slow for 3D), plus cross-origin isolation headers and HTTP Range support.

There is no release, tag or CI workflow. scripts/test_vu_codegen.py exercises native and WebAssembly vector-unit code generation without a game disc, and a software GS rasterizer is kept as the reference for the GPU output. Frame rates are the author's measurements on one laptop. Last commit at review: 2026-10-19.

MIT-licensed; the MPEG decoder's VLC tables adapted from Play! keep its BSD 2-clause notice, and the README names PCSX2, Play! and the ps2sdk headers as behavior references. It states no affiliation with Sony or the games' publishers. This collection did not build or run it, and no game compatibility is implied.

name: shuji
description_en: Command-line tool that writes the original JavaScript and CSS sources embedded in source maps back out as files. It reads .map files, or JavaScript and CSS files whose sourceMappingURL holds an inline Base64 or URL-encoded map or points to a map in the same folder, and can walk directories with a regular-expression filter. Output is flattened to file names by default, or keeps the map's folder structure with --preserve.
description_zh: 命令行工具，可把源映射（source map）中内嵌的原始 JavaScript 和 CSS 源码重新写出为文件。它能读取 .map 文件，也能读取 sourceMappingURL 中内联了 Base64 或 URL 编码映射、或指向同一目录下映射文件的 JavaScript 和 CSS 文件，并可按正则表达式筛选、递归遍历目录。默认只按文件名平铺输出，使用 --preserve 则保留映射中的目录结构。
requirements: npm release at review: shuji 0.8.0, published 2023-12-04, which requires Node.js 14.15.0+; the repository publishes tags but no GitHub releases. The reviewed main commit is 139 commits ahead and unreleased: it raises the minimum to Node.js 24.12.0, which the README already states, moves linting to Oxlint and, since 2026-10-11, rejects output paths that would escape the output directory.

Install the CLI globally with npm and run it on a file or directory with -o for the output directory; the default filter only picks .map files, so -M is needed to scan .js or .css files for inline maps. Maps are read from local files only: a referenced map must sit relative to the code file, and remote maps are not fetched.

Only sources whose content is embedded in the map's sourcesContent are written; entries that list a path without content are skipped, so maps built without included sources yield nothing for them. Existing files are never overwritten, so flattened sources with the same file name are skipped unless --preserve is used.
MIT. Recovered files remain the original authors' code under their own terms, so analyze only source maps you may inspect. No source maps were processed for this entry.

name: xboxrecomp
description_en: Static-recompilation toolkit for original Xbox games: a Python pipeline parses a retail XBE, disassembles it, classifies library functions, recovers calling conventions and lifts every x86 function to C. The generated code is compiled in a separate game project that links the toolkit's runtime libraries, which stand in for the Xbox kernel and translate Direct3D 8, NV2A, audio and input to Direct3D 11 and Win32 APIs, or to SDL2 and OpenGL on Linux and macOS.
description_zh: 面向初代 Xbox 游戏的静态重编译工具包：Python 流水线解析零售版 XBE，进行反汇编、识别库函数、恢复调用约定，并将每个 x86 函数提升为 C 代码。生成的代码在独立的游戏项目中编译，并链接工具包的运行时库；这些库替代 Xbox 内核，并将 Direct3D 8、NV2A、音频和输入转换到 Direct3D 11 与 Win32 API，在 Linux 和 macOS 上则转换到 SDL2 与 OpenGL。
requirements: The README for v0.14.0 (2026-10-16, the reviewed commit) calls the toolkit title-agnostic but built against Burnout 3: Takedown, and says a first run of a recompiled game will crash and needs iterative stubbing, indirect-call fixes and runtime work for each title. The author's own ports are early: the README retires an earlier playable claim for Burnout 3, whose recompiled path reaches engine initialization, and lists Wreckless and Blood Wake as booting or scaffolded. The curated The Two Towers Recompiled and DOAXVB cases build on vendored or forked copies.

Users supply default.xbe and the game's data files from their own original Xbox disc image. The repository contains no game code or assets and builds only libraries, never a game executable; the generated C, often millions of lines, is written into the user's own game project created from the bundled template.

The pipeline needs Python 3.10+ with Capstone (pytest for tests); Ghidra or IDA are optional and only recover symbol names. The runtime builds with CMake 3.20+ and Visual Studio 2022 or MinGW-w64 on Windows (D3D11, XInput, XAudio2, Media Foundation), or Clang/GCC with SDL2, libepoxy and pkg-config on x86-64 and arm64 Linux and macOS, where FMV decoding is not available. The v0.14.0 release has no binary assets.

Unit tests need no game files, and several compile the lifter's output and check it against x86 definitions with paired negative controls; the README gives 812 passed and 0 skipped as a clean run. A conformance suite runs lifted C and the original instructions on a real 32-bit x86 CPU over the same inputs, with Docker images supplying GCC and MSVC under Wine on Linux and macOS. The README calls lifter coverage good but unquantified, and the repository has no CI workflow.

MIT-licensed, except the MCPX APU sources and NV2A register definitions extracted from xemu, which stay LGPL-2.1-or-later as listed in NOTICE. The README credits Claude Code for AI-assisted development and states no REA use. This collection did not build or run the toolkit, and no game compatibility is implied.

name: PCSX-Redux
description_en: PlayStation 1 emulator forked from PCSX and built around development and reverse engineering, with an interpreter and dynamic recompiler, software and OpenGL renderers, a MIPS debugger, VRAM viewer, SPU and GPU debugging tools, and a built-in GDB server that its documentation connects to gdb, IDA Pro and Ghidra's debugger. A LuaJIT API exposes breakpoints, memory and registers, an assembler and an ISO builder, and an optional REST web server can dump RAM and VRAM. The repository also holds the OpenBIOS replacement BIOS, PS-EXE conversion and packing tools, a Psy-Q object-file converter, Ghidra scripts for exchanging symbols and overlays with the emulator, and PS1 hardware designs.
description_zh: 基于 PCSX 分支、面向开发与逆向工程的 PlayStation 1 模拟器，提供解释器与动态重编译器、软件和 OpenGL 渲染器、MIPS 调试器、显存查看器、SPU 与 GPU 调试工具，以及内置 GDB 服务器；其文档说明了如何用 gdb、IDA Pro 和 Ghidra 调试器连接它。LuaJIT API 提供断点、内存与寄存器、汇编器和 ISO 构建器等接口，可选的 REST Web 服务器还能转储内存和显存。仓库另含替代 BIOS OpenBIOS、PS-EXE 转换与打包工具、Psy-Q 目标文件转换器、用于与模拟器交换符号和覆盖段的 Ghidra 脚本，以及 PS1 硬件设计。
requirements: No tagged GitHub releases at review: the README links rolling development builds for Windows x64 (GUI and CLI), Linux x64 and arm64 AppImages and macOS Arm, and says the codebase is still experimental and has not reached its first stable release. Builds are 64-bit only and need a GPU and driver that can create at least an OpenGL 3.0 context; the macOS build is unsigned. The reviewed main commit is from 2026-10-19.

Source builds need a recursive clone: Visual Studio 2022 with NuGet on Windows; Docker for the AppImage, or make with clang and packages such as Capstone, FFmpeg, libuv, SDL3 and curl, on Linux; macOS Catalina or later with Xcode and Homebrew packages. OpenBIOS and other PS1 code need a mipsel-none-elf GCC toolchain, for which the repository provides install scripts.

Game discs and executables come from the user. The README presents OpenBIOS, built separately, as an alternative to the copyrighted retail BIOS, and the reviewed trees contain no retail BIOS, Psy-Q libraries or game files. The docs say most CPU debugging features need the dynarec disabled and the debugger enabled, and Ghidra debugging needs gdb-multiarch and Ghidra 10.3+. When enabled, the web server listens on port 8080 on all network interfaces by default, which the docs note makes it reachable from other machines.

GPL-2.0 for PCSX-Redux; OpenBIOS lives in the MIT-licensed nugget submodule, and LICENSES.md lists third-party libraries with their own licenses, some vendored with modifications. Hardware designs and wiki research were not reviewed. No emulator, game or debugging session was run, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection or use by a specific decompilation project.

name: Obfuscator.io Deobfuscator
description_en: Deobfuscator dedicated to JavaScript produced by Obfuscator.io (javascript-obfuscator), which its README says also handles most forks. Working statically on a Babel AST, it reveals strings hidden in rotated, Base64- or RC4-encoded string arrays, inlines proxy functions, simplifies objects, arithmetic and string concatenation, removes dead code and the obfuscator's anti-tamper wrappers, and reverses control-flow flattening. Its configuration is detected automatically, and the author also hosts an online version.
description_zh: 专门处理 Obfuscator.io（javascript-obfuscator）所生成 JavaScript 的反混淆工具，README 称也能处理其大部分分支版本。它在 Babel AST 上进行静态处理，可还原隐藏在经过轮转、Base64 或 RC4 编码的字符串数组中的字符串，内联代理函数，化简对象、算术表达式和字符串拼接，删除死代码和混淆器的防篡改包装代码，并还原控制流平坦化。配置会自动检测，作者另提供在线版本。
requirements: npm release at review: obfuscator-io-deobfuscator 1.0.6, published 2025-03-27. The reviewed main commit, merged 2026-08-09, adds unreleased improvements to string-array wrapper identification and README notes on running the CLI from source; package.json still reports 1.0.6. No GitHub releases are published.

Install the global obfuscator-io-deobfuscator CLI, which takes an input file and an optional output path, or build it from source with npm and TypeScript. It applies its Babel-based transformations repeatedly, for at most 50 passes; package.json declares no Node.js version range. An online version runs at obf-io.deobfuscate.io; only the repository was reviewed.

Input must be JavaScript produced by Obfuscator.io or a compatible fork; other obfuscators are out of scope, and the author's general-purpose javascript-deobfuscator covers generic patterns. The README states that it does not run untrusted code or use a sandbox; recovered strings and control flow still need checking against the original script.
The LICENSE file is Apache-2.0, while package.json and the npm metadata declare ISC. No scripts were deobfuscated for this entry.

name: decomp2dbg
description_en: Decompiler-to-debugger bridge that serves function names, global variables, stack and register variable names and decompiled code from IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, Ghidra or angr-management to GDB over an XML-RPC connection. Synced functions and globals become ordinary GDB symbols for breakpoints and memory examination, local variables appear as convenience variables, and each breakpoint stop prints the decompiled line for the current address. It works with vanilla GDB, GEF and pwndbg, and can map a shared library's symbols once its load range is supplied.
description_zh: 连通反编译器与调试器的桥接工具：通过 XML-RPC 连接，把 IDA Pro、Binary Ninja、Ghidra 或 angr-management 中的函数名、全局变量、栈变量与寄存器变量名以及反编译代码提供给 GDB。同步过来的函数和全局变量成为普通的 GDB 符号，可直接下断点和查看内存；局部变量以便利变量的形式出现，每次在断点处停下时还会打印当前地址对应的反编译代码行。它支持原生 GDB、GEF 和 pwndbg；提供共享库的加载地址范围后，也能为该库映射符号。
requirements: Release at review: v4.0.3, published 2026-07-14 on GitHub and PyPI; the reviewed main commit is that version bump. Package metadata requires Python 3.10+, and the README says decomp2dbg must be installed in the same Python environment as the decompiler and the debugger. The bundled installer places the decompiler plugin and sources the GDB client from the user's .gdbinit, after GEF or pwndbg are loaded; a Windows decompiler outside WSL needs the README's manual steps.

The README lists IDA Pro 9.0+, Binary Ninja 2.4+, Ghidra 12+ (started in PyGhidra mode with the plugin enabled) and angr-management 9.0+, each installed separately; decompiler access goes through the declib library. Only GDB-based debuggers are supported: LLDB and WinDbg support, struct syncing, function-type syncing and online DWARF creation are listed as unfinished.

The decompiler side starts an XML-RPC server on localhost:3662 by default; debugging from another machine or VM needs the host and port at connect time and the port reachable. One decompiler can be connected at a time, and a shared library's symbols need its base and end addresses supplied manually.

tests.py holds integration tests that drive headless Ghidra, or IDA through idalib, with GDB; CI runs only the Ghidra suites against Ghidra 12.0. The testing/binaries directory keeps sample executables, including an Ubuntu objdump build, as test fixtures. BSD-2-Clause license. No debugging sessions were run.

name: javascript-deobfuscator
description_en: General-purpose JavaScript deobfuscator for common obfuscation patterns, published on npm as js-deobfuscator and usable as a library or CLI. It unpacks arrays of literals and replaces references to them, removes simple, array and arithmetic proxy functions, simplifies arithmetic and string concatenation, removes dead branches, turns computed member access into static properties, renames hexadecimal identifiers such as _0xca830a and beautifies the result. The author also hosts an online version and maintains a separate deobfuscator for Obfuscator.io output.
description_zh: 通用的 JavaScript 反混淆工具，针对常见混淆手法，以 js-deobfuscator 之名发布在 npm 上，可作为库或命令行工具使用。它能展开字面量数组并替换对其的引用，移除简单代理函数、数组代理函数和算术代理函数，化简算术表达式和字符串拼接，删除死分支，把计算属性访问转为静态属性，重命名 _0xca830a 这类十六进制标识符，并美化输出代码。作者另提供在线版本，并单独维护一个针对 Obfuscator.io 输出的反混淆工具。
requirements: npm release at review: js-deobfuscator 1.1.7, published 2025-07-15; the reviewed main commit is that version bump. No GitHub releases are published. The TypeScript package parses and regenerates code with the Shift parser and the author's shift-codegen fork; package.json declares no Node.js version range.

Install it locally to import as a module, or globally for the js-deobfuscator CLI, which reads an input file and writes an output file, with -m for ES modules. The library config toggles each transformation. An online version runs at deobfuscate.io; only the repository was reviewed.

Supply the JavaScript to analyze yourself. It handles the generic patterns listed in the README; for Obfuscator.io output the README points to the author's dedicated deobfuscator. Hexadecimal identifiers are replaced with names drawn from a bundled word list, not recovered originals, so output still needs analyst review.
The LICENSE file is Apache-2.0, while package.json and the npm metadata declare ISC. No scripts were deobfuscated for this entry.

name: Il2CppInspector
description_en: Static analysis tool for Unity IL2CPP applications that reads an IL2CPP binary with its global-metadata.dat and outputs the application's type structure and method addresses as C# stub code, .NET assembly shim DLLs for decompilers such as ILSpy and dnSpy, IDA and Ghidra Python scripts that apply symbols and types, C++ type scaffolding and JSON address maps. Three APIs, also published as a NuGet package, and a plugin SDK expose the binary metadata, .NET type model and C++ model for custom analysis. The README states that it is not a decompiler and does not recover method source code.
description_zh: 面向 Unity IL2CPP 应用的静态分析工具：读取 IL2CPP 二进制及其 global-metadata.dat，将应用的类型结构和方法地址输出为 C# 存根代码、供 ILSpy 和 dnSpy 等反编译器使用的 .NET 程序集垫片 DLL、为 IDA 和 Ghidra 套用符号与类型的 Python 脚本、C++ 类型脚手架以及 JSON 地址映射。三套 API（另以 NuGet 包发布）和插件 SDK 开放二进制元数据、.NET 类型模型和 C++ 模型，供自定义分析使用。README 说明它不是反编译器，不会还原方法源码。
requirements: The README announces that development is suspended for the foreseeable future and that the author will not respond to issues or pull requests. The reviewed master commit, which added that notice, dates from 2021-11-23, 16 commits after the last release, 2021.1 (2021-01-31). The README recommends Cpp2IL instead; Cpp2IL and Il2CppDumper, whose entry documents Unity support up to 2022.2, are separate catalog entries. This entry lists Il2CppInspector for its documented outputs and APIs, not as a maintained tool.

Its version table marks Unity 5.3.0 through 2020.3.x (IL2CPP 16 to 27.1) as working and 2021.1 (27.2) as partial; later Unity versions are not covered. Documented inputs are ELF, PE, Mach-O, Universal Binary and PS4 FSELF images, 32- and 64-bit, for ARMv7, Thumb-2, ARMv8, x86 and x64, plus APK, AAB, XAPK, Zip and decrypted IPA packages.

The analyst supplies the IL2CPP binary and its matching global-metadata.dat; IPA executables must already be decrypted, and the README says packed, encrypted or obfuscated IL2CPP files are not its intended input. It warns that loading a packed PE file runs the DLL's entry point and initialization code, so untrusted DLLs should not be loaded and the tool should never run as administrator.

Builds use dotnet publish from a recursive clone and target .NET Core 3.1; the CLI builds for Windows, macOS and Linux, while the WPF GUI is Windows-only, and plugins are fetched separately with the get-plugins scripts. AGPL-3.0; the Bin2Object submodule and libraries such as dnlib and CxxDemangler keep their own licenses. Obfuscation-specific loader plugins and DLL-injection project output are outside this entry's analysis scope. No binary was analyzed, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: whatsapp-web-reveng: documenting the legacy WhatsApp Web protocol
description_en: Documents and reimplements the WebSocket protocol WhatsApp Web used while browser sessions mirrored a paired phone: QR pairing, Curve25519/HKDF key setup, AES/HMAC-protected binary messages, the token-based node encoding and end-to-end media encryption. A Python backend, Node.js relay and browser front end decode a logged-in session’s messages into inspectable JSON, and the README lists independent reimplementations such as Baileys and go-whatsapp. This is an older protocol generation from before WhatsApp’s 2021 multi-device architecture, not a description of current WhatsApp Web.
description_zh: 记录并重新实现 WhatsApp Web 在浏览器会话镜像已配对手机时期使用的 WebSocket 协议：二维码配对、Curve25519/HKDF 密钥建立、经 AES/HMAC 保护的二进制报文、基于字符串令牌表的节点编码，以及端到端媒体加密。Python 后端、Node.js 中继和浏览器前端把已登录会话的报文解码成可查看的 JSON，README 还列出了 Baileys、go-whatsapp 等独立再实现。这是 WhatsApp 2021 年多设备架构之前的旧一代协议，不能当作对当前 WhatsApp Web 的描述。
requirements: Reviewed at the 2024-04-22 master head, a README-only change; the backend and Node relay last changed in August 2021, the protobuf schema in March 2020, and there are no releases or tags. The README’s pairing flow has the phone supply session details such as its battery level, the phone-mirroring companion model that WhatsApp’s July 2021 engineering post says multi-device replaces. A 2022 issue reports the server answering a QR scan with an upgrade_md_prod command; whether the flow still connects was not tested. As checked on 2026-10-20, the 2024-04-22 head is still GitHub’s last recorded push, the repository is not archived and the README does not mark it as maintained, superseded or archived.

Use needs the user’s own WhatsApp account and phone to scan the pairing code, and the backend connects to WhatsApp’s servers. The protobuf definitions come from a helper script that parses the public WhatsApp Web JavaScript bundle. The README’s task list still names growing binary-decoding errors, writing binary messages and a less technical interface as open work.

Bare-metal setup needs Node.js 8+ and Python 2.7 with websocket-client, simple-websocket-server, curve25519-donna, pycrypto (pycryptodome in requirements.txt), pyqrcode and protobuf; Windows also needs Visual C++ for Python 9.0 and a supplied header. A shell.nix (Python 2.7, Node.js 13) and a Dockerfile are provided, and npm start runs the backend, Node API and front end together. The README says the Docker version is not stable enough for production.

There is no test suite: the package.json test script only starts the components. The documented correctness checks are HMAC validation of the server’s key data and of each binary message, and an in-browser JavaScript demo prints decrypted messages after a QR scan. This source review opened no session and decoded no traffic.

MIT (LICENSE, package.json). The README states the project is unaffiliated with and not endorsed by WhatsApp, that use is at the user’s own risk, and adds a cryptography export notice; WhatsApp’s services and terms apply separately. The reviewed sources establish no AI or REA use.

name: E9Patch
description_en: Static binary rewriter for x86-64 Linux ELF executables and shared objects that inserts instrumentation without control-flow recovery and writes a drop-in replacement binary, following the PLDI 2020 paper Binary Rewriting without Control Flow Recovery. The e9tool front end selects instructions with a matching language over disassembly attributes and patches them with built-in trampolines, calls into C or C++ functions compiled with e9compile.sh, or hand-written plugin trampolines; the e9patch back end accepts JSON-RPC commands so other tools can drive it. Optional modes add heuristic control-flow recovery for faster rewritten binaries or SIGILL-based fallbacks for full patch coverage.
description_zh: 面向 x86-64 Linux ELF 可执行文件和共享库的静态二进制重写工具，无需恢复控制流即可插入插桩代码，并生成可直接替换原文件的二进制，方法源自 PLDI 2020 论文 Binary Rewriting without Control Flow Recovery。前端 e9tool 用一套基于反汇编属性的匹配语言选择指令，再通过内置跳板、调用以 e9compile.sh 编译的 C/C++ 函数或手写的插件跳板进行修补；后端 e9patch 接收 JSON-RPC 命令，便于其他工具调用。可选模式包括借助启发式控制流恢复获得更快的重写结果，或借助 SIGILL 回退实现完全的修补覆盖。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.0.1, published 2026-06-22, with an amd64 Debian package; earlier 1.0.0 release candidates ran through rc10 (2025-04-16) before v1.0.0 on 2026-03-01. The reviewed master commit (2026-06-28) is one commit ahead of v1.0.1, fixing undefined behavior on empty trampoline template entries, and its VERSION file reads 1.0.1.

build.sh builds e9patch and e9tool after checking for gcc, g++, make, binutils, xxd, markdown and zlib headers, and suggests Debian/Ubuntu package names; Zydis and libdw are vendored under contrib. Patch functions are compiled with e9compile.sh using gcc and freestanding flags. The README targets x86_64 Linux; the source also contains PE handling and a Windows example that calls itself a proof of concept, which the guides do not document.

Input is the user's own ELF executable or shared object, and output is written to a.out or a.so by default. The guide notes that the built-in linear disassembler can mishandle binaries that mix code and data and accepts --use-disasm and --use-targets CSV files from other analyzers. The CFR mode is heuristic and less robust, and in the -100 mode a rewritten program's own attempts to install a SIGILL handler fail with ENOSYS.

GPL-3.0, with specific files such as examples/stdlib.c under MIT as stated in their preambles. The README's scalability, speed and overhead claims, including rewriting web browsers over 100 MB, were not tested, and the downstream projects it lists were not reviewed. No binaries were rewritten.

name: MelonLoader
description_en: Mod loader for Unity games on both the Mono and IL2CPP runtimes, which loads plugins and mods from folders in a locally installed game; on Windows a proxy DLL, version.dll by default, starts it with the game. For IL2CPP games its assembly generator runs Cpp2IL and Il2CppInterop to produce managed interop assemblies, and HarmonyX and MonoMod are bundled for runtime patching. Its logs can capture Unity player output and Harmony messages, and debug options provide a Mono debug server for Mono games and a wait-for-debugger option for IL2CPP games.
description_zh: 面向 Mono 和 IL2CPP 两种运行时 Unity 游戏的模组加载器，从本地安装游戏目录中的文件夹加载插件和模组；在 Windows 上通过代理 DLL（默认为 version.dll）随游戏一同启动。对于 IL2CPP 游戏，其程序集生成器会调用 Cpp2IL 和 Il2CppInterop 生成托管互操作程序集，并随附 HarmonyX 与 MonoMod 用于运行时修补。其日志可捕获 Unity 播放器输出与 Harmony 消息，调试选项还为 Mono 游戏提供 Mono 调试服务器，为 IL2CPP 游戏提供等待调试器附加的选项。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.7.3, published 2026-05-14, with Windows x64/x86, Linux x64 and macOS x64 archives plus Windows, Linux and macOS installers; the README also links nightly builds. The reviewed master commit (2026-10-01) declares the unreleased 0.7.4, 69 commits after v0.7.3, and its pending release notes add macOS arm64 support. The README links Linux instructions for Wine, Proton and native games, and marks Android and Oculus Quest support as work in progress.

The README lists the .NET 6.0 Desktop Runtime as a requirement for IL2CPP games, installed automatically on Windows. The installer or a manual install places MelonLoader and its proxy DLL in the user's own game folder, where the Plugins, Mods, logs and UserData/Loader.cfg configuration are created; some games need one of the alternative proxy file names. Source builds use the dotnet SDK, and the projects target Mono, Mono bleeding-edge and .NET frameworks.

On IL2CPP games the assembly generator queries MelonLoader's remote API by game name for settings such as a Cpp2IL version, obfuscation regex or deobfuscation mapping, and the README lists Cpp2IL, Unity runtime libraries and the .NET runtime as downloaded at run time. Configuration and launch options can force offline generation, a dumper version or regeneration. Per-game compatibility is not implied.

Apache-2.0; bundled libraries such as Dobby, plthook, HarmonyX, MonoMod, Mono.Cecil, AsmResolver and Il2CppInterop (LGPL-3.0) keep their own licenses, and the README says the downloaded Unity runtime libraries are subject to Unity's terms of service. This entry covers single-player modding and analysis of locally installed games; game license terms are separate. No game was modded or run, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: Rellic
description_en: Trail of Bits implementation of the pattern-independent structuring algorithm from the No More Gotos paper, turning LLVM bitcode into goto-free C as a small, hackable decompiler back end that interoperates with LLVM and Remill. rellic-decomp translates a bitcode module to C in batch, rellic-xref serves a web interface for choosing refinement passes and linking C AST nodes to the bitcode that produced them, and rellic-headergen emits C layouts of data structures from a module's DWARF metadata. Machine code must first be lifted to bitcode by another tool; a bundled IDA script uses Anvill for that step.
description_zh: Trail of Bits 对 No More Gotos 论文中模式无关结构化算法的实现，可把 LLVM bitcode 转换为不含 goto 的 C 代码，定位为小巧、易于修改且能与 LLVM 和 Remill 互操作的反编译器后端。rellic-decomp 批量将 bitcode 模块转换为 C；rellic-xref 提供 Web 界面，可选择要应用的细化遍，并将 C AST 节点与生成它的 bitcode 相互对应；rellic-headergen 根据模块中的 DWARF 元数据生成描述数据结构布局的 C 代码。机器码须先由其他工具提升为 bitcode；仓库附带的 IDA 脚本借助 Anvill 完成这一步。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.2.3, published 2023-04-04, with LLVM 15 builds: deb and tgz packages for Ubuntu 20.04 and a tgz package for macOS 11. The reviewed master commit (2025-11-03) is 13 commits ahead and comments out the AnghaBench CI cron jobs; the code commits before it date from April 2024. This entry pins it for documentation only.

The README supports Linux, tested on Ubuntu 22.04, and also documents a macOS build. Building needs CMake 3.21+, LLVM and Clang 16, Z3 4.7.1+, gflags and glog, most of which come from Trail of Bits' prebuilt cxx-common packages; scripts/build.sh downloads the rest and produces a deb package. Docker images on Docker Hub and the GitHub Package Registry are parameterized by Ubuntu and LLVM version.

Input is an LLVM bitcode module built with the same LLVM version as the decompiler. C sources can be compiled with clang -emit-llvm, but executables need a separate lifter such as Remill or Anvill. The README's examples show output whose control flow and variable types differ from the original source, and its AnghaBench 1,000-program test only checks that bitcode translates to C, not the readability or behavior of the result.

Apache-2.0 license. The roundtrip tests compile C to IR and back and check that the result builds and behaves roughly like the original; they were not run, and nothing was decompiled. By default rellic-xref listens on all addresses, on port 80.

name: ghidra-delinker-extension
description_en: Ghidra extension that delinks a selected part of a program back into a relocatable object file. Its relocation table synthesizer analyzer reconstructs, from the Ghidra database, the relocations a linker normally discards, and its exporters write COFF (x86, x86-64), ELF (x86, x86-64, MIPS) or OMF (x86) objects with symbols and relocation tables that a toolchain can link again. The README lists binary patching through the linker, software ports, format conversion, library extraction and decompilation projects that reimplement a program one object file at a time among its uses.
description_zh: Ghidra 扩展，可把程序中选定的部分“反链接”回可重定位目标文件。其重定位表合成分析器根据 Ghidra 数据库重建链接器通常会丢弃的重定位信息，导出器则写出带符号表和重定位表、可由工具链重新链接的 COFF（x86、x86-64）、ELF（x86、x86-64、MIPS）或 OMF（x86）目标文件。README 列出的用途包括借助链接器打二进制补丁、软件移植、格式转换、提取库，以及逐个目标文件重新实现程序的反编译项目。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.9.2, published 2026-09-26 at the reviewed commit, with separate extension archives for Ghidra 12.0.4, 12.1, 12.1.2, 12.1.3 and 12.1.4; use the archive built for the installed Ghidra release. CI builds with JDK 21.

Source builds need GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR and Gradle. Dependencies come from GitHub's Maven registry, which requires a token with read:packages, or from vendored submodules through gradle installStandaloneDeps. After installation, RelocationTableSynthesizedPlugin is enabled from Ghidra's Experimental plugin list; a bundled DelinkProgram script covers headless use.

Input is a program already loaded and analyzed in Ghidra. The README warns that synthesized relocations depend on the accuracy of the Ghidra database, so incorrect or missing information can break or miss relocations, and advises rerunning the analyzer right before each export. Only the listed format and architecture combinations are supported.

Apache-2.0. The test references are built from C sources in the repository. The README's examples link the author's blog series, including one on decompiling the PlayStation game Tenchu: Stealth Assassins; those projects are not covered by this entry. No programs were exported.

name: BepInEx
description_en: Plugin and patching framework for Unity Mono, Unity IL2CPP and .NET Framework games such as XNA, FNA and MonoGame titles, which loads mods and analysis plugins into a locally installed game.
