Plugins patch methods at runtime with the bundled HarmonyX and MonoMod.RuntimeDetour, while preloader patchers rewrite managed assemblies with Mono.Cecil before the game loads them; on IL2CPP games it runs Cpp2IL and Il2CppInterop to generate interop assemblies from the game binary and global-metadata.dat. Its guides also cover configuration, logging, and debugging plugins and game assemblies with dnSpy.
description_zh: 面向 Unity Mono、Unity IL2CPP 以及 XNA、FNA、MonoGame 等 .NET Framework 游戏的插件与修补框架，可将模组和分析插件加载到本地安装的游戏中。插件借助随附的 HarmonyX 和 MonoMod.RuntimeDetour 在运行时修补方法，预加载修补器则在游戏加载托管程序集之前用 Mono.Cecil 改写它们；在 IL2CPP 游戏上，它会调用 Cpp2IL 和 Il2CppInterop，从游戏二进制和 global-metadata.dat 生成互操作程序集。其指南还介绍了配置、日志，以及用 dnSpy 调试插件和游戏程序集。
requirements: Latest stable release at review: v5.4.23.5, published 2026-02-08 from the v5-lts branch, with Windows x86/x64, Linux x86/x64, macOS universal and patcher archives; the README says only Unity Mono has stable releases. The reviewed master commit (2026-10-16) declares the unreleased 6.0.0 and is 75 commits after the latest 6.x prerelease, v6.0.0-pre.2 from 2024-08-27, which ships Unity Mono, Unity IL2CPP and .NET builds; newer bleeding-edge builds are published separately. The guides note that the preloader-patcher contract changed between v5 and v6.

The README's compatibility chart lists Unity Mono on Windows, macOS and Linux, Unity IL2CPP on Windows and Linux but not macOS or ARM, and .NET/XNA games on Windows or through Mono on macOS and Linux. The master installation guide lists Windows 7–10, Linux distributions with GCC 10+, macOS 10.13+ and Unity 3 or newer. Source builds use the bundled Cake script and need .NET 6.0 or newer.

BepInEx installs into the user's own game directory: the guide identifies Unity Mono games by a Managed folder and IL2CPP games by il2cpp_data. IL2CPP interop generation reads the game's binary and global-metadata.dat and, by default, downloads managed Unity base libraries for the game's Unity version from unity.bepinex.dev; a configuration option points it to a locally placed archive instead. Some games need the documented troubleshooting steps, and per-game compatibility is not implied.

LGPL-2.1 (LGPL-2.1-only in the package metadata); the libraries it uses, including UnityDoorstop, HarmonyX, MonoMod, Mono.Cecil, Cpp2IL and Il2CppInterop, keep their own licenses. This entry covers single-player modding and analysis of locally installed games; game license terms are separate from the framework's license. No game was modded or run, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: BinExport
description_en: The exporter component of BinDiff: plugins for IDA Pro and Binary Ninja and an extension for Ghidra that write an analyzed disassembly to the Protocol Buffer format BinDiff requires. The BinExport2 schema covers instructions with their operands and expressions, basic blocks, flow graphs, the call graph, sections, strings, comments and data references; the exporter can also write a statistics text file or a text dump for debugging. Exports can be scripted through IDC or IDAPython in IDA and through a BinExport.java script that also runs in Ghidra's headless analyzer.
description_zh: BinDiff 的导出组件：为 IDA Pro 和 Binary Ninja 提供插件、为 Ghidra 提供扩展，把已分析的反汇编结果写成 BinDiff 所需的 Protocol Buffer 格式。BinExport2 模式涵盖带操作数和表达式的指令、基本块、流程图、调用图、节区、字符串、注释和数据引用；导出器还可输出统计文本文件或用于调试的文本转储。在 IDA 中可通过 IDC 或 IDAPython 脚本导出，在 Ghidra 中可使用同样能在无界面分析器中运行的 BinExport.java 脚本。
requirements: Latest release at review: v12-20240417-ghidra_11.0.3, published 2024-04-17, with Linux, macOS and Windows plugin archives and a Ghidra 11.0.3 extension; the release notes say its artifacts are not code-signed. The reviewed main commit is 111 commits ahead of that release, and its README requires IDA Pro 9.4 or later and drops the 8.x series, so the current README describes plugins that no release yet provides.

Requires a separately licensed IDA Pro or Binary Ninja installation, or Ghidra; Binary Ninja integration is minimal and the Ghidra extension is described as experimental. Users supply their own binaries and analysis databases, and BinDiff itself is a separate tool.

Native builds need CMake 3.20+, Boost 1.83+ (a partial copy is bundled), GCC 15 or recent Clang on Linux and macOS or Visual Studio 2022 with the Windows 11 SDK, and download Abseil, GoogleTest, Protocol Buffers and the IDA and Binary Ninja SDKs; Debian 11 is the preferred Linux build environment. The Ghidra extension builds with OpenJDK 21+, Gradle 8.7+ and Ghidra 11.0.3.
Apache-2.0. The README states that it is not an official Google product. No binaries were exported or diffed for this entry.

name: Karta
description_en: Source-code-assisted IDA Python plugin from Check Point Research that finds and matches open-source libraries compiled into large binaries and firmware. Its identifier script reports which supported libraries, such as OpenSSL, zlib, libpng and net-snmp, are present and fingerprints their versions; the matcher then uses a JSON configuration built from that library version to locate its compiled files by their original function order, match their functions and the external libc functions they call, and export selected matches as IDA names. The bundled Thumbs Up scripts improve IDA's function analysis beforehand, including ARM/Thumb separation in firmware.
description_zh: Check Point Research 开发的源码辅助 IDA Python 插件，用于在大型二进制和固件中查找并匹配编译进去的开源库。识别脚本会列出二进制中存在哪些受支持的库（如 OpenSSL、zlib、libpng 和 net-snmp），并识别其版本；匹配脚本再借助由该库版本生成的 JSON 配置，按原始函数顺序定位各个编译单元，匹配其中的函数及其调用的外部 libc 函数，并可把选定的匹配结果作为名称导入 IDA。附带的 Thumbs Up 脚本可预先改进 IDA 的函数分析，包括区分固件中的 ARM 与 Thumb 代码。
requirements: Latest release at review: v2.1.0, published 2021-05-18; the reviewed master commit, from 2022-03-15, adds only README and CI workflow changes. The README says the original author can no longer maintain the repository after leaving Check Point Research, citing the IDA Pro versions and regression-test requirements involved.

Requires IDA Pro 7.4 or newer with Python 3; v1.2.0 is the last release for Python 2 and older IDA versions. setup.py installs dependencies including elementals, sark, click and scikit-learn, while requirements.txt still names the old sklearn package. The scripts are loaded through IDA's script-file menu rather than installed as plugins. IDA is the only implemented disassembler backend, although the docs describe an interface for adding others; compatibility with current IDA releases was not checked.

Run the scripts on a binary that IDA has already analyzed well, and select the Windows option for Windows-compiled binaries. Matching needs a configuration for the exact library version: the repository ships configurations for OpenSSL 1.0.1j, libpng 1.2.29, libtiff 4.0.8 and zlib 1.2.3 and 1.2.11, and others are generated with karta_analyze_src.py, which also drives IDA, from the static library and object files of a library you compile yourself, following the notes in compilations/. Upstream advises backing up the binary before Thumbs Up, which makes major changes to its analysis.

MIT license. The identifier covers 15 library modules, including the closed-source Treck library, which is detected only. Matches are heuristic proposals whose matching rules differ in accuracy and are shown in different colors, so they need analyst review. No binaries were analyzed.

name: VTIL-Core
description_en: C++20 core of the VTIL (Virtual-machine Translation Intermediate Language) project, an intermediate language and optimizing compiler that the README describes as built for binary de-obfuscation and de-virtualization. Unlike LLVM IR, VTIL keeps the native stack, physical registers and non-SSA form, so code from register or stack machines can be lifted into it, native instructions can stay inline, and code can be emitted back at any virtual address. The library provides the IL with routines, basic blocks and serialization, a symbolic expression engine and simplifier, optimizer passes such as dead-code elimination, propagation and stack pinning, and Capstone/Keystone-based AMD64 and ARM64 disassembly and assembly helpers.
description_zh: VTIL（Virtual-machine Translation Intermediate Language，虚拟机翻译中间语言）项目的 C++20 核心库。VTIL 是一种中间语言及优化编译器，README 称其专为二进制去混淆与去虚拟化分析而设计。与 LLVM IR 不同，VTIL 保留原生栈、物理寄存器和非 SSA 形式，因此寄存器机或栈机代码都能提升到其中，原生指令可直接嵌入 IL 流，代码也能重新输出到任意虚拟地址。该库提供包含例程、基本块和序列化的 IL、符号表达式引擎与化简器、死代码消除、传播和栈固定等优化遍，以及基于 Capstone/Keystone 的 AMD64 与 ARM64 反汇编和汇编辅助功能。
requirements: No releases or tags; the README says the repository is incomplete because the initial release is not done, and further documentation is still to come. The reviewed master commit (2026-07-27) only edits the README; the preceding code commits date from 2026-04-04 and 2026-04-05. This entry pins it for documentation only.

Build with CMake 3.16+ and a C++20 compiler: generate a Visual Studio solution on Windows, or use Ninja on Linux and macOS, where Apple Silicon builds need -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES=x86_64. CMake fetches Capstone and Keystone at pinned commits, and CI builds on Windows Server 2022, Ubuntu 24.04 and macOS 14.

This is a library for analyzing virtualized or obfuscated code: the user supplies a lifter that translates the code under analysis into VTIL routines, which can then be optimized, inspected or re-emitted. The reviewed tree contains no lifter for a particular virtual machine or protector. Its Sample Routines folder holds 2020 .vtil test routines next to the small C test functions they correspond to, which commit messages describe as VMProtect tests; this entry covers analysis use only.

BSD-3-Clause license. The fetched dependencies keep their own licenses: Capstone's BSD-style license, and Keystone's GPL-2.0 with a FOSS license exception, which matters when distributing builds. No routines were lifted or optimized, and nothing was built.

name: efiXplorer
description_en: IDA Pro plugin and loader that automate static analysis of UEFI firmware. The plugin annotates Boot, Runtime, SMM and PEI service calls, lists the EFI protocols and known GUIDs a module installs or consumes, applies protocol interface types in the Hex-Rays decompiler, flags suspected SMM callout and GetVariable out-of-bounds write patterns for review and saves a JSON report. The efiXloader module opens a whole firmware image in one IDA database, with driver entry points, navigation between drivers and a DXE driver dependency graph.
description_zh: 用于自动化 UEFI 固件静态分析的 IDA Pro 插件与加载器。插件可标注 Boot、Runtime、SMM 和 PEI 服务调用，列出模块安装或使用的 EFI 协议与已知 GUID，在 Hex-Rays 反编译器中应用协议接口类型，标记疑似 SMM callout 及 GetVariable 越界写入模式供人工复核，并保存 JSON 报告。efiXloader 加载模块可在单个 IDA 数据库中打开整个固件镜像，提供各驱动入口点、驱动间导航和 DXE 驱动依赖关系图。
requirements: Latest release at review: v6.3.0, published 2026-08-20 as a zip of prebuilt binaries; the reviewed master commit is two GUID-database submodule updates ahead. ida-plugin.json declares IDA 8.3 or newer on Windows x86_64, Linux x86_64 and macOS x86_64/aarch64; the plugin is listed in Hex-Rays' plugin repository and can be installed with ida-hcli.

Needs a licensed IDA Pro. Applying protocol interface types also needs the Hex-Rays decompiler, and the build instructions cover building without it. Source builds use CMake or build.py against the IDA SDK, UEFITool and GUID database submodules; a manual install copies the plugin and the guids directory into IDA's plugins folder and the loader into its loaders folder.

Input is a UEFI firmware image or individual UEFI driver the analyst already has. The wiki's feature table lists SMM services and the dependency graph for 64-bit modules only and PEI services for 32-bit only. Its loader page still says only 64-bit drivers are supported, while the v6.3.0 notes add 32-bit modules in the loader, and the wiki pages still link the earlier binarly-io repository.

GPL-3.0; ida-plugin.json declares GPL-3.0-only. Vulnerability-scanner hits are suspected findings presented for analyst review, not confirmed bugs; the authors' Black Hat Europe 2020 and EKO 2020 publications describe the approach. No firmware was analyzed.

name: Frida Workbench for VSCode
description_en: Unofficial Visual Studio Code extension for Frida work. A sidebar lists apps and processes on local, Apple Simulator, USB and remote devices to attach, spawn or kill, and runtime panels browse an attached process's native modules and exports and its Java and Objective-C classes, methods and protocols; selected items generate Interceptor, Objective-C or Java hook scaffolds, optionally with GitHub Copilot-inferred native signatures, and Objective-C headers or Java class stubs can be dumped. A language server completes class, selector and module names from a live target, and the extension also scaffolds Frida agent and C-module projects, script-debugging configurations, syslog streaming and Android frida-server setup.
description_zh: 非官方的 Visual Studio Code 扩展，用于 Frida 相关工作。侧边栏列出本地、Apple 模拟器、USB 和远程设备上的应用与进程，可附加、启动或结束它们；运行时面板可浏览已附加进程的原生模块与导出函数，以及 Java 和 Objective-C 的类、方法与协议，并根据所选项目生成 Interceptor、Objective-C 或 Java 的 Hook 代码框架（可选用 GitHub Copilot 推断原生函数签名），还能导出 Objective-C 头文件或 Java 类存根。语言服务器根据运行中的目标补全类名、选择器和模块名；扩展还提供 Frida agent 与 C 模块项目脚手架、脚本调试配置、系统日志流以及 Android frida-server 部署。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.12.11, published 2026-09-29 as a .vsix package, whose tag is the reviewed main commit; package.json requires VS Code 1.94+. The extension is also listed on the Visual Studio Marketplace under the CodeColorist publisher. CHANGELOG.md's newest entry is v0.12.8, so later releases are not described there.

Needs Python 3.7+ with the frida-tools package; because of PEP 668 the README recommends the workspace's active virtual environment, or pipx or uv. Targets need a working Frida setup: on Android the extension can download and start frida-server, iOS USB access from Windows needs iTunes kept open, libimobiledevice is optional for SSH shells, and iOS shells require a jailbroken device.

The language server attaches to the live target named in .vscode/frida.json, which needs a device and exactly one of app, pid or process. Copilot-assisted hook generation depends on GitHub Copilot, and Objection is an optional external tool. Users supply their own devices, apps and processes.
A community project, not affiliated with the Frida team; MIT-licensed. No device or process was attached for this entry.

name: ghidriff
description_en: Command-line binary diffing engine that drives Ghidra headlessly through pyghidra: it imports and analyzes an old and a new binary, then reports added, deleted and modified functions, with patch diffing as its main use. The default VersionTrackingDiff engine combines several Ghidra Version Tracking correlators with BSim matching, alongside simpler symbol-name and structural-graph engines and a GhidraDiffEngine base class for custom differs. Results are written as JSON and Markdown with Mermaid charts and meta diffs of strings, called and calling functions and binary metadata, plus optional side-by-side HTML.
description_zh: 命令行二进制差异分析引擎，通过 pyghidra 以无界面方式驱动 Ghidra：导入并分析新旧两个版本的二进制，列出新增、删除和修改的函数，主要用于补丁比对。默认的 VersionTrackingDiff 引擎组合了多个 Ghidra 版本跟踪关联器和 BSim 匹配，另有基于符号名和结构图的较简单引擎，并提供 GhidraDiffEngine 基类供编写自定义比对器。结果以 JSON 和带 Mermaid 图表的 Markdown 输出，附有字符串、被调用与调用函数及二进制元数据的元差异，也可另外生成并排对照的 HTML。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.0.0, published 2025-07-04 on GitHub and PyPI, which requires Python 3.9+ and pyghidra 2.0+. The reviewed main commit, merged 2026-05-11, is six commits ahead and still reports version 1.0.0: it requires Python 3.10+ and pyghidra 3.x, targets Ghidra 12.0.4 and logs a warning when another Ghidra or pyghidra version is running. setup.cfg classifies the package as Alpha.

Install Ghidra with a JDK supported by that release, set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR and install the package with pip or uvx; the README covers Windows, Linux and macOS, and its x64/arm64 Docker image ships the PyPI release so Ghidra and Java need not be installed on the host. Large binaries may need a larger JVM memory share.

Supply two or more versions of the same binary, ordered oldest to newest, with an optional summary across several new versions; anything Ghidra can import and analyze can be compared, with a custom base address for firmware or bootloader images, analyzer options and GDT type archives. The supported-platforms page says native code works best, managed .NET results are mixed and native libraries must be taken out of an APK first. A preflight check stops the diff when the two programs' processor languages differ or their symbol counts differ by 4,000 or more, unless --force-diff is given. By default Ghidra's well-known PDB symbol servers are configured with a local symbol store unless --no-symbols is set.

GPL-3.0. Matching quality depends on Ghidra's analysis and decompilation. The README's use cases and the documentation site's sample diffs cover Windows and macOS system binaries obtained separately; the repository ships no target binaries. No binaries were diffed for this entry.

name: vmlinux-to-elf
description_en: Rebuild an analyzable ELF with function and variable symbols from a Linux kernel image, whether a raw or compressed vmlinux, vmlinuz, zImage or bzImage blob, certain Android boot.img files or a stripped kernel ELF, by locating and decoding the embedded kallsyms symbol table. It detects the compression format, instruction set, endianness, word size, entry point and an approximate base address and writes an ELF for IDA Pro or Ghidra; a kallsyms-finder listing, a standalone decompressor and a GTK GUI are included.
description_zh: 通过定位并解码内嵌的 kallsyms 符号表，从 Linux 内核镜像重建带函数与变量符号、可供分析的 ELF 文件；输入可以是原始或压缩的 vmlinux、vmlinuz、zImage、bzImage 数据块，部分 Android boot.img 文件，或已去除符号的内核 ELF。工具会检测压缩格式、指令集、字节序、位宽、入口点和近似基址，并生成可在 IDA Pro 或 Ghidra 中分析的 ELF；另附列出符号的 kallsyms-finder、独立解压工具和 GTK 图形界面。
requirements: Latest release at review: 1.3.6, published 2026-05-20 on GitHub and PyPI; its notes include provisional support for reserializing section-stripped ELF kernels and uImage LZMA decompression. The reviewed master commit is four commits ahead, with GUI and packaging updates, and carries a 1.3.6.1 tag that has no release. PyPI classifies the project as beta.

Requires Python 3.9+ with lz4, zstandard, minilzo and peewee. The README installs the CLI and GUI with snap on Ubuntu, from the AUR, or with uv plus GTK 4, libadwaita and PyGObject development packages; Flathub provides the GUI on distributions whose libadwaita is older than 1.6.

Input is a kernel image the analyst already has; kernels built without CONFIG_KALLSYMS are not supported. The README states support for Linux 2.6.10 through 6.4 as of August 2023, raw-kernel architecture detection for MIPS, ARM, ARM64, PowerPC, SPARC, x86, x86-64, SuperH and ARC, XZ, LZMA, GZip, BZ2, LZ4, LZO and Zstd decompression, and OpenWrt's uncompressed kallsyms variant. Instruction set, bit size, file offset and base address can be overridden when detection fails.

GPL-3.0-or-later. Recovered symbols carry only the name, address and nm-style type stored in kallsyms, and the base address is a heuristic: the first text symbol address with the low 12 bits cleared. No kernel image was converted.

name: Ddisasm
description_en: GrammaTech's Datalog disassembler, which turns ELF and PE binaries for x86-32, x86-64, ARM32, ARM64 and MIPS32 into the GTIRB intermediate representation. It decodes a superset of possible instructions, then applies Soufflé Datalog rules and weighted heuristics to infer code locations, symbolization and function boundaries; gtirb-pprinter turns the result into reassemblable assembly or a rebuilt binary, and the GTIRB APIs or gtirb-rewriting can modify it in between. User hint files add Datalog facts or change heuristic weights where inference goes wrong.
description_zh: GrammaTech 开发的 Datalog 反汇编器，可将 x86-32、x86-64、ARM32、ARM64 和 MIPS32 架构的 ELF 与 PE 二进制转换为 GTIRB 中间表示。它先解码所有可能指令的超集，再用 Soufflé Datalog 规则和加权启发式推断代码位置、符号化结果和函数边界；gtirb-pprinter 可将结果输出为可重新汇编的汇编代码或重建的二进制，期间还可借助 GTIRB API 或 gtirb-rewriting 修改程序。推断出错时，用户可通过提示文件添加 Datalog 事实或调整启发式权重。
requirements: Latest GitHub release at review: v1.8.0, published 2023-12-14 without attached files. Later versions are distributed elsewhere: PyPI lists ddisasm 1.9.5, uploaded 2026-07-06 as a single manylinux x86_64 wheel. The reviewed main commit, from 2026-10-13, declares version 1.9.6, which its changelog marks unreleased.

Prebuilt options are the grammatech/ddisasm Docker image (stable or unstable tags), Ubuntu 20 (focal) apt packages and Windows .zip builds on GrammaTech's servers; the docs warn against mixing stable and unstable tools. Source builds need a C++17 compiler, GTIRB 1.12.1+, gtirb-pprinter 2.0.0+, Capstone 5.0.1+ (GrammaTech tests with its fork), Soufflé 2.4 built with 64-bit numbers, libehp 1.0.0+ and LIEF 0.13.2+.

Input is an ELF or PE binary; rebuilding through gtirb-pprinter invokes a compiler or assembler such as gcc. Code inference and symbolization are heuristic: --self-diagnose checks symbolization only for binaries linked with complete relocation information, and the docs call the option that replaces CFI directives with .eh_frame symbolic expressions experimental and unreliable.

AGPL-3.0; contributions require GrammaTech's contributor license agreement. GTIRB, gtirb-pprinter and gtirb-rewriting are separate projects that were not reviewed. The README cites a USENIX Security 2020 paper and an IEEE S&P 2025 paper on the approach; their results are not restated here. No binaries were disassembled.

name: PINCE
description_en: Linux front end for the GNU Debugger (GDB), focused on games but usable for other reverse engineering; the name stands for “PINCE is not Cheat Engine”. It scans process memory and pointers through libmemscan into a typed address table, and its memory view adds disassembly, an on-the-fly assembler, code dissection for referenced calls, jumps and strings, function, region and instruction searches, and structure overlays, including structures generated from Mono/IL2CPP class dissection of native Linux or Wine/Proton processes. Debugging covers chained breakpoints and watchpoints, tracking of the instructions that access an address, tracing and stack traces, alongside a GDB console and the reusable libpince Python library.
description_zh: 面向 Linux 的 GNU 调试器（GDB）前端，以游戏为主要对象，也可用于其他逆向工程；名称意为“PINCE is not Cheat Engine”。它借助 libmemscan 扫描进程内存和指针，并将结果放入带类型的地址表；内存视图提供反汇编、即时汇编、对引用的调用、跳转和字符串进行代码剖析、函数/内存区域/指令搜索以及结构体叠加查看，其中结构体可由对原生 Linux 或 Wine/Proton 进程中 Mono/IL2CPP 类的剖析自动生成。调试功能包括可链式关联的断点与观察点、追踪访问某地址的指令、执行跟踪和调用栈查看，并提供 GDB 控制台和可复用的 libpince Python 库。
requirements: Linux only. Latest release at review: v0.10.2, published 2026-09-18, whose tag is the reviewed master commit; it ships an x86_64 AppImage that the README supports on distributions as new as Ubuntu 22.04 or newer.

Local development installs run install.sh with APT, Pacman or DNF and need Python 3.11+, PyQt 6.11+ and GDB; Kubuntu 22.04+ and Arch Linux are officially supported, while Debian 12+, Fedora 35+ and openSUSE are only partially supported and not actively tested. The PINCE.sh launcher runs PINCE as root, elevating through pkexec or sudo.

Users select a running process of their own to inspect. This entry describes only the memory-inspection, disassembly and debugging features; the README states that users are responsible for their actions and asks that only this GitHub repository be trusted as a source of PINCE code or packages.
GPL-3.0-or-later (COPYING); AUTHORS lists the bundled Silk icons in media/icons under CC BY 3.0 (COPYING.CC-BY). No process was attached to or scanned for this entry.

name: uncompyle6
description_en: Cross-version decompiler that translates Python bytecode back into equivalent Python source, accepting bytecode from Python 1.0 through 3.8 as well as some PyPy bytecode and Dropbox's Python 2.5. It disassembles code objects with the companion xdis library and parses the instruction stream into a grammar-based tree from which source is printed; it can also deparse just the fragment around a given bytecode offset, which the author's trepan debuggers use for exact location reporting. It succeeds the older decompyle, uncompyle and uncompyle2 forks.
description_zh: 跨版本的 Python 反编译器，可把 Python 字节码还原为等价的 Python 源码，支持 Python 1.0 至 3.8 的字节码，以及部分 PyPy 字节码和 Dropbox 的 Python 2.5 字节码。它借助配套的 xdis 库反汇编代码对象，再把指令流解析成基于语法的树并据此输出源码；它还能只反解析给定字节码偏移附近的代码片段，作者的 trepan 调试器即用此功能精确报告位置。它是早期 decompyle、uncompyle 和 uncompyle2 等分支的后继项目。
requirements: Latest release at review: 3.9.3, published 2025-09-29 on GitHub and PyPI; the reviewed master commit is 34 commits later and reports 3.9.4.dev0. Installing from PyPI, like the master branch, is meant for running on Python 3.11+; older interpreters back to Python 2.4 use the version-specific tarballs, eggs or wheels on GitHub Releases, built from separate git branches. It depends on xdis 6.3+, spark-parser and click.

The README reports testing on bytecode from Python 1.4, 2.1–2.7 and 3.0–3.8 and later PyPy versions. Python 3 support is strongest around 3.3–3.4 and weakens further away, control flow is the biggest known problem, and the author does not intend serious work on 3.8 or 3.9, pointing to the separate decompyle3 for 3.7 and 3.8. Bytecode newer than 3.8 is not decompiled, and candidate-release magic numbers, some Python 3.6 magic variants, encrypted or custom-interpreter bytecode other than Dropbox's old 2.5, obfuscated code, Cython and MicroPython are not handled.

Input .pyc or .pyo files come from the user; it cannot decompile Py2EXE executables directly, and bytecode bundled by such packagers has to be extracted first. The --syntax-verify option checks only that the output is valid Python syntax, so the README suggests cross-checking with other uncompyle6 versions or other decompilers such as pycdc. Recovered source remains subject to the rights of the original program’s owner.
GPL-3.0-or-later per pyproject.toml, with the GPL-3.0 text in COPYING. Nothing was installed or decompiled.

name: ret-sync
description_en: Reverse-Engineering Tools SYNChronization: plugins that keep IDA, Ghidra or Binary Ninja graph and decompiler views following a live WinDbg, GDB, LLDB, OllyDbg 1.10/2 or x64dbg session, rebasing addresses on the fly so ASLR does not break the mapping. Debugger commands push comments, labels, rebased addresses and command output into the disassembler database and resolve symbols from it, while disassembler hotkeys set breakpoints and step the debugger; several databases can be synced at once and the two sides may run on different hosts. A standalone Python library offers the same position syncing to custom tracing tools.
description_zh: ret-sync 即“逆向工程工具同步”：一组插件，让 IDA、Ghidra 或 Binary Ninja 的图形与反编译视图跟随运行中的 WinDbg、GDB、LLDB、OllyDbg 1.10/2 或 x64dbg 调试会话，并实时重定基址，使 ASLR 不影响地址对应。调试器命令可将注释、标签、重定基后的地址和命令输出写入反汇编数据库，并从中解析符号；反汇编器中的快捷键则可设置断点、单步执行调试器。可同时同步多个数据库，两端也可运行在不同主机上。独立的 Python 库可为自定义跟踪工具提供同样的位置同步。
requirements: No release tracks the reviewed master commit (2026-02-15): the only GitHub release is a 2022 Binary Ninja community build, prebuilt WinDbg, OllyDbg, OllyDbg2 and x64dbg plugins come from an Azure DevOps pipeline, and ext_ghidra/dist holds per-version Ghidra extension archives, the newest for Ghidra 11.4.2. Each Ghidra archive supports only the Ghidra version in its file name; other versions are built with Gradle against a local installation.

The IDA plugin requires IDA 9.2+, with older IDA versions served by history before the ida9.2 tag; the Binary Ninja plugin needs Binary Ninja 2.2+ with Python 3 and is marked experimental; the WinDbg extension is built from a Visual Studio solution, reported working with Visual Studio 2017 and 2026; the IDA and GDB plugins need Python 2.7+ or Python 3. IDA, Binary Ninja and WinDbg are obtained separately, and users supply their own binaries and debugging targets.

The README states there is no authentication or encryption between debugger and disassembler and that self-modifying code is out of scope; its tested-versions list is older (Python 2.7/3.7, IDA 7.7, Ghidra 10.1.1, Binary Ninja 3.0, GDB 8.1, LLDB 310.2.37), and it notes GDB signal issues with multi-threaded debugging and a possible WinDbg race condition. Remote and renamed-module setups are configured through an optional .sync INI file.
GPL-3.0-or-later; the Binary Ninja plugin is MIT-licensed. ret-sync is a fork of Quarkslab's qb-sync. No debugging session was synchronized for this entry.

name: PyInstaller Extractor (pyinstxtractor)
description_en: Single-file Python script that extracts the contents of executables built with PyInstaller, including Linux ELF builds without other tools. It locates the PyInstaller archive in the executable, reports the PyInstaller and Python versions and likely entry-point scripts, and writes out the bundled CArchive files and the modules in the PYZ archive. It fixes the headers of the extracted .pyc files so that Python bytecode decompilers such as uncompyle6 and Decompyle++ (pycdc) recognize them.
description_zh: 单文件 Python 脚本，用于提取由 PyInstaller 构建的可执行文件的内容，Linux ELF 构建也无需借助其他工具即可提取。它在可执行文件中定位 PyInstaller 归档，报告 PyInstaller 和 Python 版本以及可能的入口脚本，并导出打包在 CArchive 中的文件和 PYZ 归档中的模块。它还会修复导出的 .pyc 文件头，使 uncompyle6、Decompyle++（pycdc）等 Python 字节码反编译器能够识别。
requirements: Runs under Python 2.x or 3.x and needs no PyInstaller installation. Latest release at review: 2026.07, published 2026-07-22 without attached files; it tags the reviewed master commit, whose script header still calls itself version 2.0. The README lists PyInstaller 2.0 through 6.19.0 as tested against a separate test-binary repository and supported.

Modules in the PYZ archive are extracted only when the script runs under the same Python major and minor version that built the executable; otherwise it warns and skips them, and an archive whose table of contents fails to unmarshal is skipped too. Entries that cannot be decompressed, such as those of encrypted PYZ archives, are saved unchanged with an .encrypted suffix rather than decoded.

The PyInstaller executable comes from the user, and turning the recovered bytecode into source needs a separate decompiler. Recovered code remains subject to the rights of the original program’s owner.
GPL-3.0. Nothing was run.

name: Binary Analysis Platform (BAP)
description_en: OCaml binary analysis platform from Carnegie Mellon University. Its bap command loads a program, disassembles it, lifts instructions into an architecture-neutral intermediate representation, builds the control-flow graph and runs analysis passes, while objdump, raw-loader and mc modes handle linear disassembly, raw code blobs and single encodings. The README lists x86, x86-64, ARM, MIPS and PowerPC support, an interpreter, a microexecution interpreter, a symbolic executor and the Primus Lisp language for analyses, function stubs and SMT-solver queries; analyses are written as OCaml plugins or by embedding BAP as a library, with C bindings and minimal Python support in separate repositories.
description_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学开发的 OCaml 二进制分析平台。其 bap 命令可加载程序、进行反汇编、将指令提升为与架构无关的中间表示、构建控制流图并运行分析遍；objdump、raw 加载器和 mc 模式分别用于线性反汇编、原始代码块和单条指令编码。README 列出对 x86、x86-64、ARM、MIPS 和 PowerPC 的支持，以及解释器、微执行解释器、符号执行器和 Primus Lisp 语言，后者可用于编写分析、为函数编写桩模型和调用 SMT 求解器；分析以 OCaml 插件形式编写，或将 BAP 作为库嵌入应用，C 绑定和最基本的 Python 支持位于独立仓库。
requirements: Latest stable release at review: v2.5.0, published 2022-07-11, with x86_64 Debian and RPM packages, tgz archives and sigs.zip/sigs.tar.gz signature archives; a v2.6.0-alpha development build dates from 2023-01-07. The reviewed master commit (2026-05-07) is 60 commits ahead of v2.5.0 and its opam packages carry version dev; the commit before it dates from April 2025. This entry pins it for documentation only.

The binary packages omit the OCaml development environment, so writing analyses needs a source install. The README recommends opam with OCaml 4.14.1 (opam install bap), offers a rolling testing opam repository that follows master, and also documents dune builds from a clone; the opam dependencies keep core_kernel and base below v0.16. The LLVM backend needs llvm-config (conf-bap-llvm 1.8+). The Ghidra and radare2 integrations, which the README calls experimental, and the Z3-based symbolic executor come with the bap-extra meta-package; IDA Pro integration is a separate package.

Input is a user-supplied executable, or a raw code blob opened with --loader=raw and a base address. The tree also has RISC-V, SystemZ and Thumb packages beyond the README's architecture list. Lifted output depends on per-architecture semantics coverage; the 2.5.0 changelog adds a --print-missing option to list unlifted instructions.

MIT license; contributions to the repository are accepted under MIT, while separately hosted plugins may use any license, including a proprietary one. The README names ForAllSecure Mayhem, Draper's CBAT tools and Fraunhofer FKIE's CWE Checker as projects built on BAP. No packages were installed and no binaries were analyzed.

name: furiousMAC Continuity
description_en: Reverse-engineering notes and a Wireshark dissector for Apple's proprietary Continuity Bluetooth LE advertisements, continuing the authors' PETS 2019 privacy study. Per-message pages document field layouts and observed values for 14 message types, including AirDrop, Handoff, Proximity Pairing, Nearby Info and Find My, and the dissector replaces Wireshark's packet-bthci_cmd.c so captured advertisements decode into named btcommon.apple fields.
description_zh: 针对 Apple 专有 Continuity 蓝牙低功耗广播的逆向工程笔记与 Wireshark 解析器，是作者 PETS 2019 隐私研究的延续。各报文页面记录了 AirDrop、Handoff、Proximity Pairing、Nearby Info、Find My 等 14 种报文类型的字段布局和观测到的取值；解析器替换 Wireshark 的 packet-bthci_cmd.c，使捕获到的广播能解码为具名的 btcommon.apple 字段。
requirements: No GitHub releases; the reviewed commit, from 2025-08-29, merges a typo fix. The dissector README calls the March 2021 version for Wireshark 3.4.4 the most up to date: the 4.4.0 file contributed in 2024 ports it to build on Wireshark 4.4.0 without dissector changes and may not correctly dissect messages from the latest iOS versions. Fields the message tables mark as unknown or uncertain remain open.

On Linux and macOS, users download the Wireshark source for the matching version, replace epan/dissectors/packet-bthci_cmd.c with the project's file and build Wireshark. The repository also commits prebuilt 64-bit Windows Wireshark installers for 3.0.8 and 3.2.1, which the dissector README says are based on the original ShmooCon 2020 dissector and should not be used.

Capturing advertisements needs a BLE sniffer: HARDWARE.md recommends a Nordic nRF51 dongle with Nordic's sniffer firmware, or an Ubertooth One with the included btleshark.sh capture script. Analysis uses advertisements the analyst captures; the repository contains no sample captures.
GPL-2.0. The README credits many message types and field meanings to Celosia and Cunche's PETS 2020 paper. No advertisements were captured and Wireshark was not built.

name: Reko
description_en: General-purpose decompiler that loads executables or raw images, scans their machine code into a machine-independent register transfer language, groups it into procedures and decompiles them into high-level C code. The reviewed source has 64 architecture directories, from 6502, Z80 and PDP-11 to ARM, MIPS, PowerPC, RISC-V and x86, and loaders for formats including ELF, PE/MZ, Mach-O, COFF, Amiga Hunk, VMS, WebAssembly, Xbox XBE and Xbox 360 XEX. It runs as a Windows Forms GUI, a command-line client or a .NET library, and project files and scripts let users add names, types and comments.
description_zh: 通用反编译器：加载可执行文件或原始镜像，把机器码扫描转换为与机器无关的寄存器传输语言，再归并为过程并反编译为高级 C 代码。所审阅的源码包含 64 个架构目录，从 6502、Z80、PDP-11 到 ARM、MIPS、PowerPC、RISC-V 和 x86，并提供 ELF、PE/MZ、Mach-O、COFF、Amiga Hunk、VMS、WebAssembly、Xbox XBE 及 Xbox 360 XEX 等格式的加载器。可作为 Windows Forms 图形界面、命令行客户端或 .NET 库使用，用户还可通过项目文件和脚本补充名称、类型和注释。
requirements: Latest release at review: 0.12.5, published 2026-09-29, with x86 and x64 Windows MSI installers and command-line and GUI zip builds; the Reko.Decompiler.Runtime NuGet package is also at 0.12.5. The reviewed master commit, from 2026-10-14, is ten commits ahead of that release.

Requires .NET 9.0. Source builds use the .NET 9.0 SDK, or Visual Studio 2026 for IDE users, plus CMake for the NativeProxy project; the WiX toolset is needed only for MSI installers. CI builds on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS. The cross-platform Avalonia GUI is still under development, and the user guide's non-Windows instructions still mention AppVeyor builds and Mono.

Input is a binary the user has the right to decompile; the README warns that many software licenses prohibit decompilation. Raw images need the loader, architecture, base and entry addresses given explicitly. The user guide says useful decompilation usually needs the user to supply types, names and comments, and that a heuristic scan may be needed when indirect jumps or calls hide code.

GPL-2.0 (COPYING). The complete architecture and format list is on the project wiki, which was not reviewed; the architecture and loader directories were counted, not exercised. The repository's subjects directory holds regression samples collected from other sources together with Reko's output for them; it is test data, not part of the tool. No binaries were decompiled.

name: Dyninst
description_en: Binary instrumentation, analysis and modification libraries from the Paradyn project. DyninstAPI inserts and changes instrumentation in a running program, or rewrites an executable or library on disk and writes the patched copy back, through one machine-independent interface that also supports static and dynamic analysis. Separately documented components handle symbol tables, line numbers and types (SymtabAPI), instruction decoding and disassembly (InstructionAPI), parsing into blocks, functions and loops (ParseAPI), dataflow analyses such as slicing (DataFlowAPI), process control, stack walking and patching.
description_zh: 源自 Paradyn 项目的二进制插桩、分析与修改库。DyninstAPI 可在运行中的程序里插入和修改插桩代码，也可改写磁盘上的可执行文件或库并写回修改后的副本；同一套与机器无关的接口还支持静态和动态分析。各组件有独立手册，分别负责符号表、行号与类型（SymtabAPI）、指令解码与反汇编（InstructionAPI）、解析为基本块、函数和循环（ParseAPI）、切片等数据流分析（DataFlowAPI），以及进程控制、栈回溯和代码修补。
requirements: The CMake platform check accepts Linux, FreeBSD and Windows hosts on x86-64, 32-bit x86, AArch64, ppc64le and riscv64, plus AMD GPU code-generation targets; InstructionAPI documents x86, x86-64, ARMv8-64 and 32/64-bit PowerPC decoding. The README calls AArch64 dynamic instrumentation experimental and incomplete, and its known issues include no Windows 64-bit or Windows rewriter mode, uncaught exceptions in relocated code, a fragile Windows stack walker and a crash when parsing a binary with no functions.

Latest release at review: v13.0.0, published 2024-03-21. The reviewed master commit still declares version 13.0.0 and is 590 commits ahead of that tag; the README says the bundled v13.0.0 PDF manuals are a snapshot, so current behavior needs manuals built from source with pdflatex.

Install with Spack or build from source with CMake 3.14+ (3.19.0 is rejected), a C11/C++11 toolchain (GCC 6+), Boost 1.71+, TBB 2019.9+ and, on Unix, elfutils 0.186+; Docker containers for development are described in the docker directory. Users supply their own executables, libraries or running processes to analyze or instrument.

LGPL-2.1 (LICENSE.md). COPYRIGHT credits Barton P. Miller with contributions from LLNS, Red Hat and Bull SAS, and DataFlowAPI incorporates Rose Compiler Project code under its own copyright notice. No binaries were instrumented or rewritten for this entry.

name: goblin
description_en: Rust crate for zero-copy, endian-aware parsing of ELF32/64, 32/64-bit Mach-O and multi-architecture fat containers, PE32/PE32+, COFF objects, Terse Executable (TE) images and Unix/BSD archives; Object::parse picks the format from its magic bytes. Parsed structures cover ELF headers, sections, symbols, dynamic entries, relocations and notes, Mach-O load commands, imports and exports, and PE imports, exports, relocations, TLS, resources, exception and unwind data, Authenticode certificates and the .NET CLR header. Feature flags can reduce it to std-free #[repr(C)] struct definitions for kernels and other no_std code.
description_zh: 以零拷贝、感知字节序的方式解析二进制格式的 Rust crate，支持 ELF32/64、32/64 位 Mach-O 及多架构 fat 容器、PE32/PE32+、COFF 目标文件、Terse Executable（TE）镜像以及 Unix/BSD 归档；Object::parse 根据魔数自动识别格式。解析结果涵盖 ELF 的文件头、节区、符号、动态段条目、重定位和 note，Mach-O 的加载命令及导入导出，以及 PE 的导入导出、重定位、TLS、资源、异常与展开信息、Authenticode 证书和 .NET CLR 头。借助特性开关，它还可精简为不依赖 std 的 #[repr(C)] 结构体定义，供内核等 no_std 代码使用。
requirements: Latest tag at review: 0.10.6 (also tagged v0.10.6) on the 2026-05-25 version-bump commit; the project publishes no GitHub releases. crates.io also lists 0.10.7, published 2026-05-28, which has no matching tag or changelog entry. The reviewed master commit (2026-08-30) still declares 0.10.6, and this entry pins it for documentation only.

Used as a Cargo dependency; it needs rustc 1.85.0+ (Rust 2024 edition) and depends on plain, scroll and an optional log. Default features enable every format with std; elf32/elf64, mach32/mach64, pe32/pe64, te and archive select backends, endian_fd parses by the binary's own byte order, and Mach-O, PE and TE parsing requires alloc and endian_fd.

Input is a byte slice holding an executable, object file or archive the user supplies. goblin parses format metadata only and includes no disassembler, so code needs a separate instruction decoder. PE parse options can skip RVA resolution, attribute certificates, TLS data, resources or imports, and the changelog describes an ELF and PE permissive mode for packed, broken or malware samples.
MIT license. The README quotes a report of 100 million fuzzing runs, and the repository holds cargo-fuzz and AFL harnesses; neither was rerun, and no binaries were parsed.

name: mitmproxy2swagger
description_en: Command-line tool that reverse-engineers undocumented REST APIs from captured traffic. It reads a mitmproxy flow file, or a HAR export from the browser DevTools, and generates an OpenAPI 3.0 specification describing the observed endpoints. Running it again over further captures safely merges the new data into an existing schema.
description_zh: 命令行工具，从捕获的流量还原未公开的 REST API。它读取 mitmproxy 流文件或浏览器 DevTools 导出的 HAR，生成描述所观察端点的 OpenAPI 3.0 规范。对更多捕获再次运行时，会将新数据安全合并到已有规范中。
requirements: Installed from PyPI (also packaged for Arch Linux) or run via the provided Dockerfile; pyproject.toml marks version 0.15.0 and requires Python 3.12+.

Takes a mitmproxy flow file or a browser HAR export as input; the analyst captures that traffic separately, for example with mitmproxy, and supplies the API base-URL prefix. The two-pass workflow lets several captures be merged into an existing schema.

Intended for APIs and traffic the analyst is authorized to capture and analyze. The project metadata in pyproject.toml declares the MIT license; no standalone LICENSE file is present for GitHub to detect.

name: opendbc
description_en: comma.ai's repository of DBC files describing the CAN messages and signals of many car makes, with a Python library that parses and builds CAN messages from those definitions; its porting guide has contributors reverse engineer new messages from recorded drives in the cabana tool. Per-brand car ports built on it parse vehicle state, identify models from ECU firmware versions and generate openpilot's steering, gas and brake messages, while safety code for comma's panda interface restricts which messages can be sent.
description_zh: comma.ai 维护的 DBC 文件库，描述多个汽车品牌的 CAN 报文与信号，并附带一个依据这些定义解析和构造 CAN 报文的 Python 库；其车型移植指南要求贡献者在 cabana 工具中利用行车记录逆向分析新的报文。基于它的各品牌车型移植代码可解析车辆状态、根据 ECU 固件版本识别车型，并生成 openpilot 的转向、油门和制动报文；面向 comma panda 接口的安全代码则限制哪些报文可以发出。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.3.1, published 2026-04-22 on GitHub and PyPI; the reviewed master commit is 296 commits ahead of it. docs/CARS.md lists 406 known cars: 341 with upstream support, 14 community, 32 dashcam-only, 16 not compatible and 3 in a custom category. The README says it and that list are the project's only documentation.

The package requires Python 3.11 or 3.12 because pycapnp does not work with 3.13. From a clone, test.sh installs dependencies, builds with SCons, runs the tests and lints; the README roadmap still lists pip install opendbc as open even though PyPI carries the 0.3.x releases. For a live car, the porting guide starts with a comma four and a car-specific harness, and the DBC README connects through a panda.

New definitions come from the analyst's own recorded drives loaded in cabana, which lives in the openpilot repository; the README also points to the commaCarSegments dataset of CAN data from 300 car models. The DBC README recommends recording uncertain signal interpretations as comments, so definitions cover only what contributors have documented for each car.

MIT. The README says panda safety firmware starts with silent CAN buses and that some output modes are disabled in release firmware. The car-control interfaces were not exercised; no CAN data was loaded and no vehicle was connected.

name: FLOSS (FLARE Obfuscated String Solver)
description_en: Mandiant FLARE string extractor for malware analysis that is used like strings.exe but also recovers obfuscated strings. Besides static ASCII and UTF-16LE strings it extracts stack strings, tight strings and strings decoded by functions: it heuristically identifies decoding routines, recovers their arguments through control-flow analysis, emulates them and diffs memory before and after emulation. It also extracts Go and Rust strings and accepts PE, ELF and raw 32- or 64-bit shellcode; JSON results can be turned into import scripts for IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, radare2 and x64dbg.
description_zh: Mandiant FLARE 团队的恶意软件字符串提取工具，用法与 strings.exe 相同，但还能还原混淆字符串。除了静态的 ASCII 和 UTF-16LE 字符串，它还能提取栈字符串、紧凑栈字符串（tight strings）以及由函数解码出的字符串：先用启发式方法识别解码函数，通过控制流分析取得调用参数，再模拟执行这些函数，并比较模拟前后的内存状态。它还能提取 Go 和 Rust 字符串，支持 PE、ELF 以及 32 位或 64 位原始 shellcode；JSON 结果可转换为 IDA Pro、Ghidra、Binary Ninja、radare2 和 x64dbg 的导入脚本。
requirements: Latest release at review: v3.2.0, published 2026-10-16 as standalone Linux, macOS and Windows executables and on PyPI for Python 3.10+; it adds basic ELF support and moves the Ghidra import script to PyGhidra. The reviewed master commit has 857 commits that are not in v3.2.0, which in turn has 8 not on master: it merges the QUANTUMSTRAND preview, so the layout-aware static strings with file-structure context and tags, the HTML report and the hosted viewer described in its README have so far shipped only in quantumstrand pre-releases (latest quantumstrand-beta3, 2026-04-22). Master requires Python 3.12+ and still reports version 3.1.1.

Decoding uses static emulation with embedded FLIRT signatures to identify library functions; files above 64 MB abort deobfuscation unless --large-file is given. Shellcode is recognized by .sc32/.raw32/.sc64/.raw64 extensions or selected with -f. Source clones need Git LFS for the tag databases and signature files, and the installation guide calls the Python API unstable between releases, leaving the CLI as the stable interface.

Samples come from the analyst. v3.2.0 fixed an issue in which crafted .viv vivisect workspace files, either the sample itself or one beside it, could execute code during analysis in v3.1.1 and earlier and in the QUANTUMSTRAND pre-releases; saved workspaces now load only with FLOSS_LOAD_VIV_WORKSPACE=1. Decoded strings come only from routines that FLOSS identifies as decoders and emulates.
Apache-2.0. Nothing was installed and no samples were analyzed.

name: Zydis
description_en: Lightweight C11 x86/x86-64 disassembler and code-generation library. Its decoder reports each instruction's operands, accessed CPU and FPU flags, ISA set and extension and branch type; the formatter prints Intel, MASM or AT&T syntax, and the encoder assembles instructions from encoder requests, which can also be derived from decoded instructions. ZydisDisasm and ZydisInfo command-line tools are included, and the official Rust and Python 3 bindings live in separate repositories.
description_zh: 轻量级 C11 x86/x86-64 反汇编与代码生成库。解码器可报告每条指令的操作数、所访问的 CPU 与 FPU 标志、ISA 集与扩展以及分支类型；格式化器可输出 Intel、MASM 或 AT&T 语法，编码器则根据编码请求生成指令，请求也可由已解码的指令转换而来。仓库附带 ZydisDisasm 与 ZydisInfo 命令行工具，官方 Rust 与 Python 3 绑定位于独立仓库。
requirements: Latest release at review: v4.1.1, published 2025-02-16 with no attached files; v4.1.0 (2024-02-04) carries the zydis-amalgamated single-header and single-source archives the README describes. The README says master holds the next, unreleased version without API stability guarantees; the reviewed master commit (2026-07-27) declares 5.0.0 and is 121 commits ahead of and 59 behind the v4.1.1 tag, so this entry pins it for documentation only.

Build with CMake 3.10+ (the README lists Windows, macOS, Linux and the BSDs), the Meson 1.3+ build file, the maintained Visual Studio 2022 project, or the amalgamated files with any C11 compiler. A recursive clone fetches the Zycore support library from its zycore-c submodule unless a system copy is forced. The README lists Arch, Debian, Ubuntu, Homebrew, NixOS and vcpkg packages, and CMake options can disable the decoder, encoder, formatter, AVX-512 or KNC support or force minimal decoding mode.

The caller supplies code bytes and selects a 16-, 32- or 64-bit machine mode; ZydisDisasm reads a raw byte file. No executable-format loader is documented, so locating code in PE, ELF or firmware images needs another tool.

MIT license; Zycore is a separate MIT-licensed zyantific repository. The README's statements about performance, dependency-free and allocation-free operation, thread safety, testing on Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, Linux and UEFI, and use in x64dbg, Firefox and WebKit were not tested; no code was decoded or encoded.

name: Sony-PMCA-RE
description_en: USB tool built from reverse engineering Sony digital cameras. On supported models it reads camera information and installs Android apps through the PlayMemories Camera Apps mechanism, while its firmware-updater and service-mode shells can dump firmware, run Linux commands and change settings. The repository's notes describe the app-installation exchange between the Sony app store, the browser plugin and the camera.
description_zh: 基于逆向 Sony 数码相机而开发的 USB 工具。在受支持的机型上，它可读取相机信息，并借助 PlayMemories Camera Apps 机制安装 Android 应用；其固件更新模式和服务模式下的 shell 可转储固件、执行 Linux 命令并调整设置。仓库中的说明文档记录了 Sony 应用商店、浏览器插件与相机之间的应用安装交互过程。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.18, published 2022-04-08, with Windows and macOS builds of the pmca-console command line and the more limited pmca-gui. The reviewed master commit, from 2022-08-18, is 22 commits ahead of it. On Linux the Python 3 sources run with the listed requirements and libusb; the CI builds use Python 3.6 and PyInstaller. As checked on 2026-10-20, the reviewed 2022-08-18 commit is still the master head, GitHub’s last recorded push was 2024-07-27, the repository is not archived and the README does not mark it as maintained, superseded or archived.

Needs a supported Sony camera connected over USB; the README links an external OpenMemories compatibility list. App installation needs a camera with PlayMemories Camera Apps support. Firmware-updater mode uses the operating system's mass-storage driver and excludes CXD90045 and CXD90057 devices, whose firmware is cryptographically signed. Service mode is console-only and needs libusb drivers on Windows; macOS mass-storage access needs Sony's camera driver.

The README calls the project an early-stage experiment based on reverse engineering and warns that it could harm the camera, with no responsibility taken. Firmware-file unpacking lives in the separate fwtool project, which was not reviewed, nor were the OpenMemories apps and framework it recommends.

MIT. The repository holds no Sony firmware or apps; the prebuilt updater payloads under updatershell/fdat are packed by pack.py from the project's own sources. No camera was connected and nothing was run.

name: QBDI
description_en: Quarkslab's modular dynamic binary instrumentation (DBI) framework, which JIT-recompiles a program's basic blocks inside its own process so that an instrumentation tool can register callbacks before or after instructions, on memory reads and writes, and on VM events. The engine is a library that can start an instrumented execution anywhere in a process, scripted from C, C++, Python (PyQBDI) or Frida JavaScript. It has no preferred injection method: it bundles the LD_PRELOAD-based QBDIPreload for Linux and macOS dynamic executables and is integrated with Frida.
description_zh: Quarkslab 开发的模块化动态二进制插桩（DBI）框架：在目标进程内部按基本块对程序进行 JIT 重编译，使插桩工具可以在指令执行前后、内存读写以及虚拟机事件上注册回调。引擎以库的形式提供，可在进程中任意位置启动插桩执行，并可通过 C、C++、Python（PyQBDI）或 Frida JavaScript 编写脚本。它不绑定特定注入方式：自带基于 LD_PRELOAD 的 QBDIPreload，用于 Linux 和 macOS 动态可执行文件，并已与 Frida 集成。
requirements: The README status table supports execution and memory-access information for x86-64 and x86 on Android, Linux, macOS and Windows, ARM on Android and Linux, and AArch64 on Android, Linux, macOS and iOS; iOS support is described as unstable and needs a jailbroken device. Latest release at review: v0.12.1, published 2026-01-07, with Android, iOS, macOS and Windows packages; Linux packages last appear in v0.12.0 (2025-10-14). PyQBDI 0.12.1 on PyPI requires Python 3.8+.

The reviewed dev-next commit is 12 commits ahead of v0.12.1; the README says all new work merges there and there is no scheduled release plan. Source builds need CMake 3.12+, Ninja or Make and a C++17 toolchain, and build a bundled LLVM statically because QBDI uses private LLVM APIs of one specific version; per-platform configuration scripts cover Linux, macOS, Windows (with a native Python 3 and Visual Studio) and Android NDK cross-compilation.

The README states that QBDI does not handle signals, new-thread creation or C++ exceptions. Its documentation adds that the instrumentation tool shares the target's heap and libraries, so non-reentrant code such as the heap allocator should be left to the execution broker outside the instrumentation range, and the OS loader itself cannot be instrumented. Users supply their own target programs and an injection route.

LICENSE.txt places QBDI under Apache-2.0 and lists statically linked components: LLVM (Apache-2.0 with LLVM exceptions), spdlog, fmtlib, Catch2, pybind11 and a GPLv3/Apache-2.0 SHA-256 implementation; GitHub could not classify the combined file. No programs were instrumented for this entry.

name: MEDUSA
description_en: Modular Frida-based framework for runtime analysis of Android and iOS apps the analyst is authorized to test. From a single coordinated script it loads plug-in modules to inspect network and WebView activity, trace API calls, examine memory and cryptographic operations, monitor malware behavior, and handle protections such as SSL pinning. The README reports it ships with over 90 reusable modules.
description_zh: 基于 Frida 的模块化框架，用于对分析者有权测试的 Android 与 iOS 应用进行运行时分析。通过单个协调脚本加载插件模块，检查网络与 WebView 活动、跟踪 API 调用、查看内存与加密操作、监控恶意软件行为，并处理 SSL 固定等保护。README 称其内置 90 多个可复用模块。
requirements: Requires Python 3 and runs on Linux or macOS, with the README noting limited functionality on Windows; a preconfigured Dockerfile is also provided.
Instrumenting a target needs a rooted device or emulator with adb and a running Frida server; the tool operates only on apps the analyst is authorized to test.

The README reports 90+ reusable modules and an optional MCP server component; it names capabilities such as SSL-pinning handling, which this record does not restate as a procedure. GPL-3.0 licensed; the repository ships the framework and its modules, no application packages.

name: binsider
description_en: Terminal user interface for inspecting ELF binaries. It shows file information and linked shared libraries in the manner of stat and ldd, browses ELF headers, notes, sections, segments, symbols, dynamic symbols and relocations much like readelf, extracts strings with an adjustable minimum length, and offers a searchable hexdump view. Optional dynamic analysis runs the binary and traces its system calls like strace, with a summary of time and call counts per system call; the interface can also be embedded as a Rust library in Ratatui applications.
description_zh: 用于查看 ELF 二进制的终端用户界面。它可像 stat 和 ldd 那样显示文件信息和所链接的共享库，像 readelf 那样浏览 ELF 头、注释、节区、段、符号、动态符号和重定位，按可调的最小长度提取字符串，并提供可搜索的十六进制视图。可选的动态分析会运行该二进制，像 strace 那样跟踪其系统调用，并按系统调用汇总耗时和调用次数；该界面还能作为 Rust 库嵌入 Ratatui 应用。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.3.2, published 2026-02-01, on crates.io and as prebuilt archives for Linux (x86_64, i686, AArch64, ARM and powerpc64le, with glibc and musl variants), macOS on Intel and Apple silicon, and Windows x86_64. The release workflow enables dynamic analysis only in the x86_64 Linux builds and the AArch64 glibc build. The reviewed main commit is six commits later and adds the --syscall-number, --string-limit and --no-abbrev trace options, which the website documents but no release includes yet.

Cargo.toml requires Rust 1.88+, although the website's installation pages still give an MSRV of 1.74.1. The dynamic-analysis feature is enabled by default and can be left out with --no-default-features. The website also documents Docker, Nix, Arch Linux and Alpine Linux installation.

Input is an ELF file chosen by the user. Dynamic analysis executes that binary on the host under ptrace-based tracing, so untrusted samples should only be traced in an isolated environment; the other views read the file without running it.
Dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. Nothing was installed or run.

name: Reverse Engineering (mytechnotalent)
description_en: A free, English lesson index by mytechnotalent that grows almost daily: 490 numbered lessons, most of which have learners write small programs and then debug and patch ("hack") them, across x86, x64, 32/64-bit ARM, RISC-V and AVR. Early courses start from number systems, registers, memory and the stack; later ones cover microcontroller firmware on Raspberry Pi Pico/Pico 2, STM32F401, ESP32-C3, ATmega328P and micro:bit boards, plus Windows, Go, Rust and WebAssembly programs. The README is a table of links; the lesson text lives in a GitBook and in the author's other repositories and PDF books.
description_zh: mytechnotalent 维护的免费英文课程索引，几乎每天更新：共 490 节编号课程，多数课程让学习者先编写小程序，再对其调试和打补丁（文中称 "hack"），覆盖 x86、x64、32/64 位 ARM、RISC-V 和 AVR。前期课程从数制、寄存器、内存和栈讲起；后期转向 Raspberry Pi Pico/Pico 2、STM32F401、ESP32-C3、ATmega328P 和 micro:bit 等开发板上的微控制器固件，以及 Windows、Go、Rust 和 WebAssembly 程序。README 本身只是链接目录，课程正文位于一个 GitBook 以及作者其他仓库中的课程文件和 PDF 书。
requirements: At reviewed commit 8ae661a (pushed 2026-10-18) the README lists 490 numbered lessons in 26 courses and headlines a dated "Today's Tutorial" (Lesson 329, 18 October 2026); the default branch has received commits on most recent days. Lesson 1 describes the x86 course as starting from the basic concepts of malware reverse engineering and working up to an entry-level look at assembly, while later courses assume that grounding. The Reverse Engineering Data course (lessons 461–490) is statistics and machine-learning notebooks, not binary analysis.

No third-party target files are needed: most courses follow a write, debug, then patch pattern on programs the learner builds from the lessons. The embedded courses need physical boards (Raspberry Pi Pico and Pico 2/RP2350, STM32F401CCU6, ESP32-C3, ATmega328P, micro:bit), and the RISC-V course says it lists everything to purchase. The repository root also keeps Fritzing schematics and a few Windows MASM/Visual Studio example projects with their Debug builds.

Toolchains are set out in the linked material rather than the README, which mentions GDB in the x86 course, a Linux install lesson and PlatformIO for the ESP32-C3. Most of lessons 1–203 point to the "Reverse Engineering For Everyone!" GitBook by @mytechnotalent (built by @0xInfection); later lessons point to PDF books and lesson files in the author's separate repositories, which move independently and are not pinned by this record.

This collection reviewed the README index and repository tree only; it did not work through lessons or review the linked books, repositories, CTFs or their licenses. The README's "Reverse Engineering Assistant" (REA) link is the author's own mytechnotalent/rea tool, not the upstream REA project, so no REA connection is established. The repository is Apache-2.0; linked books and repositories carry their own terms.

name: Co-op Anything
description_en: Agent playbook, skill set and stdio MCP server for adding online or split-screen co-op to single-player games the players already have installed. Agents either revive an existing co-op mod or reverse engineer the game and engine to build one, test it with in-game bots and send their notes back, while the MCP server searches a directory of 223 co-op projects and 32 open gaps, detects a game’s engine from its install folder and records the executable’s identity. Its README and reverse-engineering skill pair it with REA for native code, and two game write-ups report observations made through REA’s Ghidra lane.
description_zh: 为玩家已安装的单人游戏加入联机或分屏合作模式的智能体操作手册、技能集与 stdio MCP 服务器。智能体或修复已有的合作模组，或逆向分析游戏及其引擎从头实现，再用游戏内机器人测试并把笔记回馈给仓库；MCP 服务器则可检索收录 223 个合作项目和 32 处空缺的目录，根据安装目录识别游戏引擎，并记录可执行文件的身份信息。其 README 和逆向分析技能建议原生代码部分搭配 REA 使用，另有两份游戏笔记报告了借助 REA 的 Ghidra 通道得到的观察结果。
requirements: The repository was created on 2026-10-16, the reviewed commit is from 2026-10-18, and there are no releases, so the playbook, directory and reported results are changing quickly. The MCP server is a Python 3.9+ script without an SDK that needs PyYAML for its directory tools; Claude Code picks it up from .mcp.json, and the playbook gives Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor settings. The same skills ship under .agents/skills and .claude/skills.

Every player needs the game installed, and the hub holds no game files or assets. AGENTS.md tells agents to work on a copied install, ask the owner before installing software or using their accounts, and pin downloads by SHA-256. Its rules allow building on existing decompilations or decompiling a game, with that code kept in the game’s own repository under the licence of what it builds on. Analysis tools such as REA, Ghidra, IDA MCP servers, Frida, Cheat Engine, BepInEx and UE4SS are installed separately, and the playbook leaves REA’s npx rea-agents setup for the owner to run before restarting the agent.

Networking guidance uses Steam relay through Valve’s free Spacewar test app, and split-screen guidance builds on Nucleus Co-op and PartyDeck. The project rules restrict it to co-op and forbid anti-cheat bypass for online services and cheating in other people’s multiplayer games.

Results are reported by the author and contributors. The README lists Deus Ex as released and Ocarina of Time as fully synced, with other games in progress; each directory entry carries a QA level, from none through player reports and automated bot tests to a verified playthrough, and the Deus Ex write-up reports automated tests with real game clients. CI only checks that DIRECTORY.md matches data/directory.yaml. This collection reviewed documentation and the MCP source without running agents, mods or games.

MIT for the hub; MinHook source vendored in one game experiment keeps its own licence, and linked mods, decompilations, tools and games keep their own terms. The REA connection is a documented pairing for native analysis plus reported use in game notes; the MCP server itself does not call REA.

name: FISSURE
description_en: GNU Radio-based RF framework that carries a signal from survey and detection through IQ capture, inspection, conditioning, feature extraction and classification into a protocol discovery workflow. Its demodulation workspace estimates symbol rates for OOK/ASK and binary FSK recordings, and the bitstream and framing stage applies Manchester or differential decoding, sync-pattern and CRC evidence and repeated-message detection to propose message boundaries. A Qt dashboard coordinates local or remote SDR sensor nodes, a library keeps protocol and packet definitions, dissectors and archived recordings, and plugins add inspection modules such as radar pulse analysis.
description_zh: 基于 GNU Radio 的射频框架，可将信号从频谱巡查与检测，经 IQ 采集、检查、调理、特征提取和分类，一路带入协议发现流程。其解调工作区可为 OOK/ASK 和二进制 FSK 录制估计符号速率；比特流与成帧阶段则结合曼彻斯特或差分解码、同步模式与 CRC 证据以及重复报文检测，推断报文边界。Qt 仪表盘负责协调本地或远程的 SDR 传感节点，资料库保存协议与数据包定义、解析器和归档录制，插件还可加入雷达脉冲分析等检查模块。
requirements: Development happens on the Python3 branch, reviewed at its 2026-10-17 commit; the README calls GitHub releases periodic snapshots that may lack recent fixes, and the latest, Python3_20260921 (published 2026-09-29), is seven commits behind. The changelog shows protocol discovery being rebuilt in October 2026: Demodulation and Bitstream & Framing are new, Packet Analysis is a placeholder, and the older Bit Slicing, Dissectors and Sniffer tabs are hidden as obsolete, while the Read the Docs operation pages still describe the older tabs.

Installed by cloning the repository and running its interactive installer as a normal user, not with sudo, preferably on a clean system. The README lists DragonOS, Kali, Raspberry Pi OS and Ubuntu 20.04 to 24.04 with PyQt5 and GNU Radio 3.8 or 3.10 (Ubuntu 18.04 only on the deprecated Python2 branch), beta support for a few other distributions, Windows 11 through WSL2 and Apptainer images on Ubuntu 24.04. Testing is most extensive on Ubuntu, and flow graphs may need recompiling across GNU Radio versions.

Live capture needs a supported SDR such as a USRP, HackRF, RTL2832U, LimeSDR, bladeRF, PlutoSDR or SDRplay receiver; the README says hardware support is being migrated into the plugin architecture, so not every legacy integration works in every workflow. Offline analysis uses the analyst's own IQ or SigMF recordings.

GPL-3.0; GNU Radio out-of-tree blocks come from git submodules under their own licenses. The framework also includes transmit, packet-crafting, fuzzing and attack workflows, plus geolocation, targeting and TAK sharing for distributed operations, which this entry does not cover. No installation, capture or transmission was performed.

name: Android Unpinner
description_en: Tool from the mitmproxy project that removes certificate pinning from an Android APK you own or are authorized to test, without a rooted device. It marks the app debuggable, touching only AndroidManifest.xml, and injects a Frida Gadget over ADB so an interception proxy can read the app's traffic, reusing HTTP Toolkit's unpinning script. It bundles the Android SDK helpers it needs and can also handle split APKs delivered as XAPK.
description_zh: 来自 mitmproxy 项目的工具，可在无需 root 的情况下移除使用者拥有或有权测试的 Android APK 的证书固定。它将应用标记为可调试（仅改动 AndroidManifest.xml），并通过 ADB 注入 Frida Gadget，复用 HTTP Toolkit 的解固定脚本，使检查代理能够读取应用流量。工具自带所需的 Android SDK 辅助程序，并可处理以 XAPK 形式提供的分包。
requirements: Installed with uv or pip and requires Python 3.10+ (pyproject version 1.0); the target device connects to a desktop over USB/ADB, and the tool bundles the adb, apksigner, zipalign and aapt2 helpers for Windows, Linux and macOS.
Patches the target APK and needs active instrumentation from the desktop each time the app launches, so rooting the device is not required; intended only for apps you own or are authorized to test.

The README states the project's own code is MIT-licensed, with no separate LICENSE file for GitHub to detect; bundled components keep their own licenses, including HTTP Toolkit's unpinning script (AGPL-3.0), the Frida gadgets (wxWindows Library Licence) and Android build/platform tools. The repository also ships HTTP Toolkit's open-source SSL-pinning demo APK (Apache-2.0) as a test target.

name: cpu_rec
description_en: Statistically recognize the CPU instruction set in an arbitrary binary file, such as an unknown firmware image, by comparing Markov-chain byte statistics with a default corpus covering dozens of architectures, from 6502 and 8051 to ARM, MIPS, PowerPC, RISC-V, x86-64 and WebAssembly. It reports a match for the whole file, then the largest chunk that matches one architecture, and shows entropy so that encrypted or compressed regions can be discounted. It runs standalone, as a Python function or as a binwalk module.
description_zh: 对任意二进制文件（例如来历不明的固件镜像）中的 CPU 指令集进行统计识别：把字节的马尔可夫链统计与默认语料库比较，语料库涵盖数十种架构，从 6502、8051 到 ARM、MIPS、PowerPC、RISC-V、x86-64 和 WebAssembly。它先给出整个文件的匹配结果，再找出与单一架构匹配的最大数据块，并显示熵值，以便排除加密或压缩区域。可独立运行，也可作为 Python 函数或 binwalk 模块使用。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.1, published 2024-03-19 and tagged at the reviewed commit; it adds an optional pickled corpus for faster startup and LIEF as an alternative to elfesteem. There is no package: cpu_rec.py and the cpu_rec_corpus directory are copied into the same directory. As checked on 2026-10-20, nothing has been pushed since v1.1 and the repository is not archived; the README’s Development status section holds only CI badges and does not mark the project as maintained, superseded or archived.

Runs on Python 3 or Python 2; the portability workflow covers Python 3.10, PyPy 2.7 and 3.9 and GraalPy on Ubuntu and macOS. Without the lzma module the .xz corpus files must be decompressed first. Optional elfesteem or LIEF extracts the text section of ELF, PE, Mach-O or COFF files. The README reports about one minute of analysis per MB, and 1 GB of RAM to build signatures for 70 architectures, on the author's laptop.

Binwalk mode installs into binwalk's module directory and needs a binwalk that includes devttys0/binwalk pull request 241; these instructions point to the earlier Python binwalk, and compatibility with the current Rust-based v3 was not checked.

Results are heuristic: the README warns that files can contain several architectures, small chunks can be misdetected, and results for data with entropy above 0.9 are probably meaningless. 78k and TriCore are left out of the default corpus for licensing reasons and can only be added from the user's own binaries.

cpu_rec.py is Apache-2.0. The README describes the default corpus as a composite of code chunks under their own licenses, mostly from Debian, BusyBox, C-Kermit and the author's own cross-compiled open-source builds, plus a few of unknown license, including an H8S binary distributed by Dell; build_default_corpus records each origin. No files were analyzed.

name: iced
description_en: x86 instruction library for 16-, 32- and 64-bit code that decodes, formats, assembles and encodes instructions, with masm, nasm, GNU AT&T and Intel XED output syntaxes. Its instruction-info API reports the registers, memory operands and RFLAGS bits an instruction reads or writes, its CPUID feature flags and control-flow type, and the encoder can re-encode decoded instructions at any address. Rust, C# (.NET) and Java implementations live in one repository, with Python, JavaScript (WebAssembly) and Lua bindings built on the Rust crate.
description_zh: 面向 16、32 和 64 位 x86 代码的指令库，可解码、格式化、汇编和编码指令，输出支持 masm、nasm、GNU AT&T 和 Intel XED 语法。其指令信息 API 可报告指令读写的寄存器、内存操作数和 RFLAGS 标志位，以及所需的 CPUID 特性标志和控制流类型；编码器还能把已解码的指令重新编码到任意地址。同一仓库维护 Rust、C#（.NET）和 Java 三套实现，另有基于 Rust crate 的 Python、JavaScript（WebAssembly）和 Lua 绑定。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.21.0, published 2024-01-20, distributed as iced-x86 on crates.io, PyPI, npm and Maven Central (group io.github.icedland.iced) and as iced on NuGet. The reviewed master commit (2026-07-14) is 340 commits ahead of that tag, with no newer release, and still declares version 1.21.0; this entry pins it for documentation only.

The Rust crate needs rustc 1.64.0+, supports no_std and WebAssembly, and uses Cargo features to select the decoder, encoder, block encoder, instruction info, each formatter and the optional code assembler. The .NET library targets .NET Standard 2.0/2.1 and .NET Framework 4.5, and the Java library needs Java 8+. PyPI ships Windows, macOS and Linux wheels, and source builds need Rust and Python 3.8+; the JavaScript package is built with wasm-pack, and the Lua binding is built from source with Rust, luarocks and Lua 5.1+.

The caller supplies raw code bytes, the bitness and the instruction pointer. The reviewed documentation describes no executable-format parsing or function discovery, so a loader or format library has to locate code first. Knights Corner MVEX instructions need the mvex feature and the KNC decoder option.

MIT license. The README reports that all instructions are tested, that iced was tested against xed, gas, objdump, masm, dumpbin, nasm and ndisasm and fuzzed, and Rust throughput above 250 MB/s for decoding and 130 MB/s for decoding plus formatting in its disas-bench results. None of this was reproduced; no code was decoded or assembled.

name: apk-mitm
description_en: Command-line tool that prepares an Android APK you own or are authorized to test for HTTPS traffic inspection. It decodes the package with Apktool, adjusts the network security configuration to trust user-added certificates, disables certificate pinning, then re-encodes and signs the patched APK, so a proxy can read the app's traffic without a rooted device. App bundles supplied as .xapk or .apks are also supported.
description_zh: 命令行工具，为使用者拥有或有权测试的 Android APK 准备 HTTPS 流量检查。它用 Apktool 解码安装包、调整网络安全配置以信任用户添加的证书、关闭证书固定，再重新编码并签名修补后的 APK，使代理无需 root 设备即可读取应用流量。也支持以 .xapk 或 .apks 形式提供的应用捆绑包。
requirements: Installed from npm as a global CLI and requires Node.js 14+ and Java 8+ per the README; patching app bundles on Linux also needs zip and unzip available.

Operates on an APK or app bundle the analyst supplies and is intended only for apps you own or are authorized to test; rooting the device is not required because the changes are applied statically before install.

The README notes the static Apktool-based approach can fail on large or complex apps and cannot address certificate pinning enforced inside native binaries such as Flutter. MIT licensed; the repository ships the tool only, no application packages.

As checked on 2026-10-20, the latest release, v1.3.0 (2024-04-21, also the latest npm version), is the reviewed commit and still the main head; GitHub’s last recorded push was 2024-07-24, the repository is not archived and the README does not mark it as maintained, superseded or archived.

name: friTap
description_en: Frida-based tool that hooks TLS libraries such as OpenSSL, BoringSSL, NSS and GnuTLS inside a running process and writes NSS key logs and decrypted payloads as PCAP, so analysts can inspect an application's encrypted traffic in Wireshark. For stripped or statically linked libraries it accepts byte patterns or offsets and can scan for renamed libraries, or it can recover TLS secrets by scanning heap memory instead of hooking. A terminal UI, a Python API and a Wireshark extcap integration wrap the same capture.
description_zh: 基于 Frida 的工具，在运行中的进程内挂钩 OpenSSL、BoringSSL、NSS、GnuTLS 等 TLS 库，输出 NSS 格式的密钥日志和解密后的 PCAP 明文，便于分析者在 Wireshark 中检查应用的加密流量。对于去除符号或静态链接的库，可通过字节模式或偏移量定位函数、扫描被重命名的库，也可不挂钩而改为扫描堆内存来恢复 TLS 密钥。终端界面、Python API 和 Wireshark extcap 集成都基于同一套捕获功能。
requirements: Latest release at review: v2.5.2, uploaded to PyPI on 2026-09-29 and published on GitHub on 2026-10-04; the reviewed main commit is identical to that tag. The README describes Linux, Windows and Android as supported and macOS and iOS as partial and still under development, and says the Windows implementations were verified only on Windows 10.

Installed with pip as fritap on Python 3.10+. friTap 2.x requires frida 17.x and frida-tools 14.x; devices with an older frida-server need a legacy friTap line installed through the documented constraints files. Mobile apps need a frida-server running on the device, and the Android walkthrough uses a rooted phone or emulator with adb in PATH; the desktop example attaches with sudo. libpcap or Npcap is needed only for full packet capture, and live Wireshark piping works only on Linux and macOS.

Analysts name the process or app package to attach to or spawn. Coverage differs by library and platform: the README's support table marks many combinations as read/write hooks only, keys only or not yet implemented, so plaintext captures can be incomplete. Byte patterns for statically linked BoringSSL can come from the authors' separate BoringSecretHunter tool, which analyzes the user's own copy of the library.

GPL-3.0; setup.py declares GPL-3.0-only while its inline comment says GPLv3 or later. The README presents the tool for malware analysis and application privacy research and asks users to cite the authors' 2024 Forensic Science International: Digital Investigation paper on TLS key material extraction. No process was hooked and no traffic was captured.

name: hrtng
description_en: IDA plugin published by Kaspersky that extends the Hex-Rays decompiler with tools its author collected for reverse-engineering work, including malware analysis. It decrypts strings, data and constants with built-in ciphers or in bulk through IDA's Appcall debugger feature, resolves API-name hashes, unflattens control flow and forces decompilation of obfuscated code, and recognizes library code through microcode signatures, inlined-function detection and PAT files built from an IDA database. Pseudocode helpers cover automatic renaming, retyping and enum substitution, structure creation, virtual and indirect call navigation, and patching.
description_zh: Kaspersky 发布的 IDA 插件，为 Hex-Rays 反编译器加入了作者在包括恶意软件分析在内的逆向工作中积累的各类工具。它可用内置密码算法解密字符串、数据和常量，或借助 IDA 的 Appcall 调试器功能批量解密；还能识别 API 名称哈希、消除控制流平坦化并强制反编译混淆代码，并通过微码签名、内联函数检测和从 IDA 数据库生成的 PAT 文件识别库代码。伪代码辅助功能包括自动重命名、类型修改和枚举替换、结构体创建、虚函数与间接调用导航以及补丁。
requirements: Requires IDA with the Hex-Rays decompiler. The README supports only the latest IDA version; the plugin can still be compiled against IDA SDK 7.3 or later, but new features are usually not well tested on older versions. Latest release at review: v3.9.114, published 2026-09-02, with prebuilt archives for IDA 9.2, 9.3 and 9.4 plus a separate 7z archive; the reviewed master commit is one changelog fix ahead and declares 3.9.115 in ida-plugin.json.

The CI workflow builds Linux x64, macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) and Windows x64 binaries, and Linux ARM for IDA 9.3 and 9.4. Source builds use CMake with the Crypto++ CMake submodule and an IDA SDK whose path and version are set in src/CMakeLists.txt; the README gives manual SDK fixes for 8.5 and 9.1. The apilist.txt and literal.txt files from bin/plugins must sit beside the plugin for API-hash scanning and enum substitution.

Samples and IDA databases come from the analyst. The Appcall engine for mass decryption runs the analyzed program's own decryption routine under the selected IDA debugger, and its documentation reports testing only with the imul emulator and IDA's Remote Windows debugger. Obfuscated-code decompilation and inline detection are described as experimental.

GPL-3.0. NOTICE.txt lists bundled third-party code and its licenses, including Crypto++ 8.9.0 under the Boost Software License 1.0, used for ciphers such as RC4, AES and ChaCha20, and MIT-licensed GraphSlick and microavx code. Nothing was built, installed or run.

name: Frida Mobile Interception Scripts
description_en: A set of Frida scripts from HTTP Toolkit for inspecting a mobile app's HTTPS traffic while analysing apps you own or are authorized to test. Injected into a running Android or iOS app, they redirect its connections to an interception proxy, add a user-supplied CA certificate to the trust stores, and disable certificate pinning and transparency checks so the proxy can read the traffic. Individual scripts can also be used on their own to hook specific behaviour.
description_zh: 来自 HTTP Toolkit 的一组 Frida 脚本，用于在分析自有或经授权测试的应用时检查移动应用的 HTTPS 流量。将其注入运行中的 Android 或 iOS 应用后，可把连接重定向到检查代理、将用户提供的 CA 证书加入信任库，并关闭证书固定与证书透明度检查，使代理能够读取流量。各脚本也可单独使用以挂钩特定行为。
