requirements: Delivered as Frida scripts injected into a target app with the Frida CLI; the README's Android workflow requires a rooted device or emulator running frida-server as root, and the iOS workflow requires a jailbroken device with Frida installed.

The analyst supplies their own interception proxy and CA certificate and edits config.js before use; the scripts are intended only for mobile apps you own or are authorized to test, not for circumventing protections on third-party software.
AGPL-3.0 licensed and funded by NLnet as part of the HTTP Toolkit project; the repository ships scripts only and no application packages.

name: BinCAT
description_en: Static binary code analysis toolkit designed for reverse engineers. Starting from a chosen address and initial state, it computes register and memory values, taint and reconstructed types, with forward and backward analysis and heap use-after-free and double-free detection; bits it cannot determine are shown as unknown. It is driven from an IDA plugin, where analysts can override values or taint, skip functions or replace instructions with NOPs before re-running, or from Python and an .ini configuration for automation.
description_zh: 面向逆向工程人员的二进制代码静态分析工具包。它从选定的地址和初始状态出发，计算寄存器与内存的值、污点和重建出的类型，支持前向与后向分析，并能检测堆上的释放后使用和重复释放；无法确定的位会标为未知。分析可在 IDA 插件中进行，分析人员可覆盖值或污点、跳过函数或把指令替换为 NOP 后重新运行；也可通过 Python 和 .ini 配置文件实现自动化。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.5, published 2025-02-25; its tag is the reviewed master commit, and the repository has had no commits since. The Linux and Windows release archives bundle the analyzer and the IDA plugin, which is installed by running install_plugin.py from IDA. The plugin requires IDA 7.4 or later with Python 3; the changelog adds IDA 8.3 support in v1.3 and IDA 9.0 support in v1.4.

The README lists x86-32, x86-64, ARMv7, ARMv8 and PowerPC as analysis targets; the changelog also records initial RISC-V and initial, incomplete ARMv7 Thumb support. The analyzer runs locally on Linux or Windows (macOS only “maybe”, per the README) or as a Flask web service in the airbusseclab/bincat Docker image that the plugin reaches through its remote URL option. Source builds need OCaml with dune, menhir, ocamlgraph, ppxlib and zarith plus Python 3; Windows builds use Cygwin and an opam mingw64 OCaml switch.

Each analysis is described by a versioned .ini file covering the program, its sections and imports, the initial register and memory state and overrides; the IDA plugin generates it from the open database, ELF core dumps can supply the initial state, and the format documentation is partial, with the parser source as its reference. Binaries to analyze come from the user; the tutorial uses the project’s own keygen-me sample.

AGPL-3.0 per the README and doc/COPYING; GitHub detects no license because there is no root license file. The OCaml code includes LGPLv2 OCaml runtime code, the plugin includes Apache-2.0 code from python-pyqt5-hexview, and a modified copy of c2newspeak is bundled. Results depend on the configured initial state, skipped functions and overrides; nothing was installed or analyzed.

name: pbtk
description_en: Recover Protobuf message definitions from compiled programs as readable .proto files. Extractors cover the Java runtimes in JAR, DEX and APK files (including ProGuard-obfuscated code), binaries that embed Protobuf reflection metadata, and web apps using the Protobuf-URL format. A GUI then binds a recovered message type to an HTTP endpoint, decodes hex-encoded captured samples into an editable field tree and resends edited messages, so analysts can relate each field to the response.
description_zh: 从已编译程序中恢复 Protobuf 消息定义，并还原为可读的 .proto 文件。提取器覆盖 JAR、DEX 和 APK 中的各类 Java 运行时（包括经 ProGuard 混淆的代码）、内嵌 Protobuf 反射元数据的二进制文件，以及使用 Protobuf-URL 格式的 Web 应用。随后可在图形界面中把恢复出的消息类型绑定到 HTTP 端点，将十六进制形式的抓包样本解码为可编辑的字段树，并重新发送修改后的消息，帮助分析者把每个字段与响应对应起来。
requirements: Latest release at review: 1.1.3, published 2026-08-21 on GitHub and PyPI; the reviewed master commit is four commits ahead of it, adding a version display, a dependency bump and new brand colors, and carries a 1.1.3.1 tag with no GitHub release or PyPI upload. The README's 2026 notes say Java extraction now works mostly with older APKs and the Chrome-based Protobuf-URL web extractor needs an update; finishing the automatic fuzzing part is listed as forthcoming.

Requires Python 3.10+, PySide6 and the Python protobuf runtime. The README documents a snap for Ubuntu, the pbtk-git AUR package, and uv or pipx installs, and says Windows is supported. Java extraction needs a Java runtime (the Debian instructions install OpenJDK 8), and web extraction drives a Chrome or Chromium instance through websocket-client.

Analysts supply the APK, JAR, DEX or native library to analyze and, optionally, hex-encoded request samples they captured themselves with a proxy such as mitmproxy or Wireshark. Replay sends the edited messages to the live endpoint the analyst configures. Extracted .protos and endpoint definitions are stored in a .pbtk folder in the home directory (a pbtk folder under APPDATA on Windows).

GPL-3.0-or-later per pyproject.toml. The package bundles third-party executables: protoc builds, dex2jar 2.4 jars with their Apache-2.0 notice, and JAD decompiler binaries for which the repository includes no license text. Definitions recovered from minified code keep obfuscated names until the analyst renames them; no application was analyzed and no requests were sent.

name: reFlutter
description_en: Flutter reverse-engineering framework for apps the analyst is authorized to inspect. It repacks an app with a prebuilt patched Dart engine, or instruments the app's own engine at runtime, to emit a JSONL dump of every function's name, class, library and code offset into the Dart instructions image for Frida or IDA/Ghidra work. It can also route the app's HTTPS traffic through an inspection proxy with Flutter certificate pinning disabled.
description_zh: 面向分析者有权检查的应用的 Flutter 逆向框架。它通过替换为预编译的已打补丁 Dart 引擎（repack 模式）或在运行时插桩应用自带引擎（attach 模式），导出包含每个函数名称、类、库以及其在 Dart 指令镜像中代码偏移的 JSONL 清单，供 Frida 或 IDA/Ghidra 使用。它还能在关闭 Flutter 证书固定的情况下，将应用的 HTTPS 流量路由到检查代理。
requirements: Installed from PyPI as reflutter (setup.py marks version 0.9.8 and requires Python 3.10+) and runs on Linux, Windows or macOS; the README notes a repacked APK must be re-signed and zip-aligned with an external signer before install.

The README lists support for Android arm64, arm32 and x64 and iOS arm64 across release and profile builds on the stable and beta channels, with engine coverage keyed by snapshot hash in enginehash.csv; pre-monorepo engines (<= 3.27) are built from the archived flutter/engine repository. Frida hooking and dump collection need a matching frida-server on the target device or emulator.
Intended for Flutter applications the analyst owns or is authorized to inspect. GPL-3.0 licensed; the project ships tooling and prebuilt engine assets but no application packages.

name: ddc
description_en: Rust decompiler that turns Android DEX bytecode, versions 035 to 041, from APKs, multi-dex apps and XAPK/APKS/APKM containers into Java, folding lambdas and string concatenation back into Java syntax and giving locals jadx-style names. By default every file also goes through a source-level cleanup pass, described as semantics-preserving, that inlines copy chains, recovers ternaries and for-each loops and drops dead stores; --fast skips it. Alongside full decompilation, 15 query subcommands return app and manifest information, resources, strings, cross-references, class hierarchies, disassembly or single classes and methods on demand, and the same queries are served over REST and MCP.
description_zh: 用 Rust 编写的反编译器，可将 APK、多 DEX 应用以及 XAPK/APKS/APKM 容器中 035 至 041 版本的 Android DEX 字节码转换为 Java，把 lambda 和字符串拼接还原为 Java 语法，并按 jadx 的风格为局部变量命名。默认情况下，每个文件还会经过一道据称保持语义的源码级整理，内联拷贝链、恢复三元表达式和 for-each 循环并删除无用赋值；--fast 可跳过这一步。除完整反编译外，15 个查询子命令可按需返回应用与清单信息、资源、字符串、交叉引用、类层次结构、反汇编以及单个类或方法，同样的查询也可通过 REST 和 MCP 提供。
requirements: Release at review: v0.1.30, published 2026-10-18, which is the reviewed main commit. The repository was created in September 2026 and releases come quickly (v0.1.28 to v0.1.30 within eight days). Releases ship raw binaries for Linux, Windows and macOS on x86_64 and ARM64, the non-macOS builds UPX-compressed, and Homebrew, Scoop and cargo-binstall install them; source builds use stable Rust and the author's jdc-core, cure and xyz-rust crates.

Input is an APK, app container or DEX file from the user's own app; full decompilation writes an <input>-out directory next to the input by default. ddc serve and ddc http default to the listen address :8080, with no host given, and bearer-token authentication is optional; ddc mcp stdio runs as an agent subprocess.

The README reports that all 909,689 files emitted for seven benchmark APKs, and docs/validation.md that 4.08 million files from 39 apps, pass javac's parse phase; this is a syntax check only. Known limitations include erased generic types, separate d8-desugared lambda classes, timeouts on some very large R8 methods whose output can vary between runs, and desugared pattern switches; a full-classpath javac run still finds about 7,500 ddc-attributable errors across 0.91 million files, roughly twice jadx's count on the same set.

CI builds and runs cargo test on Linux, macOS and Windows. The benchmark APKs are not in the repository; its fixtures are small DEX files and one binary AndroidManifest. MIT license. No apps were decompiled and the servers were not run.

name: ME Analyzer
description_en: Parse Intel Management Engine (CS)ME, TXE and SPS firmware, Graphics System Controller firmware and their independent PMC, PCHC, PHY and option-ROM images to report family, version, release, SKU, platform, size and health status. Research options print flash partition, BPDT/IFWI and CSE layout tables, validate RSA signatures and checksums, and unpack the supported CSE and GSC code and file systems. A bundled database identifies known images and reports those not yet listed in the community firmware repositories.
description_zh: 解析 Intel 管理引擎 (CS)ME、TXE 和 SPS 固件、图形系统控制器（GSC）固件，以及与之配套的独立 PMC、PCHC、PHY 和 Option ROM 镜像，报告系列、版本、发布类型、SKU、平台、大小和健康状态。研究用参数可显示 Flash 分区表、BPDT/IFWI 和 CSE 布局表，校验 RSA 签名与校验和，并解包所支持的 CSE、GSC 代码及文件系统。附带的数据库能识别已知镜像，并报告社区固件仓库尚未收录的镜像。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.312.0 with database r378 (tag v1.312.0-r378), published 2026-09-06 at the reviewed commit, with no attached builds. The README describes the tool as the MEA.py script plus its bundled MEA.dat, Huffman.dat and FileTable.dat databases, and says MEA.dat is required to run.
Requires Python 3.7+, which the script checks at startup, and the third-party colorama, crccheck and pltable modules. The README lists Windows, Linux and macOS hosts; the script also accepts BSD.

Input is an Intel Engine, Graphics or Independent firmware image the user already has, given as files or scanned from a directory with -mass. The README lists ME 2-15, TXE 0-4, SPS 1-5, GSC 100 (DG1) and selected PMC, PCHC, PHY and OROM generations, and states that any family or version not listed is unsupported, with no plans to add others.

By default the script contacts GitHub to compare its version and database with the latest ones (-duc disables this) and copies any input that triggers a note, warning or error into a __CHECK__ folder in the output directory (-dcm disables this).
BSD-2-Clause-Patent. The README describes parsing, validation and unpacking, not rebuilding or modifying images; reported details depend on the bundled database. No firmware was analyzed.

name: DeepExtract (DeepExtractIDA)
description_en: IDA Pro 9.x plugin and PowerShell batch extractor that turn Windows PE files into material AI coding agents can read: a per-binary SQLite database of PE metadata, signatures, disassembly, Hex-Rays pseudocode, cross-references, strings, stack frames, loops and dangerous API calls, plus optional grouped C++ and assembly files with per-function caller, callee and string headers and JSON indexes. It runs headless over directories, file lists or the modules of a running process, or interactively on the open IDA database, keeping the analyst’s renames and comments. The agent commands that work on this output come from the separate DeepExtractRuntime project.
description_zh: IDA Pro 9.x 插件与 PowerShell 批量提取脚本，可把 Windows PE 文件转换为 AI 编程智能体能够读取的材料：每个二进制文件对应一个 SQLite 数据库，内含 PE 元数据、函数签名、反汇编、Hex-Rays 伪代码、交叉引用、字符串、栈帧、循环与危险 API 调用；还可选择输出分组的 C++ 与汇编文件，每个函数附带调用者、被调者与字符串信息头，并生成 JSON 索引。它可以无界面地处理目录、文件列表或正在运行进程加载的模块，也可以在已打开的 IDA 数据库上交互运行，并保留分析者所做的重命名和注释。处理这些输出的智能体命令来自独立的 DeepExtractRuntime 项目。
requirements: The reviewed main commit is the v0.9.14 release of 2026-09-12; ida-plugin.json lists IDA 9.0 to 9.3 on Windows x86-64, and the plugin installs with Hex-Rays’ hcli or runs from a clone. The README requires Windows 10 or 11 and IDA Pro 9.x, with the Pro edition for headless mode. The Hex-Rays decompiler is needed only for pseudocode and C++ output, while assembly output works from disassembly alone. pefile is vendored; the batch script also checks for Python on PATH and needs symchk.exe from the Windows SDK Debugging Tools for its default PDB download from Microsoft’s public symbol server.

Users supply the PE files, from single binaries to whole directories such as System32 or the modules loaded by a running process. The README warns that large batches can run for days and produce tens to hundreds of gigabytes. Outputs contain disassembly and decompiled code of the analysed binaries, whose own licences still apply.

The extractor calls no model. With -EnableAI, the batch extractor writes a CLAUDE.md that tells the agent, without asking the user, to clone the DeepExtractRuntime repository’s default branch into .claude and install Cursor rules and hooks; that runtime and its agents are not part of this repository.

Vtable and indirect-call resolution are labelled experimental, with stated limits such as a single vtable at object offset 0 and a short intra-procedural instruction window. Tests load IDA-independent modules such as the schema, configuration and code formatters outside IDA, and the release workflow only packages the plugin. This collection reviewed source and documentation without running IDA or the extractor.

MIT, with the vendored pefile under its own MIT licence; IDA Pro, the Hex-Rays decompiler and the Windows SDK tools are licensed separately. The README presents the output for AI-assisted vulnerability research, reverse engineering, threat hunting and code review. The reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: Simplify
description_en: Generic Android deobfuscator built on smalivm, a sandboxed Dalvik virtual machine that executes each method and records every possible register and class value along all execution paths, taking both branches when a value such as file or network input is unknown. Simplify then repeatedly applies constant propagation, dead-code removal, unreflection and peephole optimizations to the APK or DEX, which can decrypt strings and remove reflection while keeping behaviour the same; it does not rename classes or methods. smalivm can also be used as a library, and the last release adds sdbg, a step-through Smali debugger built on it.
description_zh: 基于 smalivm 的通用 Android 反混淆工具。smalivm 是一个沙箱化的 Dalvik 虚拟机，会逐个执行方法并记录所有执行路径上可能的寄存器与类取值；遇到文件或网络输入等未知值时，两个分支都会执行。Simplify 随后对 APK 或 DEX 反复进行常量传播、死代码删除、反射还原和窥孔优化，可在保持行为不变的前提下解密字符串、去除反射；它不会重命名类或方法。smalivm 也可作为库使用，最新发布版还附带基于它的单步 Smali 调试器 sdbg。
requirements: Development is inactive: the latest release, v1.3.0 of 2020-03-30, ships simplify, smalivm and sdbg jars, and the reviewed master commit dates from 2021-05-23. The project pins smali/dexlib2 2.4.0 and, by default, builds its Android framework reference from android-25 classes, so check results on apps that use newer DEX or API features.

Run it as java -jar simplify.jar on a user-supplied APK or DEX. Building needs JDK 8, a recursive clone for the AndroidFrameworkSmali submodule of reference framework classes, and the Gradle fatjar task. Execution limits on visits, call depth and time apply per method; the README advises narrowing large apps with include and exclude patterns, and output DEX defaults to API level 15.

--remove-weak, on by default, removes code even when it has weak side effects, and --ignore-errors may lead to unexpected behaviour, so compare output with the original code. The repository includes a project-provided obfuscated example app for testing; tests ran through a Travis CI configuration using Oracle JDK 8, the repository has no GitHub Actions workflow, and nothing was run in this review.

Dual-licensed: GPL-3.0 for open-source use, or a commercial license that permits binary distribution without source redistribution. Android framework classes and dependencies keep their own terms. The reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: GDA (GJoy Dex Analyzer)
description_en: Windows-native Dalvik decompiler and Android analysis workbench written in C++ that opens APK, DEX, ODEX, OAT, JAR, AAR and class files without installation. Besides Java and Smali views with cross-references, renaming and comments, it identifies packers, deobfuscates and decrypts strings, tracks data flow and taint, solves paths, runs rule-based malicious-behaviour, vulnerability and privacy-leak scans, and can dump device memory or hook methods with Frida. Shell and server CLI modes, Python and Java scripting and a sample malware-triage agent skill expose the same analysis to scripts and agents.
description_zh: 以 C++ 编写、原生运行于 Windows 的 Dalvik 反编译器与 Android 分析工作台，无需安装即可打开 APK、DEX、ODEX、OAT、JAR、AAR 和 class 文件。除带交叉引用、重命名和注释的 Java 与 Smali 视图外，它还能识别加固壳、反混淆并解密字符串、追踪数据流与污点、求解路径，运行基于规则的恶意行为、漏洞和隐私泄露扫描，并可转储设备内存或用 Frida 钩挂方法。Shell 与服务器两种命令行模式、Python 和 Java 脚本以及一个恶意软件分诊智能体技能示例，让脚本和智能体也能调用这些分析功能。
requirements: Releases are Windows-only zip archives; the latest, GDA 4.12 of 2026-04-07, adds shell and server CLI modes among fixes. The repository holds no decompiler source: the README says GDA is not an open-source project, at least in the short term, and the repository publishes the free binaries with open scripts, plugin examples, rule samples and colour themes.

The executable runs without setup. Dex-family inputs need no Java, while JAR, AAR and class files need a working Java runtime for the bundled dx tool. The README says GDA is protected with VMProtect and unpacks embedded adb, a gdump memory-dump helper and rule files into the user’s application-data folder, which some antivirus products flag; the author states it has no malicious behaviour.

The skills folder holds a gda-analyze skill in Claude Code’s format that drives a bundled GDA.exe through a Python wrapper to trace code, extract indicators and draft malware reports, plus a server-mode client and test script. Its output, like the built-in rule-based scans, needs manual confirmation; this review ran no part of GDA.

LICENSE is Apache-2.0, and NOTICE says most of GDA is released under it, with adb and dex libraries taken from the Android SDK and AOSP; this conflicts with the README’s closed-source statement, so the binaries’ terms are unclear. Users supply the apps they analyze. The reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: GEF (GDB Enhanced Features)
description_en: Single-file Python extension, gef.py, that adds dynamic-analysis commands to GDB. Each stop shows a context view of registers, stack, code, threads and call trace, and commands cover memory maps, pointer dereferencing, searching process memory for patterns, ELF and security-property information, process status and glibc heap inspection. An architecture abstraction layer covers x86-32/64, ARMv5–v7, AArch64, SPARC, MIPS and PowerPC, and gef-remote enriches remote sessions through gdbserver or the GDB stubs of qemu-user and qemu-system.
description_zh: 单文件 Python 扩展 gef.py，为 GDB 增加动态分析命令。每次程序停下时都会显示寄存器、栈、代码、线程和调用轨迹等上下文视图，命令涵盖内存映射、指针解引用、在进程内存中搜索模式、ELF 与安全属性信息、进程状态以及 glibc 堆检查。其架构抽象层覆盖 x86-32/64、ARMv5–v7、AArch64、SPARC、MIPS 和 PowerPC；gef-remote 命令可通过 gdbserver 或 qemu-user、qemu-system 的 GDB stub 增强远程调试会话。
requirements: Needs GDB 10.0+ built with Python 3.10+, the baseline since GEF 2025.01 in the compatibility table, plus file, readelf, nm, ps and python3 on the host; Python 2 users are pointed to the separate gef-legacy. The README installs it by downloading gef.py, through an install script or manually, and sourcing it from the user's .gdbinit file.

Release at review: 2026.01, published 2026-02-02 without binary assets; the reviewed main commit is 12 commits ahead, adding glibc 2.42/2.43 heap support and removing unmaintained commands. More commands live in the separate GEF-Extras repository, which was not reviewed.

GEF relies on the GDB API and Linux-specific sources such as /proc/<pid>, so some features may not work on custom or hardened systems, and heap commands support only the glibc allocator. qemu mode needs a local copy of the debugged binary because QEMU's GDB stub cannot transfer files. The README aims it at exploit developers and reverse engineers; this entry covers its debugging and inspection use.
MIT license. Tests run with pytest under the Python version GDB was built against. No debugging sessions were run.

name: Z0FCourse Reverse Engineering
description_en: A free English course by Z0F on reverse engineering 64-bit Windows programs, which its README pitches as taking learners from beginner to intermediate. Markdown lessons move from number systems, x64 registers, memory layout and calling conventions to x64dbg and Ghidra, then reverse small samples and an author-written DLL, recovering a Player class and calling the DLL's exports from a program of one's own. The unfinished later chapters introduce Windows internals and reverse ntdll's generic-table functions.
description_zh: Z0F 编写的免费英文课程，讲解如何逆向 64 位 Windows 程序，README 称目标是帮助学习者从入门进阶到中级。Markdown 课程从数制、x64 寄存器、内存布局和调用约定讲起，过渡到 x64dbg 与 Ghidra，再逆向若干小样本以及作者自己编写的 DLL，还原其中的 Player 类，并在自己编写的程序中调用该 DLL 的导出函数。尚未完成的后续章节介绍 Windows 内部机制，并逆向 ntdll 中的 generic table 系列函数。
requirements: Reviewed at commit ee4b070 (2026-07-25). Most lessons were written in 2019–2020, and the table of contents marks Chapter 7 (Windows) and Chapter 8 (Generic Table) as work in progress; the .NET and other-architecture material promised by the setup and Before You Begin pages is not in the tree. Later commits are small fixes, formatting, refreshed PDF copies and new links. The README points to two TryHackMe rooms as an interactive version of chapters 1–6.

Chapter 1 lists a good understanding of C/C++, object-oriented programming and pointers as prerequisites and highly recommends prior x86/x64 assembly. The course needs a 64-bit Windows system, a virtual machine being optional until the malware material; setup names the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable, x64dbg (with the optional xAnalyzer plugin) and dnSpy or ILSpy as required, with Ghidra and Visual Studio highly recommended.

The target programs are the author's own and ship with their source in FilesNeeded: the Chapter 6 DLL with two host programs and debug symbols, plus a sample malware program and dropper for a chapter not yet written, which FilesNeeded marks as use-at-your-own-risk. Chapter 8 instead analyzes Windows's own ntdll.dll, which is not included. PDF copies of the chapters are also committed, and the README warns they may lag the Markdown lessons.

The repository's License.md is the AGPL-3.0 text; the FAQ adds that downloading is allowed for personal use only and defers redistribution and teaching use to the license. This collection read the README, setup, table of contents, FilesNeeded notes, FAQ and license at the reviewed commit; it did not work through the lessons or run the sample programs, and nothing in the course mentions AI or REA.

name: APKLab
description_en: VS Code extension that turns the editor into an Android reverse-engineering workbench around Apktool, Jadx, smali-lsp and uber-apk-signer. It decodes an APK into resources and Smali, decompiles it to Java, gives Smali go-to-definition, references and diagnostics through a language server, and rebuilds, signs and installs the modified app. It can also generate Frida hooks for Smali methods, add a Frida gadget, prepare an app for HTTPS traffic inspection with apk-mitm and produce a Quark-Engine malware-analysis report.
description_zh: 把 VS Code 变成 Android 逆向工作台的扩展，整合 Apktool、Jadx、smali-lsp 和 uber-apk-signer。它可将 APK 解码为资源文件和 Smali 并反编译为 Java，借助语言服务器为 Smali 提供定义跳转、引用查找和诊断，还能重新构建、签名并安装修改后的应用。此外，它可为 Smali 方法生成 Frida 钩子、加入 Frida gadget、借助 apk-mitm 为 HTTPS 流量检查做准备，并生成 Quark-Engine 恶意软件分析报告。
requirements: The latest tag, v2.0.0, dated 2026-04-06 in the changelog, added smali-lsp, Frida hook generation and gadget injection and Apktool 3.0+ compatibility; the reviewed master commit of 2026-07-16 is five commits ahead of it. The extension is published on the VS Code Marketplace and Open VSX, and package.json requires VS Code 1.91+. The README lists Linux, macOS and WSL2, and CI also builds and tests it on Windows.

JDK 17+ is required. On first use the extension downloads the tools named in the project’s update configuration into a .apklab folder in the user’s home directory, at review Apktool 3.0.2, smali-lsp 1.5.0, uber-apk-signer 1.3.0 and Jadx 1.5.6, unless the user sets their paths. adb is optional for installing to a device, and Quark-Engine 21.01.6+ is optional for malware reports. Users supply the APKs.

CI lints and packages the extension and runs its test suite on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows against a sample open-source APK from the separate testdata repository; this checks the integration, not the bundled tools’ results on real apps. Jadx output can be incomplete, and rebuilt APKs are re-signed with uber-apk-signer, using the configured keystore when one is set.

AGPL-3.0; Apktool, Jadx, smali-lsp, uber-apk-signer, apk-mitm, Frida and Quark-Engine keep their own licenses. HTTPS-inspection patching and gadget injection modify the app under analysis, and the tool grants no rights to analyze, patch or redistribute third-party apps. This review installed nothing and modified no apps.

name: Triton
description_en: C++ library with Python bindings for dynamic binary analysis of x86, x86-64, ARM32, AArch64 and RISC-V 32/64 code. Callers process instructions one at a time, optionally with concrete register and memory values; Triton builds symbolic expressions from each instruction's semantics, tracks taint and solves path constraints through Z3 or Bitwuzla. It also synthesizes and simplifies expressions and lifts them to LLVM IR or Z3 and back, for building analysis tools, automating reverse engineering, software verification or emulating code.
description_zh: 面向 x86、x86-64、ARM32、AArch64 和 RISC-V 32/64 代码动态二进制分析的 C++ 库，提供 Python 绑定。调用方逐条处理指令，并可设置具体的寄存器和内存值；Triton 依据每条指令的语义构建符号表达式、进行污点跟踪，并通过 Z3 或 Bitwuzla 求解路径约束。它还能合成与化简表达式，并将其提升为 LLVM IR 或 Z3 表达式后再转换回来，可用于构建分析工具、自动化逆向工程、软件验证或模拟执行代码。
requirements: The README calls Triton a part-time project that may not be fully reliable. The newest GitHub release is v0.9 from 2022-02-09, with Windows builds only; PyPI's triton-library 1.0.0rc4, first uploaded 2024-05-22 with wheels added through 2026-02-23, provides CPython 3.8–3.14 wheels for x86_64 Linux (manylinux 2.31/2.34), macOS 12 and Windows. The reviewed master commit declares version 1.0, and the dev-v1.0 branch was 22 commits ahead.

Source builds use CMake 3.20+ and need Capstone 5+. Z3 4.6+ is the default solver; Bitwuzla 0.4+, LLVM 12+ for lifting, Boost 1.68+ and libpython 3.6+ for the Python bindings are optional, and LLVM and Bitwuzla are off by default. The README also covers Windows builds and a vcpkg port maintained outside the project.

The README example processes raw instruction bytes against caller-set registers; some bundled examples load executables with LIEF and hook libc functions themselves, and the examples include CTF write-ups with their challenge binaries. CTest runs Python unit tests and per-architecture scripts that compare Triton's semantics with the Unicorn emulator; the x86 script notes that Unicorn 2.1.1 lacks some tested instructions.
Apache-2.0; Capstone, Z3, Bitwuzla, LLVM and Boost keep their own licenses. Symbolic results describe only the executed instructions and modeled state. No binaries were analyzed.

name: PyLingual
description_en: Research decompiler for CPython bytecode from Python 3.6 onward that pairs per-version transformer models with control-flow reconstruction. A segmentation model splits bytecode into statements, a statement model translates each into source, and templates rebuild loops, conditionals, exception handlers, with blocks and match statements. The result is recompiled with the target Python version and its control flow compared with the original bytecode, and failing segments are retried with alternative segmentations; the design is described in the IEEE S&P 2025 paper “PyLingual: Toward Perfect Decompilation of Evolving High-Level Languages”.
description_zh: 面向 Python 3.6 及以后版本 CPython 字节码的研究型反编译器，将按版本训练的 Transformer 模型与控制流重建相结合。分段模型把字节码切分为语句，语句模型将每段翻译为源码，再由模板重建循环、条件分支、异常处理、with 块和 match 语句。生成结果会用目标 Python 版本重新编译，并与原字节码比较控制流，未通过的片段会改用其他分段方案重试；其设计见 IEEE S&P 2025 论文《PyLingual: Toward Perfect Decompilation of Evolving High-Level Languages》。
requirements: First release at review: v0.0.1, published 2026-09-21, whose notes report decompilation rates of about 82–87% for Python 3.6–3.12 and about 71% for 3.13–3.15 on the separate pylingual_eval_dataset; these are project-reported figures. The reviewed main commit is 67 commits later and declares version 0.1.0. The README warns that this readability-focused codebase may initially regress in control-flow accuracy compared with the hosted service.

Installed from a clone with uv tool install; pyproject.toml requires Python 3.12+ and pulls in PyTorch, Transformers, Hugging Face Hub and xdis. Per-version segmentation and statement models are downloaded from the syssec-utd Hugging Face organization at their unpinned main revision and run on CUDA when available, otherwise on CPU. Model cards differ in declared licenses: the 3.12 statement model states Apache-2.0, while its segmenter states none.

Checking a reconstruction compiles it in the target version: uv-managed interpreters cover 3.8–3.15, while 3.6 and 3.7 need pyenv or pyenv-win, which --init-pyenv can install. An optional Redis instance caches model predictions, keyed by version and normalized bytecode but not by model revision. The pylingual.io web service is a hosted alternative, so confidential .pyc files should stay with the local CLI.

GPL-3.0-only. Passing the control-flow check does not prove that the recovered source is identical to the original, and recovered code keeps the original owner’s rights. Nothing was installed, no models were run and the paper was checked only for its bibliographic record.

name: Star Fox 64: a complete matching Nintendo 64 decompilation
description_en: Reconstructs C source for the US 1.1 (Rev A) Nintendo 64 release of Star Fox 64 that, compiled with the IDO compiler through a static recompilation, rebuilds a ROM with the published MD5; the README badge counts all 2,951 functions as matching. Code and assets are split from the user’s own ROM at build time, and the repository contains no assets or assembly. The separately curated Starship PC port compiles this C code, while Starfox 64: Recompiled takes headers and some functions from it for its patches.
description_zh: 为 Nintendo 64 版《星际火狐 64》美版 1.1（Rev A）重建 C 源码；借助静态重编译运行的 IDO 编译器编译后，可重建出 MD5 与公布值一致的 ROM，README 徽章显示全部 2,951 个函数均已一致。构建时从使用者自备的 ROM 中拆分代码与素材，仓库本身不含素材或汇编。另行收录的 Starship PC 移植直接编译这份 C 代码，Starfox 64: Recompiled 则从中取用头文件和部分函数来编写补丁。
requirements: The reviewed master pin of 2026-09-28 is a clean-up commit after the July 2026 commits announcing 100% completion. README calls this a complete matching decompilation of the US 1.1 (Rev A) ROM, MD5 741a94eee093c4c8684e66b89f8685e8, and says it is not a PC port. Splat configurations and linker scripts also exist for US 1.0, Japanese and European releases, with checksum files for uncompressed Japanese and European 1.0 ROMs, but README does not document building them.

Building needs the user’s own US 1.1 Rev A ROM, placed in the project root as baserom.us.rev1.z64. README says the repository includes no assets or assembly code; make init decompresses the ROM, splits code, data and assets with splat, then builds. config.yml and assets/yaml also hold the Torch asset definitions that write starship.otr for the Starship port.

README documents Linux, natively or under WSL or a VM, with make, Git, build-essential, MIPS binutils, Python 3 with pip, libpng and the listed clang tools, or macOS with Homebrew’s coreutils, make, pkg-config and mips64-elf binutils; native Windows builds are unsupported. make toolchain downloads decompals’ ido-static-recomp build of the IDO compiler and builds the mio0 tool and Torch, while submodules add splat, asm-processor, asm-differ, m2c and Torch. A GCC build is available but defines NON_MATCHING.

With COMPARE=1 by default, the build checks the output against starfox64.us.rev1.md5, and README reads a mismatch as a bad base ROM or non-matching code. CI runs make init on the US ROM, fetched from a private repository through secrets, and a separate workflow checks formatting. These checks establish ROM identity for that release, not gameplay coverage; this collection ran nothing.

The repository carries CC0-1.0, which does not cover Nintendo’s game, the ROM or extracted assets; the IDO compiler and the submodules keep their own terms. The reviewed sources establish no AI or REA involvement.

name: Galaxy Buds Client: an unofficial manager built on Samsung’s earbud protocol
description_en: Reimplements control of Samsung Galaxy Buds over their proprietary RFCOMM serial protocol in a cross-platform desktop and Android manager. The author reports recovering the message format by analyzing the earbuds’ binary stream and disassembling Samsung’s official Android apps, and publishes partial packet notes for the 2019 Buds and the Buds+. Beyond the official app’s settings, it exposes battery statistics, diagnostics, factory self-tests, hidden debug information and firmware flashing for supported models.
description_zh: 在跨平台桌面与 Android 管理器中，通过三星 Galaxy Buds 专有的 RFCOMM 串口协议重新实现耳机控制。作者称通过分析耳机发出的二进制数据流并反汇编三星官方 Android 应用来恢复报文格式，并公开了 2019 款 Buds 和 Buds+ 的部分数据包笔记。除官方应用的设置外，它还提供电池统计、诊断、出厂自检、隐藏调试信息，以及适用型号的固件刷写。
requirements: Reviewed at the 2026-10-01 master head, 72 commits after release 5.2.1 (2026-06-07). Device specifications in source cover Galaxy Buds models from the original 2019 Buds through the Buds4 series. The protocol notes say they are incomplete and point to the source for details; this is an independent client, not recovered Samsung source, and features vary by model.

Requires the user’s own Galaxy Buds paired over Bluetooth; earbud firmware and Samsung’s official apps are not part of the repository. Firmware flashing and downgrades download builds from the author’s firmware service, behind an in-app disclaimer and a model-compatibility check meant to avoid bricking. Release notes say the app can share protocol data through an on-demand crowdsourcing feature to support models the author does not own, and sends crash dumps to Sentry; both can be disabled in settings.

Builds from one solution with the .NET 10 SDK (global.json pins 10.0.300) and Avalonia, targeting Windows 10 build 19041+, macOS 12+, Linux and Android 7.0+ (API 24); Linux Bluetooth uses a bundled BlueZ D-Bus library. Release 5.2.1 attaches unsigned Windows and macOS installers and Linux x64/ARM portable binaries; the README also lists Flatpak, AUR and winget packages, and the Android version is sold on Google Play.

An NUnit test project decodes captured extended-status packets from seven models and checks message and spatial-audio parsing; the reviewed CI workflows build and publish binaries without running those tests. Protocol and feature behavior on real earbuds remains author-reported here, and this source review ran neither the tests nor the app.

GPLv3 (LICENSE); the README states the project is not affiliated with or supervised by Samsung. Samsung firmware, apps and trademarks keep their own rights, and the separate firmware archive the README points to is deliberately not linked from this record. The reviewed sources establish no AI or REA use.

name: OWASP Mobile Application Security Testing Guide (MASTG)
description_en: OWASP’s open manual for Android and iOS app security testing and reverse engineering, published at mas.owasp.org. Chapters on platform internals, test setup and app tampering and reverse engineering sit beside modular, individually referenced tests, techniques, tool pages, knowledge articles, best practices and runnable demos, all mapped to MASVS controls and MASWE weaknesses. OWASP’s UnCrackable crackme apps serve as practice targets and examples.
description_zh: OWASP 维护的开放手册，讲解 Android 和 iOS 应用的安全测试与逆向工程，发布于 mas.owasp.org。除平台原理、测试环境搭建以及应用篡改与逆向工程等章节外，还收录可单独引用的测试、技术、工具页面、知识条目、最佳实践和可运行的演示，均与 MASVS 控制项和 MASWE 弱点对应。OWASP 自己的 UnCrackable 破解练习应用用作练习目标和示例。
requirements: Reviewed at the 2026-09-30 master commit. The latest release, v2.0.0 of 2026-06-30, is described as completing the refactor into modular, machine-readable components and as the first stable release of that framework, while CITATION.cff still names version 1.5.0 of 2022. The pin holds 92 v1 tests and 200 atomic tests, 167 techniques, 135 tool pages, 157 demos, 141 knowledge articles and 74 best practices.

Reading needs only a browser; OWASP’s separate mas-website workflow builds the site. Following the techniques needs a Windows, Linux or macOS host with the tools each page names, such as the Android SDK platform tools, plus test devices or emulators. The guide recommends a rooted Android test device or jailbroken iOS device for dynamic analysis, warns against using a personal device, and describes fallbacks for testers without one.

The UnCrackable apps for Android and iOS are OWASP’s own reverse-engineering challenges, used as examples throughout the guide. Sample-app pages describe third-party apps, and tool pages describe external software; both keep their own terms. Demo results are written up from the guide’s sample code, not from tests of production apps.

The repository is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0, so adapted text needs attribution and the same license. The guide establishes no REA connection; this entry records it as a testing and reverse-engineering reference, and this review ran none of its demos.

name: Wino Mail: recreating Windows Mail and Calendar
description_en: Native Windows client that aims to preserve the familiar Windows Mail and Calendar experience while rebuilding its functionality. The upstream README documents a WinUI 3 interface, mail and calendar providers, contacts, tasks and offline workflows.
description_zh: 原生 Windows 客户端，以重建 Windows 邮件与日历的功能、保留熟悉的使用体验为目标。上游 README 说明了 WinUI 3 界面、邮件与日历服务、联系人、待办及离线工作流。
requirements: Windows application from bkaankose/Wino-Mail; the reviewed README links Microsoft Store and App Installer distribution.
The repository publishes GNU GPL v3 license text for its code; this does not license the original Microsoft application or branding.
Feature coverage and preservation of the original experience are upstream goals and claims. The application was not installed, built or compared here; no REA integration is established.

name: Metroid Prime: the PrimeDecomp matching GameCube decompilation
description_en: Reconstructs C++ source for Metroid Prime’s GameCube executable and its NES-emulator module so that CodeWarrior builds match the originals, across the USA, Korean, PAL and Japanese releases, with early configurations for demo discs and three Wii releases. Matched units are compiled from source and linked with objects split from the user’s disc, then checked against per-version SHA-1 hashes; the repository contains no game assets or assembly. The separately curated Metaforce and Metroid Prime Port build their native ports on this code.
description_zh: 为《密特罗德 Prime》GameCube 版的可执行文件及其 NES 模拟器模块重建 C++ 源码，使 CodeWarrior 编译结果与原文件一致，涵盖美版、韩版、PAL 版与日版，另有针对体验版光盘和三个 Wii 版本的早期配置。已匹配的单元由源码编译，再与从使用者光盘中拆分出的对象链接，并按各版本的 SHA-1 哈希校验；仓库不含游戏素材或汇编。另行收录的 Metaforce 与 Metroid Prime Port 都在这份代码之上构建原生移植。
requirements: The reviewed main pin of 2026-10-19 updates objdiff to v3.8.2. README describes a work-in-progress decompilation supporting GM8E01_00 (USA v1.088), GM8E01_01 (USA v1.093), GM8E01_48 (Korea v1.097), GM8P01_00 (PAL v1.110), GM8J01_00 (Japan v1.111) and GM8E01_02 (USA v1.111); configure.py and CI also cover the Multi-Game Demo Disc, a Japanese demo and the Wii New Play Control and Trilogy releases. Output is the original main.dol and, for the six retail GameCube versions, the NES emulator REL, not a port; docs/metaforce.md explains how to convert code from Metaforce into matching C++98.

Building needs the user’s own disc image of the chosen version in its orig/ folder, in ISO (GCM), RVZ, WIA, WBFS, CISO, NFS, GCZ or TGC format, which can be deleted after the first build. The repository contains no game assets or assembly; decomp-toolkit splits the original executable and its embedded data locally. CONTRIBUTING lists Metaforce, a shared Ghidra server and a symbol map from an early demo disc as references for contributors.

Builds run natively on Windows with Python and ninja; macOS needs ninja and Wine Crossover, and Linux uses ninja with the automatically downloaded wibo wrapper on x86 or Wine elsewhere. configure.py pins decomp-toolkit v1.8.4, objdiff v3.8.2, binutils 2.42-1, sjiswrap v1.2.2, wibo 1.0.3 and a 20251118 compiler bundle from files.decomp.dev, compiling game code with CodeWarrior GC/1.3.2, or Wii/1.0a for the Wii releases. The MusyX audio library comes from a submodule.

The default build links source-built objects only for units marked Matching, uses original extracted objects for the rest and checks main.dol and the NES REL against the version’s build.sha1. decomp.dev’s reports for the pinned commit list 93.89% of GM8E01_00 code (16,478 of 16,685 functions) and 98.47% of its data matched, with 739 of 829 units complete; the other USA and Korean releases report 92.5–93.83% of code, PAL 84.37%, Japan 82.91%, and the demo and Wii builds early figures. CI builds all eleven configurations in a container that supplies the original files; this collection ran no build.

The repository carries CC0-1.0, which does not cover Nintendo’s game, the disc content or the downloaded compilers; the vendored zlib 1.1.3 keeps its own license and MusyX is a separate repository. Metaforce, rewritten on this decompilation, and Metroid Prime Port, a fork of it compiled natively, are curated separately. The reviewed sources establish no AI or REA involvement.

name: Batla 3D server emulator (2015 client)
description_en: C# server emulator for the 2015 Steam client of Batla 3D, covering HTTP account, shop and room services and Lidgren UDP gameplay. It includes a client-assembly patcher and protocol notes that distinguish recovered client evidence from emulator rules.
description_zh: 面向 Batla 3D 2015 年 Steam 客户端的 C# 服务端模拟器，涵盖账户、商店、房间 HTTP 服务与 Lidgren UDP 对战。项目包含客户端程序集补丁工具，协议文档区分了从客户端恢复的证据与模拟器自行选择的规则。
requirements: Requires an owned Unity 4.6.9f1 Steam client and .NET 10 SDK. The patcher uses dnlib; strict Steam validation requires Windows x86 Steam libraries.
MIT covers the repository code; game files must come from your own installation. Client patches also change packet fields and gameplay behavior beyond the server address.
Some combat, economy and objective values are emulator policies. Client evidence does not establish every original server rule or full behavioral equivalence.
The README declares this stack frozen and unsupported. The referenced Batla.UdpSmoke harness is absent from the reviewed tree. No runtime reproduction or REA integration was verified.

name: The Decompilation Wiki
description_en: Community wiki explaining how decompilers work, from disassembly, lifting and control-flow recovery to type recovery, control-flow structuring, quality evaluation and neural decompilation, citing the research behind each technique. It also keeps directories of decompilers, plugins, blogs and talks, pages on applied research such as symbol recovery, code similarity and vulnerability discovery, and a table of about 240 game reconstruction projects by original platform.
description_zh: 社区维护的维基，讲解反编译器如何工作，从反汇编、提升和控制流恢复，到类型恢复、控制流结构化、质量评估和神经反编译，并为各项技术注明研究出处。它还整理了反编译器、插件、博客和演讲目录，设有符号恢复、代码相似性和漏洞发现等应用研究页面，以及按原平台列出的约 240 个游戏重建项目表。
requirements: Reviewed at the 2026-10-15 main commit, from which a workflow builds the site with MkDocs Material and publishes it to GitHub Pages; reading needs only a browser. The README calls the wiki early in development: it has about 30 pages, several of them short, and the neural-decompilation page was last changed in September 2024, so newer LLM decompilation work needs separate checking.

Listings are compiled from contributions, not tested. The decompiler directory’s 23 rows note open-source, inactive, plugin and educational status, and the program-reconstruction table lists 241 games, 39 marked completed; project status, original-file requirements and rights must be checked at each linked source. Cited papers are gathered in a linked Google Sheets list kept outside the repository.

Changes arrive as GitHub pull requests: listing additions should give a description link, tags and a source link, while content changes to research areas need a citation or a reasoned argument. Local previews use Python and MkDocs.

The repository is BSD-2-Clause; linked papers, tools and projects keep their own terms. The wiki was started by Zion Leonahenahe Basque and is maintained with community contributions; the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: RSDKv4 Decompilation: Retro Engine v4 and the Sonic 1 & 2 (2013) menus
description_en: Decompiles Retro Engine (RSDK) v4, the engine behind Sonic the Hedgehog and Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (2013), together with the games’ natively coded menus, and builds it for Windows, Linux and Android. The engine runs the game scripts contained in the official releases’ data files, which users must supply. The project adds a script compiler, a mod loader and an experimental online mode for Sonic 2’s 2P VS; it is the predecessor of the same group’s RSDKv5 decompilation.
description_zh: 反编译 Retro Engine（RSDK）v4——《索尼克》与《索尼克 2》（2013）所用的引擎——以及两款游戏中以原生代码实现的菜单，可构建 Windows、Linux 与 Android 版本。引擎运行官方发行版数据文件中的游戏脚本，这些文件需由使用者自备。项目增加了脚本编译器、模组加载器，以及《索尼克 2》双人对战的实验性联网模式；它是同一团队 RSDKv5 反编译项目的前身。
requirements: Reviewed at the 2026-09-06 main head, 13 commits after release 1.3.3 (2025-11-02). README calls it a complete decompilation of Retro Engine v4 and the menus from Sonic 1 and 2 (2013); the licence says most code is meant to be functionally the same as the specified RSDK version, so no byte-matching build is claimed. RETRO_REVISION defaults to 3 (Origins), and RETRO_ORIGINAL_CODE removes the project’s changes but, per CMake, cannot build a playable game.

It will not run without assets from an official release of Sonic 1 or Sonic 2: README names Sonic Origins on Steam, the Epic Games Store and Switch, and the now-delisted iOS and Android releases. The FAQ notes that Origins data files are packed as RSDKv5 datapacks and lack the games’ music and sound effects, and that release builds and autobuilds disable the DLC and block Origins’ Amy; the repository ships no game data.

Clone recursively, because GitHub’s source ZIPs omit the stb, tinyxml2, asio and Flatpak submodules. CMake 3.10+ builds use Visual Studio with vcpkg (GLEW, SDL2, libogg, libvorbis) on Windows, the listed GLEW, SDL2 and Ogg/Vorbis packages on Linux, and a separate Android guide; Xcode, UWP and Flatpak projects are included, while Vita, Switch, 3DS and WebAssembly ports are unofficial forks. Sonic 2’s online 2P VS needs a Python 3.8+ server that README calls a very unstable proof of concept.

CI builds Windows x86 and x64, Android and Linux binaries with the Plus DLC disabled; it runs no tests, and the project publishes no comparison with the original engine binaries. The FAQ says bugs present in official releases will mostly not be fixed. This collection did not build or run it.

The custom RSDKv3/v4 Decompilation Source Code License v2 requires distributed prebuilt executables to default to DLC off, forbids commercial use and distributing game assets other than unique modded ones, requires crediting the original RSDK author Christian “Taxman” Whitehead and the decompilation authors Rubberduckycooly and st×tic, and binds forks to the same terms. The reviewed sources establish no AI or REA use.

name: Miasm
description_en: Python reverse-engineering framework for analyzing, modifying and generating binary programs. It reads, modifies and generates 32- and 64-bit PE and ELF files, assembles and disassembles x86, ARM, AArch64, MIPS, PowerPC, SH4, MSP430 and MeP code, and lifts it into its own intermediate language for symbolic execution, SSA and data-flow analysis, dependency graphs and expression simplification aimed at deobfuscation. Its JIT emulator runs shellcode or parts of binaries through LLVM, GCC, Clang or pure-Python backends, with Python callbacks that stand in for library functions, sandboxes with selected Windows API and Linux emulation, and dynamic symbolic execution through Z3.
description_zh: 用于分析、修改和生成二进制程序的 Python 逆向工程框架。它可读取、修改和生成 32 位与 64 位 PE 和 ELF 文件，汇编和反汇编 x86、ARM、AArch64、MIPS、PowerPC、SH4、MSP430 与 MeP 代码，并将其提升到自有的中间语言，用于符号执行、SSA 与数据流分析、依赖图以及面向反混淆的表达式化简。其 JIT 模拟器可借助 LLVM、GCC、Clang 或纯 Python 后端运行 shellcode 或二进制中的部分代码，用 Python 回调代替库函数，提供模拟部分 Windows API 和 Linux 行为的沙箱，并可通过 Z3 进行动态符号执行。
requirements: PyPI’s latest release and the newest tag are 0.1.5 from 2023-04-18; GitHub releases stop at v0.1.3 from 2019. The reviewed master commit still declares 0.1.5 but is 100 commits ahead of that tag, so current code is installed from a clone with pip or taken from the project’s Docker images. CI runs the regression suite on Ubuntu with Python 3.10 and 3.13.

pyproject.toml requires Python 3.10+ with future and pyparsing, pinned to 3.3.2. Native jitter extensions are built only when a C compiler is available; otherwise installation continues without the jitter features unless MIASM_REQUIRE_JIT=1 is set. Optional extras add pycparser C-type parsing, Z3 for solver-backed dependency graphs and dynamic symbolic execution, llvmlite 0.44.0 for the LLVM backend, graphviz export and pycryptodome for Windows crypto API emulation. The README marks the LLVM backend untested on Windows.

Binaries, shellcode and memory dumps come from the analyst. The bundled Windows API emulation targets 32-bit x86, and other library effects are modeled with Python callbacks. The IDA plugins use a subset of Miasm without the jitter.
GPL-2.0-only. Lifted IR, simplified expressions and emulation results are analysis aids, not proof of equivalence with the original code. No binaries were analyzed or emulated.

name: Fernflower
description_en: JetBrains' analytical decompiler that turns Java class files back into Java source; IntelliJ IDEA bundles it to show code when debugging or browsing class files. The standalone console decompiler takes class files, JARs, ZIPs or directories, can load library files with -e only as analysis context, and writes Java sources to an output directory. Options cover generic signatures, lambdas, inner classes, record and switch patterns, per-method time limits and renaming of ambiguous or obfuscated identifiers, optionally through a user-supplied renamer class.
description_zh: JetBrains 的分析型反编译器，可将 Java class 文件还原为 Java 源码；IntelliJ IDEA 内置了它，用于在调试或浏览 class 文件时显示代码。独立的控制台反编译器接受 class 文件、JAR、ZIP 或目录，可通过 -e 加载仅作为分析上下文的库文件，并将 Java 源码写入输出目录。选项涵盖泛型签名、lambda、内部类、记录模式与 switch 模式、单个方法的处理时限，以及对含糊或混淆标识符的重命名，也可由使用者提供的重命名类来实现。
requirements: No GitHub releases: the README says releases are published in the IntelliJ repository, whose java-decompiler-engine metadata listed 262.10968.63 as the latest release at review. The README describes Fernflower as part of IntelliJ Community, which takes patches as pull requests, and bugs go to JetBrains' YouTrack (subsystem Java. Decompiler. Engine).

The reviewed master commit's Gradle build (wrapper 9.1.0) compiles for Java 21 and produces fernflower.jar, or a fernflower start script with ./gradlew installDist; the README documents the java -jar fernflower.jar command line.

Inputs are user-supplied class, JAR or ZIP files; libraries passed with -e inform analysis of class and method relationships but are not decompiled. The README says most options are aimed at professional reverse engineers. Output is reconstructed Java, not the original source.

Apache-2.0 with a JetBrains NOTICE. The README credits Stiver as the original author and JetBrains as maintainer since 2014, with some ForgeFlower patches merged; Vineflower is a separately maintained fork. No classes were decompiled.

name: HyperDbg
description_en: Hypervisor-assisted Windows debugger that virtualizes the running system with Intel VT-x and Extended Page Tables to debug kernel and user mode, either locally as a tracing and introspection tool or from a host attached over a serial connection to a guest virtual machine. Its events include EPT-based hidden breakpoints and hooks, memory read, write and execute monitoring without the limits of hardware debug registers, monitoring of system calls, CPUID, MSRs, I/O ports, MMIO, exceptions and interrupts, and Intel PT and LBR branch tracing. A kernel-side script engine, PDB symbol support and an SDK automate analysis.
description_zh: 借助虚拟化技术的 Windows 调试器：利用 Intel VT-x 和扩展页表（EPT）将正在运行的系统虚拟化，从而调试内核态和用户态代码；既可在本机作为跟踪与内省工具运行，也可从宿主机通过串行连接附加到客户虚拟机进行调试。其事件包括基于 EPT 的隐藏断点与钩子、不受硬件调试寄存器限制的内存读写和执行监控，对系统调用、CPUID、MSR、I/O 端口、MMIO、异常和中断的监控，以及 Intel PT 与 LBR 分支跟踪。内核侧脚本引擎、PDB 符号支持和 SDK 可用于自动化分析。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.24, published 2026-09-22 as a single compiled ZIP; the reviewed master commit is that release. The README and FAQ name Windows as the only supported OS. The v0.24 changelog reports that the kernel modules now compile on Linux, but Linux support is still under development.

Requires an Intel x64 processor with VT-x and EPT; AMD and ARM processors are not supported, and the FAQ says most features need a 4th-generation or later Intel processor. The driver is not digitally signed, so the documented setup enables VT-x in firmware and turns off driver signature enforcement and virtualization-based security on the debugged machine. The documentation recommends a guest VM under VMware Workstation, ESXi or KVM in Debugger Mode, because local VMI Mode cannot pause or step.

Building from source needs a recursive clone, Visual Studio 2026 and current Windows SDK and WDK releases; CI builds with Visual Studio 2022 and 2026. The user supplies the drivers, programs or systems to debug, and the README recommends OpenSecurityTraining2’s Reversing with HyperDbg (Dbg3301) course for getting started.

GPL-3.0 for HyperDbg and its submodules unless a file states otherwise; dependencies keep their own licenses. The README also describes transparency features aimed at debugger detection; this entry covers debugging and tracing only. The cited papers were not reviewed, and nothing was installed or run.

name: JPEXS Free Flash Decompiler (FFDec)
description_en: Java desktop decompiler and editor for Adobe Flash SWF files. It decompiles ActionScript 1/2 and AS3 side by side with the P-code they came from, edits scripts as source (experimental) or through the assembler view, and exports or replaces images, shapes, sounds, video, fonts and texts, with SWF-to-FLA conversion, SWF-to-XML round trips and SVG or HTML5 Canvas output. It also opens SWC and ABC files, Scaleform GFx and 64-bit Iggy files, has an ActionScript debugger and deobfuscation passes for obfuscated AS3, and offers its parser and decompiler as the ffdec_lib Java library and a command line.
description_zh: 面向 Adobe Flash SWF 文件的 Java 桌面反编译与编辑工具。它可反编译 ActionScript 1/2 和 AS3，并与对应的 P-code 对照显示；既能以源码形式（实验性）编辑脚本，也能通过汇编视图编辑，还可导出或替换图像、形状、声音、视频、字体和文本，支持 SWF 转 FLA、SWF 与 XML 互转，以及输出 SVG 或 HTML5 Canvas。它还能打开 SWC、ABC 文件以及 Scaleform GFx 和 64 位 Iggy 文件，内置 ActionScript 调试器和针对混淆 AS3 的反混淆处理，并以 ffdec_lib Java 库和命令行形式提供其解析与反编译功能。
requirements: Latest stable release at review: 26.3.0, published 2026-09-14, with a Windows MSI, a Debian package, a macOS app and pkg, a cross-platform ZIP and separate ffdec_lib and Javadoc archives; nightly prereleases are built from the dev branch. The reviewed master commit is two commits after the version26.3.0 tag, a Chinese README update and a dependency bump.

The application needs Java 8 or later on Windows, Linux or macOS; the installation guide asks for Oracle JDK 8+ on macOS. build.properties targets Java 8, and source builds use Apache Ant or the bundled NetBeans project, with Git recommended so the build can embed the revision. The Dockerfile runs the command-line interface on an Eclipse Temurin 21 JRE, and CI runs the Ant checkstyle, build and test targets on Windows.

SWF, SWC, GFx and Iggy inputs come from the user. Video display and export rely on the vlcj and JNA libraries, debugging needs a debug Flash Player, either the standalone player launched from FFDec or a remote player in listening mode, and AS3 editing through the Flex SDK is marked unstable.

The application is GPL-3.0-or-later and the ffdec_lib library LGPL-3.0, with bundled third-party libraries under their own licenses. Decompiled scripts and extracted assets keep the rights of the SWF’s owners. The README directs bug reports to the tracker on free-decompiler.com rather than GitHub issues. No SWF files were opened or decompiled.

name: Mizuchi
description_en: Plugin pipeline for matching decompilation that loops over functions in an existing decomp project: m2c drafts C, decomp-permuter mutates it, Claude rewrites it through a compile-and-diff tool, and objdiff accepts a result only when the compiled object matches the target assembly. A local Decomp Atlas web app indexes matched and unmatched functions with call graphs and code embeddings, helps pick the next function and builds prompts, while HTML reports summarise each run. An optional integrator places matched C into a git worktree, checks the build and can commit, push or open a PR.
description_zh: 面向匹配反编译的插件式流水线，在现有反编译项目中逐个处理函数：m2c 生成 C 初稿，decomp-permuter 对其做变异，Claude 借助编译并比对的工具改写代码，只有编译出的目标文件与目标汇编一致时才由 objdiff 判定通过。本地 Decomp Atlas 网页应用为已匹配和未匹配函数建立索引，附调用图和代码向量，帮助挑选下一个函数并生成提示词；HTML 报告汇总每次运行结果。可选的集成插件会把匹配成功的 C 代码放入 git 工作树，检查构建，并可提交、推送或发起 PR。
requirements: The reviewed main commit of 2026-08-17 declares package version 0.1.0; the repository has no releases or tags and is installed from source with npm on Node.js 22+. m2c and decomp-permuter are optional git submodules with setup scripts. Code embeddings need Python 3.10+ and download torch, transformers and an embedding model of about 2–3 GB, using Apple-Silicon MPS or the CPU; --skip-embeddings avoids them.

The Claude phase runs through the Claude Agent SDK and needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or cached Claude Code credentials; responses are cached locally by prompt hash. The example configuration allows 25 retries per prompt, gives the model read-only codebase tools plus compile_and_view_assembly, and accepts code only at zero instruction differences.

Mizuchi works inside a decompilation project the user already has, configured with a map file, non-matching assembly folders, a compiler shell script and the project’s period compiler. It supplies no ROMs, game assets or decompiled game code; the original files come from that project and the user’s own copies. Listed target settings include GBA, DS, 3DS, N64, GameCube, Wii, PlayStation 1/2, PSP, Switch, Saturn, Dreamcast, Win32, Android x86 and IRIX.

CI on Ubuntu runs type checks, lint, formatting and the Vitest suite and builds the CLI, using bundled agbcc and KMC GCC compiler fixtures; it covers the tool, not decompilation success on any game. The README links an author post on benchmarks, and the repository publishes no match results; this collection ran nothing. The integrator can push branches and open PRs with gh, and its optional AI build fix lets Claude edit files and run shell commands in the worktree, so review its output before it reaches a shared project.

MIT-licensed. m2c, decomp-permuter, objdiff, the embedding model and the compilers keep their own terms, and decompiled code inherits the target project’s rights and contribution rules. The reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: Kuna
description_en: Agent-first decompiler written in Rust that began as a port of Ghidra’s C++ decompiler and SLEIGH compiler, and has since diverged with option-gated features, some ported from angr. A single self-contained kuna binary decompiles one function or exports a whole binary to C, header and assembly files, and the same engine runs in the browser through WebAssembly or as the decompiler backend inside Ghidra. The project calls itself an experiment in having LLM agents refine the decompiler; most code is agent-written and steered by regression and benchmark results.
description_zh: 以智能体为核心、用 Rust 编写的反编译器，最初移植自 Ghidra 的 C++ 反编译器和 SLEIGH 编译器，此后加入了可按选项开关的功能（部分移植自 angr），已与上游分化。单个自包含的 kuna 程序可反编译单个函数，也可将整个二进制导出为 C、头文件和汇编文件；同一引擎还能通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行，或在 Ghidra 中充当反编译后端。项目自称是让 LLM 智能体持续改进反编译器的实验，大部分代码由智能体编写，并以回归测试和基准结果为导向。
requirements: The README calls Kuna an experiment. A scheduled workflow publishes releases daily; the latest at review, v1.906 of 2026-10-18, has kuna archives for Linux x86_64 (glibc and musl) and arm64, macOS arm64 and x86_64 and Windows x86_64, a specs archive and a Ghidra 12.1.2 extension zip. The reviewed main commit is 40 commits ahead of it, and the README’s Ghidra install step still links the older v1.157 zip.

Release binaries embed the compiled SLEIGH specs. Source builds need only a Rust toolchain, with the workspace declaring Rust 1.90+; make specs compiles the vendored Ghidra processor specs before a release-style kuna build. Users supply the binaries to analyze; the README says the browser version decompiles on the user’s machine, so the file stays local.

The Ghidra extension is version-locked to the Ghidra release in its file name and bundles Linux, macOS and Windows backends; other 12.x releases are marked unverified, and the README says not all native Ghidra features are supported yet. Headless Ghidra never loads the plugin, so the README swaps the stock decompile binary or uses a PyGhidra toggle, and reports testing that swap with Ghidra 12.1.2 and REA 3.1.0. That is the project’s own compatibility note, not an REA-maintained integration; this collection did not try it.

CI runs the 675-assertion XML regression corpus vendored from Ghidra against a checked-in baseline, Kuna’s own stage testcases, the cargo workspace suite, a spec-documentation check, CLI tests and the browser page’s modules. docs/history.md reports that the Rust port matched all 675 assertions against the untouched C++ decompiler before the C++ tree was removed. The README’s top DecBench standing and speed figures are project-reported; this review decompiled nothing.

Apache-2.0. NOTICE says the engine, SLEIGH compiler, processor specs and regression corpus derive from Ghidra, also Apache-2.0, and that some structuring and region-recovery code is ported from angr under BSD-2-Clause. Output can differ from stock Ghidra by design and is a reading aid, not verified original source.

name: Bytecode Viewer
description_en: Desktop suite for inspecting compiled Java and Android programs: drop in a class, JAR, WAR, APK, DEX, XAPK or APKM file to browse its classes and resources, with up to three decompiler or disassembler views side by side. The README lists six bundled Java decompilers (Krakatau, CFR, Procyon, FernFlower, JADX and JD-GUI), Krakatau and Smali/baksmali disassemblers and assemblers plus javap, Dex2Jar and Enjarify for APK/DEX conversion, a built-in Java compiler for editing, and static search. Java and JavaScript plugins receive every loaded class as an ASM ClassNode for jobs such as string deobfuscation or malicious-code searches.
description_zh: 用于检查已编译 Java 与 Android 程序的桌面套件：拖入 class、JAR、WAR、APK、DEX、XAPK 或 APKM 文件即可浏览其中的类和资源，并可并排显示最多三个反编译器或反汇编器视图。README 列出六个内置 Java 反编译器（Krakatau、CFR、Procyon、FernFlower、JADX 和 JD-GUI）、Krakatau 与 Smali/baksmali 反汇编器和汇编器以及 javap，还有用于 APK/DEX 转换的 Dex2Jar 和 Enjarify、用于编辑的内置 Java 编译器和静态搜索。Java 和 JavaScript 插件会收到全部已加载类的 ASM ClassNode，可用于字符串去混淆或恶意代码搜索等任务。
requirements: Release at review: v2.13.2, published 2026-01-01 and re-released on 2026-01-06 with Windows APK fixes, as a single runnable JAR started with java -jar. Its notes call it an in-development version whose CLI is being rewritten and is not functional, pointing CLI users to v2.12; the reviewed master commit is ten fix commits ahead of that tag and still declares 2.13.2.

pom.xml targets Java 8 and holds the bundled JADX at 1.4.7 because newer versions need Java 11+; source builds use mvn package. Some tools call external runtimes: the Krakatau decompiler needs a configured Python 2 command and a JRE rt.jar library, and Enjarify needs Python 3. The README suggests a larger -Xmx heap for OutOfMemoryError.

Inputs are user-supplied class, JAR, ZIP, WAR, APK, DEX, XAPK or APKM files. Decompiled Java is reconstructed from bytecode rather than recovered source, and the bundled decompilers can disagree; the side-by-side views are for comparing them.

GPL-3.0 per the LICENSE file; bundled decompilers and converters keep their own licenses. The repository's Zip Slip advisory (CVE-2022-21675) affects v2.10.x and is fixed from v2.11.0. No files were decompiled.

name: Binary Ninja API
description_en: Vector 35’s public C++, Python and Rust APIs for Binary Ninja, with their documentation, examples and the open-source plugins built on them. Binary Ninja itself is a closed-source commercial application, and this repository does not contain its analysis core. The open plugins cover the x86/x86_64, ARM64, ARMv7, PowerPC, MIPS, RISC-V and MSP430 architectures, ELF, PE/COFF, Mach-O and Apple shared-cache and kernel-cache loaders, DWARF, PDB and IDB import, and Objective-C, RTTI and SVD analysis, while the examples walk the low- and medium-level intermediate languages and extend the analysis pipeline through workflows.
description_zh: Vector 35 为 Binary Ninja 公开的 C++、Python 和 Rust API，附带文档、示例以及基于这些 API 的开源插件。Binary Ninja 本身是闭源商业软件，本仓库不包含其分析核心。开源插件涵盖 x86/x86_64、ARM64、ARMv7、PowerPC、MIPS、RISC-V 和 MSP430 架构，ELF、PE/COFF、Mach-O 以及 Apple 共享缓存和内核缓存加载器，DWARF、PDB 与 IDB 导入，以及 Objective-C、RTTI 和 SVD 分析；示例则演示如何遍历低级与中级中间语言，并通过工作流扩展分析流程。
requirements: The dev branch tracks Binary Ninja development builds. The newest release in this repository at review is stable/6.0.10601, published 2026-09-03, whose assets are Binary Ninja Free installers; the reviewed dev commit is 165 commits ahead of it, and dev-only material such as the guide to plugin-registered MCP tools is not in that release. The README says master tracks the stable build, but master was last updated in August 2024.

The API does not run on its own: plugins and scripts load the closed-source core from an installed copy of Binary Ninja. C++ plugins must be built from the API revision named in the installation’s api_REVISION.txt, and the install_api.py script shipped with the installation adds the Python module to another interpreter. The standalone examples and other headless scripts need a license with headless API access; the plugin guide says non-commercial licenses lack headless automation and names the Commercial and Ultimate editions for it.

CMakeLists.txt requires CMake 3.28+, a 64-bit C++20 toolchain and a Python 3.12+ interpreter. UI plugins need Qt 6.8.2, which the README recommends taking from the official installer or Vector 35’s Qt build rather than Homebrew, and -DHEADLESS=ON skips them. The Rust crate declares rust-version 1.98.1.

Most of the API and documentation is MIT-licensed and the Rust API is Apache-2.0; some components carry their own license files, and contributions go through Vector 35’s CLA. These licenses cover the API layer only and do not make Binary Ninja open source. The repository’s issue tracker also serves the wider product. No plugin was built and no binary was analyzed.

name: OpenRW: an open re-implementation of the Grand Theft Auto III engine
description_en: Re-implements Rockstar Games’ Grand Theft Auto III (2001) as a cross-platform C++ engine that runs on the data of a legitimate PC copy. It has its own loaders for the game’s RenderWare models, textures and archives, a script machine for the original mission scripts, and an optional Qt data viewer. Playability is partial: the project’s mission tracker marks six early Portland story missions as completable.
description_zh: 以跨平台 C++ 引擎重新实现 Rockstar Games 的《侠盗猎车手 III》（2001），在正版 PC 游戏的数据上运行。项目自行实现了游戏 RenderWare 模型、纹理和归档的加载器，提供执行原版任务脚本的脚本机，并附带可选的 Qt 数据查看器。可玩程度有限：项目的任务追踪清单只将波特兰的六个早期剧情任务标为可完成。
requirements: The reviewed main snapshot dates from 2025-06-18; the repository has no tagged releases and the wiki says there are no official builds, so OpenRW is built from source. The playable-missions tracker (issue #52, last updated 2024-07-24) checks six story missions, all in Portland, and notes missing AI, broken cutscenes or unimplemented opcodes for many others; the FAQ says Vice City and San Andreas are not supported yet. The reviewed sources do not describe how the original executable was analysed.

README requires a legitimate copy of the original PC game, and the FAQ says the original assets cannot be distributed; the repository contains no game data. rwgame reads the game directory set in its openrw.ini configuration file, and the optional rwviewer opens objects and models from the same data.

Builds use CMake 3.8+ and a C++17 compiler against Boost (program_options and system, plus unit_test_framework for tests), OpenAL, Bullet, GLM, FFmpeg, SDL2 and OpenGL, with FreeType for the tools and Qt 5 for the viewer; Conan is an optional package manager. The FAQ names C++17 and OpenGL 3.3 Core as hard requirements, and README reports ports to Linux, macOS, Windows and several BSDs.

GitHub Actions jobs on Arch Linux, Fedora and Ubuntu and an AppVeyor Visual Studio 2017 job run a CTest script that builds the code and its Boost.Test unit suite; tests that need game data sit behind the TEST_DATA option, which that script does not enable. No comparison with the original executable is published, and this collection did not build or run OpenRW.

README applies GPL-3.0-or-later and lists FFmpeg (LGPL-2.1 or later), Bullet and SDL 2.0 (zlib) as third-party licences; the microprofile and imgui submodules are separate projects, and the game’s own assets keep their rights. The reviewed sources establish no REA or AI use.

name: ReXGlue SDK
description_en: Experimental SDK for statically recompiling Xbox 360 executables into portable C++23 that runs natively on Windows, Linux and macOS. Its rexglue CLI scaffolds a per-game CMake project and, from a TOML config, analyzes a XEX binary (import resolution, PDATA, block discovery, gap filling, jump resolution and call-target validation) before translating each PowerPC instruction into C++; a runtime derived from Xenia's emulator core, with D3D12 or Vulkan graphics, hosts the generated code. Generated functions are weak aliases that native C++ overrides or mid-function hooks can replace, so a port can be refined one function at a time.
description_zh: 实验性 SDK，可将 Xbox 360 可执行文件静态重编译为可移植的 C++23 代码，在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上原生运行。其 rexglue 命令行工具为单个游戏搭建 CMake 项目，并根据 TOML 配置分析 XEX 二进制（导入解析、PDATA、基本块发现、空隙填充、跳转解析和调用目标校验），再将每条 PowerPC 指令翻译为 C++；生成的代码由派生自 Xenia 模拟器核心的运行时承载，图形后端为 D3D12 或 Vulkan。生成的函数均为弱别名，可用原生 C++ 覆盖或在函数内插入钩子来替换，从而逐个函数完善移植。
requirements: The README cautions that the project is in early development with breaking API changes, and the wiki calls it experimental and pre-1.0, not a turnkey way to play Xbox 360 games or an alternative to Xenia. Users must specify function boundaries, implement missing kernel imports and iterate on the codegen output; unresolved calls stop generation as validation errors unless --force is passed.

Release at review: v0.10.0, published 2026-08-21, with SDK archives for Windows amd64, Linux amd64/arm64 and macOS amd64/arm64; the default main branch holds that release, while nightly prereleases are built from the development branch, 24 commits ahead. Building needs a recursive clone, CMake 3.25+, Ninja and Clang 18+ or AppleClang 16+ on a 64-bit x86_64 or ARM64 host, and other compilers are rejected; the wiki's Windows setup uses Visual Studio 2022 with its Clang toolset and its Linux setup Clang 20+ with GTK3 headers.

Each project's TOML config points at the user's own Xbox 360 XEX; the SDK ships no game code. Documentation is the GitHub wiki, last edited 2026-06-04, whose status section still describes v0.3.x and calls the graphics, audio and input backends in flux.

LICENSE is a BSD-3-Clause text that credits Xenia-derived portions (GitHub reports NOASSERTION); submodules and the bundled PowerPC binutils executables keep their own licenses. The README disclaims affiliation with Microsoft and prohibits use for piracy. Ports built on it, such as the catalog's Skate 3 Recomp case, are reviewed separately; no XEX was recompiled.

name: ReAgent
description_en: An open-source Python agent, published on PyPI as auto-re-agent, that drafts C/C++ implementations of functions in a compiled program from Ghidra evidence and has a separately configurable checker model review each draft in a bounded fix loop. A candidate is accepted only after a structural comparison with the decompile, assembly, control-flow and P-code evidence, the project’s own build, test and optional differential commands, and 11 heuristic parity signals. The README calls these gates conservative evidence, not proof of equivalence, and the tool writes candidates to an overlay rather than patching the source tree.
description_zh: 开源 Python 智能体，以 auto-re-agent 之名发布于 PyPI。它依据 Ghidra 提供的证据为已编译程序中的函数起草 C/C++ 实现，再由可单独配置的检查模型在有轮数上限的修复循环中审阅每份草稿。候选代码须先与反编译、汇编、控制流和 P-code 证据做结构比对，再通过项目自己的构建、测试及可选的差分命令和 11 项启发式一致性信号，才会被接受。README 称这些关卡只是保守的证据，并非等价性证明；工具把候选代码写入覆盖层，而不直接修改源码树。
requirements: The reviewed pin follows the v0.4.0 release of 2026-09-09 by one documentation commit; pyproject.toml classifies the package as alpha. The re-agent CLI covers init, plan, reverse, parity, status, estimate and evidence commands, with generic-cpp, windows-x64, gta-reversed and openrct2 profiles, the last two carrying hook and stub patterns for those existing reimplementation projects. Outputs are per-function candidate code, per-call prompt and response logs, checkpoints and a knowledge graph; the README says it never commits, pushes or overwrites the original tree.

Users supply the target program, a local Ghidra project in which it is imported, and a C/C++ project whose matching function bodies candidates replace in a temporary copy; the FAQ says useful results depend on that project’s source context, types, symbols and validation commands. Evidence comes from Ghidra exports read through the author’s separate ghidra-ai-bridge, whose headless export needs PyGhidra and a local Ghidra installation; without Ghidra only source-only parity checks run. No target binary or Ghidra export is bundled, and the GTA example needs the user’s own San Andreas executable.

It needs Python 3.10 or later; CI runs the tests on Linux with Python 3.10–3.13, on Windows with 3.12 and on macOS with 3.13. At least one model provider is required: a Claude or OpenAI-compatible API key, or an authenticated local Claude Code or Codex CLI, with reverser and checker free to use different providers at the user’s cost. Build, test and runtime commands are project-owned; argument arrays run directly on Windows and POSIX, legacy string commands need /bin/sh, and their results count as acceptance evidence only after trust_configured_commands is set explicitly.

docs/validation-0.3.md reports 131 tests passing locally on Python 3.13 with Ruff and strict mypy, and CI skips tests that need a model or Ghidra. Its one reference experiment, dated 2026-09-04, generated three GTA San Andreas timer functions with Claude CLI; each is reported to have passed review in one round, compiled through the example adapter and matched the original x86 code under Unicorn on seven inputs, with all three wrong-output controls detected. The author calls these 21 matching observations rather than exhaustive verification; this collection ran nothing.

The repository and ghidra-ai-bridge are MIT-licensed; Ghidra, model services and the analysed programs keep their own terms. The README warns that configured commands are arbitrary project-owned commands to be trusted only when the project owner controls them, and that the Ghidra integration has to be tested in the user’s own environment. The reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: capa
description_en: Mandiant FLARE tool that reports what an executable can do by matching a YAML rule set against features extracted from PE, ELF and .NET files or 32/64-bit shellcode, such as API calls, imports, strings and constants. Matches are grouped into capability namespaces with ATT&CK and MBC tags, and verbose output shows the function or basic-block addresses and features behind each match, pointing analysts to code worth studying. It also reads CAPE, DRAKVUF and VMRay sandbox reports for dynamic features and can use vivisect, IDA Pro, Ghidra or Binary Ninja for analysis, with explorer plugins for IDA and Ghidra and a browser viewer for its JSON results.
description_zh: Mandiant FLARE 团队的工具，将 YAML 规则集与从 PE、ELF、.NET 文件或 32/64 位 shellcode 中提取的 API 调用、导入、字符串和常量等特征进行匹配，报告可执行文件具备哪些功能。匹配结果按功能命名空间归类并标注 ATT&CK 和 MBC，详细输出会列出每项匹配所依据的函数或基本块地址及特征，为分析人员指出值得深入研究的代码。它还能读取 CAPE、DRAKVUF 和 VMRay 沙箱报告以利用动态特征，可选用 vivisect、IDA Pro、Ghidra 或 Binary Ninja 进行分析，并提供 IDA 和 Ghidra 的 explorer 插件以及查看 JSON 结果的浏览器界面。
requirements: Release at review: v10.0.0, published 2026-10-16, with standalone PyInstaller builds for Linux (x86_64, arm64 and a Python 3.13 variant), macOS (x86_64 and arm64) and Windows that run without installation; the reviewed master commit only syncs the rules submodule after that tag. The installation guide says the Linux build needs GLIBC 2.26+ and that macOS Gatekeeper must approve the binary on first run. The flare-capa PyPI package (10.0.0, Python 3.10+) does not include the default rules or library-identification signatures, which are passed with -r and -s.

Inputs are user-supplied PE, ELF or .NET modules, raw shellcode, CAPE, DRAKVUF or VMRay reports, BinExport2 files or saved capa feature files. The IDA Pro explorer needs IDA 7.4+ with Python 3.10+ (tested through IDA 9.0); the Ghidra backend and explorer script need Ghidra 12.0+ started through PyGhidra; the Binary Ninja backend uses a separately installed Binary Ninja.

The limitations guide states that packed or obfuscated programs, installers and packaged programs such as AutoIt give misleading or incomplete results, and that capabilities split across wrapper or child functions are not matched; capa warns when its rules detect packing or installers. Matches are rule-based indications of capability, not confirmed behavior.
